featured_plugins.name: dsh-market/dsh-market
featured_plugins.description: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索并安装社区插件，支持分类筛选、一键更新与停用，以及主题切换与配置备份。

featured_plugins.name: awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin
featured_plugins.description: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

featured_plugins.name: omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar
featured_plugins.description: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

featured_plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-genui
featured_plugins.description: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

featured_plugins.name: hanzhangzzz/dsh-diagram
featured_plugins.description: Editable Excalidraw diagrams for DeepSeek Harness conversations.
featured_plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话中的可编辑 Excalidraw 图表。

featured_plugins.name: bowenliang123/dsh-context
featured_plugins.description: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content details, evolution trends, compaction/injection events, and stats.
featured_plugins.description_zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。

featured_plugins.name: 0xsline/dsh-spotlight
featured_plugins.description: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

featured_plugins.name: GooodWei/arcana
featured_plugins.description: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
featured_plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

featured_plugins.name: Edge-Echo/dsh-mcp-bridge
featured_plugins.description: Curated MCP server bundle: one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, plus a connectivity verifier tool and CI checks.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 精选 MCP 服务器全家桶：一键接入演示、记忆、文件系统、GitHub、Playwright、远程 HTTP 等服务器，自带连通性验证工具与 CI 检查。

featured_plugins.name: Noelune/unified-agent-memory
featured_plugins.description: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
featured_plugins.description_zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗���）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

featured_plugins.name: zhijun-dai/Catppuccin-dsh-theme
featured_plugins.description: Catppuccin theme plugin: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha skins for the DSH Web theme runtime.
featured_plugins.description_zh: Catppuccin 主题插件：为 DSH Web 主题运行时提供 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套皮肤。

featured_plugins.name: openma-ai/deepseek-harness-tui#npm
featured_plugins.description: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.
featured_plugins.description_zh: Rust/ratatui 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。

featured_plugins.name: litestartup-com/dsh-api-gateway
featured_plugins.description: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.
featured_plugins.description_zh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

plugins.name: 01Virex/dsh-status-rotator
plugins.description: Replaces the "Deep diving..." turn-status label with rotating meme-worthy phrases, with typewriter and gradient effects.
plugins.description_zh: 把回合状态那句 "Deep diving..." 替换成更有梗的自定义文案，按阶段轮换，支持打字机与流动渐变。

plugins.name: 0xsline/dsh-spotlight
plugins.description: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

plugins.name: 1070296335-create/dph-taskboard
plugins.description: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏会话化任务看板：拖拽会话到待办/进行中/评审中/已完成四列，新建会话可选模型与推理强度，回收站可恢复，支持备注与导出导入。

plugins.name: 13071301808/dsh-composer-expand
plugins.description: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

plugins.name: 2768651338/dsh-effort-slider
plugins.description: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
plugins.description_zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

plugins.name: 2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app
plugins.description: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
plugins.description_zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

plugins.name: a1073097082/dsh-model-search
plugins.description: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
plugins.description_zh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

plugins.name: a179-sanae/dsh-auto-collapse
plugins.description: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

plugins.name: a735624258/dsh-skill-picker
plugins.description: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
plugins.description_zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-file-mentions
plugins.description: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-file-upload
plugins.description: One upload button plus drag-and-drop files into the conversation as local paths: save to the project's uploads/, path text into the input box, works with any vision tool.
plugins.description_zh: 统一上传按钮 + 拖拽文件直进对话：文件保存到项目 uploads/，路径文本自动进输入框，可配合任意视觉工具看图。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-hud
plugins.description: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
plugins.description_zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch
plugins.description: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

plugins.name: AcidGr/dsh-web-mobile-fix
plugins.description: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

plugins.name: Aik358/dsh-anchored-monitor
plugins.description: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

plugins.name: AikenFra/dsh-alive
plugins.description: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
plugins.description_zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

plugins.name: AKIRACOD/dsh-drag-and-drop
plugins.description: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.
plugins.description_zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-sysmon
plugins.description: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 右下角系统状态悬浮窗：实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘占用率，带阈值变色告警。

plugins.name: AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-ui-enhancer
plugins.description: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

plugins.name: alingalingling/ui-status-label
plugins.description: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
plugins.description_zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

plugins.name: anitman/dsh-plugin-video-player
plugins.description: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.
plugins.description_zh: 侧栏浮动窗口里的抖音式刷视频：本地/SMB NAS 文件夹上下滑动，或粘贴在线视频地址（yt-dlp 解析，支持 bilibili/YouTube 与 cookies.txt 登录态）；窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持全屏、拖动缩放、Range 流式播放，并提供 agent 视频推送队列端点。

plugins.name: anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet
plugins.description: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

plugins.name: AppliedYuu/dsh-WallpaperAndCost
plugins.description: Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.
plugins.description_zh: 合并插件：壁纸定制（原图不压缩、裁剪编辑器、左/中/右分区不透明度、MP4/WebM 动态壁纸）＋ Steam 创意工坊壁纸提取（内置 scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py 解析 scene.pkg/.tex，支持预览/下载）�� DeepSeek 余额与用量小组件 ＋ OpenCode Go 套餐用量（会话顶部药丸按钮显示滚动/周/月用量百分比，点开展开进度条与重置倒计时）。各 API key 均由 host 从 DSH 凭据库读取，不入源码/浏览器。

plugins.name: asd13006/dsh-multi-lang-ui
plugins.description: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.
plugins.description_zh: 為 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 語言選單新增六種語言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español）：各語言逐條精譯，缺字串自動兜底（繁中即時簡轉繁、其他語言回退英文），官方更新與第三方插件都能覆蓋。

plugins.name: asukasec/dsh-message-preview
plugins.description: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

plugins.name: Awu12277/dsh-sleep-send
plugins.description: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

plugins.name: ayahunter/dsh-trail#bundle
plugins.description: Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.
plugins.description_zh: 把 Web GUI 的轨迹页签替换为新手友好的回合故事线：工具名通俗中文化，支持类别筛选与模糊搜索。

plugins.name: ayingQAQ/dsh-web-launcher
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插��，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

plugins.name: bainianlaoyao/easy-archive
plugins.description: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
plugins.description_zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-composer-history
plugins.description: Command history for the Web UI composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 输入框命令历史：按 ↑/↓ 浏览此前发送的指令，回到历史末尾时恢复原草稿。

plugins.name: bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop
plugins.description: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
plugins.description_zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

plugins.name: bitxeno/dsh-github-picker
plugins.description: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

plugins.name: BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite
plugins.description: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.
plugins.description_zh: 聊天区里的像素小宠物：从蛋孵化三选一，也可用一句话描述让 LLM 画出自定义形象，自动在消息气泡间平台跳跃，支持 WASD 操控与拖拽，用已配置的模型角色扮演陪聊，养成系统（心情/电量/健康、等级、商店）由真实 token 消耗驱动。

plugins.name: boogoo619/dsh-focus-overlay
plugins.description: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
plugins.description_zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

plugins.name: caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail
plugins.description: Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.
plugins.description_zh: 会话刻度线导航条：你发的每条消息一格刻度，点亮峰值随鼠标移动、两侧均匀衰减，悬停预览消息摘要，点击或键盘跳转到对应位置。

plugins.name: causebefore/dsh-pomodoro
plugins.description: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

plugins.name: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI
plugins.description: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

plugins.name: ccq1/dsh-side-panel
plugins.description: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

plugins.name: Ceelog/dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-setting-mcp
plugins.description: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

plugins.name: CH4ACKO3/dsh-turn-fold
plugins.description: Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的 Codex 风格回合折叠：保留最终答复，合并连续的推理与工具活动，并以多语言摘要展示可配置的实时耗时、工具调用和 token 指标。

plugins.name: chengzhi43/dsh-file
plugins.description: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
plugins.description_zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

plugins.name: Choi-Peng/dsh-footer-order
plugins.description: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

plugins.name: chongfengdy-dev/dsh-message-outline
plugins.description: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
plugins.description_zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

plugins.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-chat-tidy
plugins.description: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter heading ladder, list and block rhythm, blockquote bar and table cells, with no settings to choose and before/after captures in the README.
plugins.description_zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文、更紧凑的标题层级、列表与块级节奏、引用条与表格单元格；无需任何设置，README 内附前后对比图。

plugins.name: ChuanTianML/prompt-for-me
plugins.description: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户���认。

plugins.name: coldcgh/dsh-deepseek-chat
plugins.description: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
plugins.description_zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

plugins.name: cookiesheep/whale-on-desk
plugins.description: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
plugins.description_zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

plugins.name: Coprexist/AIsChat#dsh-aischat
plugins.description: Embeds the AIsChat social-agent platform into the DSH web UI as a native sidebar board — contact panel, real-time chat over a same-origin HTTP/WS proxy, and Markdown/LaTeX rendering. The plugin is the front end only; it proxies to an AIsChat backend you run yourself (default http://127.0.0.1:5228, from the same repository).
plugins.description_zh: 把 AIsChat 社交智能体平台以原生侧边栏形式嵌入 DSH Web 界面——联系人面板、经同源 HTTP/WS 代理的实时聊天、Markdown/LaTeX 渲染。插件只是前端，它代理到你自己运行的 AIsChat 后端（默认 http://127.0.0.1:5228，后端在同一仓库内）。

plugins.name: cuhaitiang0405-collab/dsh-indexbookmark
plugins.description: Conversation question index for the DSH Web UI: every question you asked in a session, searchable, paginated, with one-click jump to the exact message.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 对话问题索引：列出会话中你提过的所有问题，支持搜索、分页与一键定位。

plugins.name: daetz-coder/dsh-multi-chat
plugins.description: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-aionui-panel
plugins.description: Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 右侧面板系统：像素级还原 AionUi 的资源树 + 预览（文件树、差异视图、预览）。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-liangshen
plugins.description: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 的梁神 agent 预设：两阶段锚定标准预设。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-task-board
plugins.description: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 任务看板：侧边栏入口 + 多列看板视图，本地持久化。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-all
plugins.description: DSH Web UI family aggregator: one-click install of all feature plugins (task-board, git-graph, pet, remote-web-ui, live-stats, web-ui-settings).
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 全家桶聚合插件：一键安装全部功能插件（task-board/git-graph/pet/remote-web-ui/live-stats/web-ui-settings）。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-settings
plugins.description: Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 设置页的 Web UI 插件组卡片：dsh-web-ui 全家插件的开关与配置。

plugins.name: dannyvan/dsh-file-drop
plugins.description: Drag & drop or click to attach any non-image file (PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/text) into the composer: in the desktop shell it resolves the real Finder path instantly; otherwise it uploads to the workspace and inserts the path.
plugins.description_zh: 拖拽/点击上传任意非图片文件（PDF/Word/Excel/ZIP/文本）到输入框：桌面壳下直取 Finder 原始路径；无壳时上传到工作区并插入路径。

plugins.name: DDSG-X/dsh-workspace-dir
plugins.description: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.
plugins.description_zh: 在可拖动、透明度可调的目录面板中显示当前对话的工作目录与文件列表。

plugins.name: demacia1314/dsh-airdrop
plugins.description: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.
plugins.description_zh: ⭐ 支持拖拽上传：任意文件、整个文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可；支持远程上传——字节直传服务器的会话工作区，部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。

plugins.name: Devin-AXIS/deepseek-design#deepseek-idesign
plugins.description: Visual design studio for websites, app prototypes, posters, cards, reports, and magazines, with templates, direct element editing, selection-aware AI draft handoff, and export.
plugins.description_zh: 可视化设计工作室，支持网站、App 原型、海报、信息卡、报告和杂志的模板创建、元素编辑、选区级 AI 草稿衔接与导出。

plugins.name: Devin-AXIS/deepseek-design#deepseek-ivideo
plugins.description: Visual video studio with an editable timeline, animation and media controls, 27 templates, whole-video and selection-aware AI draft handoff, validation, preview, and export.
plugins.description_zh: 可视化视频工作室，支持可编辑时间线、动画和素材控制、27 个模板、整段与选区级 AI 草稿衔接、校验、预览和导出。

plugins.name: dhb861832993-star/pbr-render
plugins.description: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
plugins.description_zh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

plugins.name: dingyi222666/dsh-focus-chat
plugins.description: A "focus chat" minimal view that shows only final outputs.
plugins.description_zh: 「聚焦会话」精简视图，只关注最终产出结果。

plugins.name: dingyi580/dsh-conversation-rail
plugins.description: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.
plugins.description_zh: 对话左缘的导航轨：一根杠一轮对话，杠长按该轮文字体量，悬停出提问与回答预览，点击跳转；杠来自 host 侧读整份会话日志折出的大纲，未加载进窗口的轮次也画得出来，点击时再翻页补历史。

plugins.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-input-traffic
plugins.description: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with freeze/resume and in-place multi-line editing.
plugins.description_zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持冻结/恢复与多行原位编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-niao/dsh-niao-quick-open
plugins.description: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

plugins.name: e2mcc/dsh-popout-sidebar
plugins.description: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
plugins.description_zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同���显示。

plugins.name: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-agents-pixe
plugins.description: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

plugins.name: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-three-body
plugins.description: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

plugins.name: Fayelin12/dsh-office
plugins.description: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
plugins.description_zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

plugins.name: FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt
plugins.description: Right-side prompt toolbox panel with 24 built-in deep templates plus user-defined ones, accessible via the /prompt slash trigger and a context-aware floating suggestion card; one-click inserts the selected prompt into the composer.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框旁的 prompt 工具箱面板：24 条内置深度模板 + 自定义模板，/prompt 触发源 + 智能推荐悬浮卡，点选即插入当前对话。

plugins.name: fengMax1997/dsh-line-select
plugins.description: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.
plugins.description_zh: 行��区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

plugins.name: flyhigao/dsh-sticky-notes
plugins.description: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 工作区极简便签：在各个工作区保存多张 Markdown 便签，记录你的想法和项目进程。

plugins.name: future007s/dsh-peak-indicator
plugins.description: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
plugins.description_zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

plugins.name: garrisonz/dsh-sidebar-width
plugins.description: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.
plugins.description_zh: 调整 Web UI 左侧会话列表栏宽度：调低 264px 拖动下限，可选调整拖动上限与展开默认宽度，启动时自动修补 ui-layout bundle。

plugins.name: GeekRicardo/dsh-balance
plugins.description: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方按 provider 展示 DeepSeek、Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、智谱、MiniMax、OpenRouter、OpenAI Codex 的余额/用量，2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

plugins.name: geguanming/dsh-office-plugin
plugins.description: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
plugins.description_zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，��持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

plugins.name: genius-alray/dsh-model-picker
plugins.description: Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。

plugins.name: giiiiiithub/terminal
plugins.description: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

plugins.name: GLFzr/dsh-drop-file-to-path
plugins.description: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 式拖拽：把任意文件拖入 DSH Web 界面，文件存入 ~/.dsh-dropbox，路径以整块蓝色 chip 插入输入框。

plugins.name: GooodWei/arcana
plugins.description: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

plugins.name: guchang/draw2code
plugins.description: An Excalidraw prototyping tab for dsh-better-sidebar with structured product clarification, conflict-aware human and Agent board updates, and prototype-guided frontend generation.
plugins.description_zh: 运行在 dsh-better-sidebar 中的 Excalidraw 协作原型插件：结构化澄清产品需求、保护用户手工修改的人机画板更新，以及基于原型的前端生成。

plugins.name: guo-ziao/dsh-interrupt-button
plugins.description: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.
plugins.description_zh: 发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运��时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

plugins.name: Han-1413141/dsh-sticky-disclosure
plugins.description: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
plugins.description_zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

plugins.name: Han-1413141/dsh-ui-hub
plugins.description: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.
plugins.description_zh: UI 管家：官方/插件 UI 分区折叠、逐条开关，拖拽移动/改大小，碰撞避让与一键自动排布。

plugins.name: hatsuyuki0103/dsh-at-any
plugins.description: Codex-style `@file` mentions for the web GUI: search and reference workspace files of every format (.java, .vue, PDF, images, extension-less, hidden) with no index truncation. Replaces dsh-at-file.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用：输入框里搜索并引用工作区所有格式的文件（.java、.vue、PDF、图片、无扩展名、隐藏文件），无索引上限。dsh-at-file 的替代品。

plugins.name: hg1048596-pixel/dsh-recall-unread
plugins.description: Adds a strip above the composer to recall sent-but-unread (steering) text messages before the model reads them.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框上方提供「未读消息」条带，可在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未被读取的文字消息。

plugins.name: HongMing-Huang/dsh-file-upload
plugins.description: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
plugins.description_zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

plugins.name: houyanchao/dsh-timeline
plugins.description: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

plugins.name: HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue
plugins.description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

plugins.name: huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui
plugins.description: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

plugins.name: HUITianYi/dsh-whale-desktop-launcher
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

plugins.name: hunter118/dsh-s7r
plugins.description: A retro macOS System 7-style workstation UI for DeepSeek Harness with desktop windows, Workspace and Agent management, Finder, Terminal, Monitor, context tools, and desk accessories.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供复古 macOS System 7 风格工作站界面，包含桌面窗口、工作区与 Agent 管理、Finder、终端、监视器、上下文工具和桌面附件。

plugins.name: Icather/dsh-clean-desktop-shell
plugins.description: Clean desktop shell for DSH as a plugin: wraps your existing web profile in a native window, tray-managed backend start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, desktop shortcut and single instance. Windows + macOS.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件形态的纯净桌面壳：为现有 web profile 套一层原生窗口，托盘管理后端启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、桌面快捷方式与单实例，Windows + macOS 双平台。

plugins.name: imkingjh999/dsh-shorts-wall
plugins.description: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

plugins.name: Isilsolme/dsh-splash-launcher
plugins.description: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

plugins.name: jackma5477001/dsh-system-monitor
plugins.description: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右上角实时显示运行 DSH 服务端机器的 CPU 与内存使用情况。

plugins.name: jasondu/dsh-ui-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.
plugins.description_zh: 面向手机的 DeepSeek Harness 界面，提供可安装 PWA、响应式导航，以及 Agent 成功完成时的 Web Push 通知。

plugins.name: jermaine123123/agent-context-editor#deepseek-harness
plugins.description: Cross-agent conversation management plugin adapted for DeepSeek Harness, with search, type filters, individual and batch selection, reversible hide, restore, and undo, plus independent reasoning and answer units whose sidecar state preserves the original Session.
plugins.description_zh: 跨 Agent 对话管理插件的 DeepSeek Harness 适配器，支持搜索、类型筛选、单条与批量选择、隐藏、恢复和撤销，可独立管理 reasoning 与 answer 单元；使用 sidecar 保存状态并保留原始 Session。

plugins.name: jhuanxx44/dsh-paste-path
plugins.description: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.
plugins.description_zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝���路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

plugins.name: jiangnanquan/dsh-ux
plugins.description: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
plugins.description_zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

plugins.name: jiuyuechuwuhao/dsh-canvas-preview
plugins.description: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
plugins.description_zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

plugins.name: Jiyr0119/dsh-workspace-explorer
plugins.description: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
plugins.description_zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

plugins.name: jjxjjjjiik-bot/dsh-chat-timeline
plugins.description: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
plugins.description_zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

plugins.name: johnnycls/dsh-no-setup-mode
plugins.description: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页免设置模式：隐藏复杂界面、自动套用最���设置（聊天模式、Full Access、账户余额），并提供一键人设角色扮演（女僕/管家）。

plugins.name: Js2Hou/dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.description: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

plugins.name: jsdvjx/dsh-strata
plugins.description: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.
plugins.description_zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

plugins.name: kangjinghang/dsh-xueqiu
plugins.description: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
plugins.description_zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

plugins.name: kelearns/dsh-navigation-bar
plugins.description: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.
plugins.description_zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

plugins.name: kongdexu/dsh-nav-pointer
plugins.description: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
plugins.description_zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

plugins.name: kouyichi/dsh-tui-app
plugins.description: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).
plugins.description_zh: dsh 交互式终端聊天应用：流式对话、工具卡片、任务面板、全文搜索、轨迹回放、多会话标签与 A2A 派发（Ink 实现）。

plugins.name: l541402398/dsh-file-uploads
plugins.description: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。

plugins.name: Laplace-bit/dsh-smooth-stream
plugins.description: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

plugins.name: lavapapa/dsh-composer-layout
plugins.description: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
plugins.description_zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

plugins.name: LCQ-1024/dsh-prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加提示词增强按钮，将草稿改写为可直接交给 Agent 执行的提示词。

plugins.name: lcthe/dsh-timeline-rail
plugins.description: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-animation
plugins.description: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 回合状态旁的 60 帧随主题适配的单色鲸鱼深潜动画：传播式水面、无缝闭环、资源内嵌、减少动态效果 PNG 回退，且随生命周期完整清理。

plugins.name: lemonorangeapple/dsh-effort-switcher
plugins.description: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: 为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。

plugins.name: liguobao/dsh-file-viewer
plugins.description: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
plugins.description_zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

plugins.name: lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light
plugins.description: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面边缘的跑马灯氛围光环：随会话状态自动变色（运行中绿色流动、完成粉色、有待处理黄色警告），设置面板可调颜色、光圈宽度、转速与闪动频率。

plugins.name: liliuCourier/dsh-chat-outline
plugins.description: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
plugins.description_zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，关键词过滤与一键跳转，轻便/全面两种历史模式，按住 Ctrl/Shift 单击可跳到轨迹视图同一位置。

plugins.name: Limitinfinitude/DSH-Right-Sidebar
plugins.description: DSH Web right-side output dock that collects session artifacts, previews user-facing files, and preserves tab state per session.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏，按会话收集用户产物，预览用户可读文件并保存标签状态。

plugins.name: linhx1999/dsh-writing-pad
plugins.description: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
plugins.description_zh: 停靠在对话旁的会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑/预览、选区 AI 改写、Diff 审核、撤销与草稿恢复。

plugins.name: liqiming-whu/dsh-status-card
plugins.description: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.
plugins.description_zh: 为每次 DSH Agent 回复添加可配置的 dsh-ui 状态卡片，提供双语模板和实时设置预览。需要先从 dsh-market 安装 @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui，否则卡片标记会以未渲染的形式输出。

plugins.name: lisniuse/dsh-modal-enhancer
plugins.description: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.
plugins.description_zh: 为所有 Web UI 弹窗添加窗口化操作：标题栏拖动、八向缩放、钉住防误触关闭、全屏最大化、移除背景模糊，以及按弹窗持久化的状态。

plugins.name: littleboylittlegirl/dsh-community-hot
plugins.description: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

plugins.name: lk251066/dsh-tui-pro
plugins.description: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

plugins.name: lmmzss-jk/dsh-plugin-balance
plugins.description: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

plugins.name: loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin
plugins.description: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.
plugins.description_zh: 为 Web UI 补齐缺失的 IDE 工作台：对话页可拖拽三栏（对话 / 编辑器 / 文件与 Git），多标签编辑（保存、新建、路径面包屑、行内 diff）、工作区 Terminal、文件树（按名筛选、用外部编辑器打开）、源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送/拉取、分支切换、提交图）、状态栏，以及 git_* 模型工具。

plugins.name: Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge
plugins.description: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
plugins.description_zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

plugins.name: LyaxZ/dsh-quick-toc
plugins.description: Conversation TOC for DeepSeek Harness: markdown heading outline grouped by turn, with auto-follow highlight and smooth jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲插件：按回合分组的 Markdown 标题目录，自动跟随高亮，平滑跳转导航。

plugins.name: Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab
plugins.description: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
plugins.description_zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

plugins.name: magian1127/deepseek-harness-zh_pro
plugins.description: Chinese UI enhancement for the DSH web client: completes the Chinese locale, keeps the session stats line fully visible on one row, and adds an Enhancements settings section with configurable chat width.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页中文增强：补全中文界面残留英文、统计行单行完整显示，并提供「增强设置」分区（中文补全 / 统计全显示 / 对话宽度）。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-autoload-history
plugins.description: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
plugins.description_zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-chat-width-customizer
plugins.description: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
plugins.description_zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-turn-marks
plugins.description: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.
plugins.description_zh: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-chat-rail
plugins.description: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-node-appearance
plugins.description: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），��带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

plugins.name: MDR-EX1000/dsh-desktop-kit
plugins.description: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进原生 macOS 桌面窗口：插件 + 轻量 Tauri/WKWebView 外壳跑在同一个 loopback 地址上——真 macOS 全屏、单实例、外链交给系统浏览器、类浏览器页面缩放。

plugins.name: MEMZ-JZY/DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider
plugins.description: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.
plugins.description_zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

plugins.name: mengyun233/dsh-codex-pet
plugins.description: Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

plugins.name: Meredith2328/dsh-sticky-note
plugins.description: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
plugins.description_zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

plugins.name: mervyn-teo/dsh-plugin-collapsible-steps
plugins.description: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
plugins.description_zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui
plugins.description: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

plugins.name: miisaka19800/dsh-restart-fab
plugins.description: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

plugins.name: Minecraftbe/dsh-toolfold
plugins.description: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

plugins.name: Mobai-read/dsh-chat-index-rail
plugins.description: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
plugins.description_zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

plugins.name: Mombrane/dsh-subagent-monitor
plugins.description: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

plugins.name: MorGogh/widget-dock
plugins.description: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.
plugins.description_zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、��量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

plugins.name: Nagi-ovo/dsh-visualize
plugins.description: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.
plugins.description_zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

plugins.name: nailing10086-zx/dsh-custom-ui
plugins.description: Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧文件树侧栏，可打开工作区文件；并在输入框状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

plugins.name: Neumannzc/dsh-archive-manager#plugin
plugins.description: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
plugins.description_zh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

plugins.name: nexsjournal/dsh-vision-plugin
plugins.description: Installs an image-input checkbox into the Models catalog so a custom model can declare image input and receive images directly; includes an optional BYO vision relay.
plugins.description_zh: 给模型目录装上「图片输入」勾选框，自定义模型声明后可直接收图；附带可选的 BYO 视觉中继。

plugins.name: NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-keyboard-history
plugins.description: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

plugins.name: Nothree-code/folder-tree-sh
plugins.description: Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.
plugins.description_zh: 工作区文件树插件：多标签预览（文本/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/图片）、Markdown 内联编辑、Git 变更面板与右键文��操作（重命名/删除/复制/移动/新建）。

plugins.name: Odefined/dsh-mobile-webui
plugins.description: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
plugins.description_zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation
plugins.description: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
plugins.description_zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-at-file
plugins.description: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.description: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-genui
plugins.description: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
plugins.description_zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/ex-setting
plugins.description: Settings extensions for DSH.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的设置扩展。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/web-components
plugins.description: Web Components support.
plugins.description_zh: Web Components 支持。

plugins.name: openAGFS/dsh-agfs
plugins.description: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
plugins.description_zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

plugins.name: opencues/opencues#integrations-dsh
plugins.description: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

plugins.name: openma-ai/deepseek-harness-tui#npm
plugins.description: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.
plugins.description_zh: Rust/ratatui 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。

plugins.name: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-workbench
plugins.description: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

plugins.name: pc439527/dsh-side-monitor
plugins.description: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏系统监控：实时查看宿主机概览（CPU/内存/网络/磁盘）、进程列表与 Docker 容器状态，全程只读。

plugins.name: penguin-oo/dsh-pathlink
plugins.description: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
plugins.description_zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

plugins.name: pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui
plugins.description: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
plugins.description_zh: Code-first React + TypeScript 任务应用，支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏与 localhost；交互状态可供 Agent 后续轮次读取，MCP 和 API 访问在用户授权后执行。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-composer-history
plugins.description: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
plugins.description_zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

plugins.name: Physicolor/harness-ui-enhancer
plugins.description: Web UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens; live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale and UI font stack.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 强化层：规范化官方未完善、设计语言矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）；支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放与 UI 字体。

plugins.name: Physicolor/harness-widgets
plugins.description: Right-hand widget rail for the DSH Web UI: live session stats (turns, LLM/tool time, TTFT, speed, cache, tokens) and OpenCode Go quota via a same-origin host proxy; extensible widget registry for more platform usage widgets, visuals, utility actions and external integrations.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 右侧部件栏：实时会话统计（轮次/LLM 与工具耗时/首 token 延迟/速率/缓存/tokens）与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量（同源代理）；可扩展部件注册表，为更多平台用量部件、视觉表现、实用工��与外部接口集成打基础。

plugins.name: pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-desktop-entry
plugins.description: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.
plugins.description_zh: 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，必要时启动 DeepSeek Harness，并用 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口打开 Web UI。

plugins.name: pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-quote-selection
plugins.description: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.
plugins.description_zh: 引用选中的对话文本并添加可选备注，在发送下一条消息时自动附带引用内容。

plugins.name: pyf2818/dsh-bili-widget
plugins.description: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 里的 B站悬浮看片小窗：置顶窗口，含推荐/热门/排行/精选/关注/AI 频道与搜索，自动连播、迷你专注模式、历史持久化与最小化悬浮球。

plugins.name: qjcnmd/dsh-reasoning-slider
plugins.description: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

plugins.name: Quinn2006/dsh-guise
plugins.description: Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DSH 的 agent 穿上主人钦定的人设：多套人格随心换，全局或按工作区生效，内置人设库、总开关、余额预警与没电模式（80 句随机话术）。文件即配置、保存即生效、零依赖。

plugins.name: qyw233/dsh-deeplink
plugins.description: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
plugins.description_zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。

plugins.name: RAFOLIE/dsh-desktop-windowos
plugins.description: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

plugins.name: Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite
plugins.description: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.
plugins.description_zh: 浏览器像素画与精灵动画编辑器，支持兼容 Aseprite 的文件、本地裁剪/描边蓝图和可选的 LLM 工作流节点。

plugins.name: ReachGa0/dsh-desktop#plugin
plugins.description: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

plugins.name: renat3u/dsh-web-archive
plugins.description: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.
plugins.description_zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。

plugins.name: Ri0n72Y/dsh-workspace-scope
plugins.description: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
plugins.description_zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

plugins.name: Ricketts-Guo/dsh-shortcuts
plugins.description: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预���功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

plugins.name: ruisenbai/dsh-inline-comments
plugins.description: Select text in a finished assistant reply to add numbered comments beside the quote; collect drafts and submit the batch through the official composer as one user message.
plugins.description_zh: 在已完成的助手回复中选中原文，在引文旁添加编号注释；草稿攒齐后通过官方输入框一次性作为一条用户消息发送。

plugins.name: s3yf1337/dsh-desktop#bundle
plugins.description: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

plugins.name: sakuraqqq/dsh-auto-paste
plugins.description: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件。

plugins.name: Sanqi-normal/dsh-model-picker
plugins.description: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

plugins.name: sanqiPanax/dsh-sticker-board
plugins.description: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框上方的冰箱贴纸栏：把常用任务（科技新闻、GitHub 推荐等）做成贴纸，点击即向当前会话发送预置 prompt 并执行，按长期/短期分组。

plugins.name: Semidia/dsh-sampling-sliders
plugins.description: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.
plugins.description_zh: 对话输入区的��型采样滑杆（temperature / maxTokens）：通过 agent/request 钩子对所有供应商的每次请求生效，支持热调/持久化两种模式。

plugins.name: sereinmono/dsh-desktop-pet
plugins.description: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

plugins.name: SherUnlocked-4869/dsh-plugin-msg-nav
plugins.description: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.
plugins.description_zh: 对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

plugins.name: siberiah2o/dsh-plugin-terminal
plugins.description: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
plugins.description_zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

plugins.name: SiriLee/dsh-approval-hotkeys
plugins.description: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

plugins.name: skyhancloud/dsh-client-ui-quote
plugins.description: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.
plugins.description_zh: 在网页聊天输入框上方为选中的 AI 回复内容添加可移除的引用横幅，随下一条消息一并发送。

plugins.name: SmileBuild/dsh-planchart
plugins.description: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.
plugins.description_zh: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.

plugins.name: SnowCrescenter-tech/dsh-milestone
plugins.description: Right-side dot-timeline rail: jump between user messages.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧圆点时间轴导航条，点击跳转到任意用户消息。

plugins.name: SongMiao-tech/dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方「优化提示词」按钮：一键把草稿重写为更清晰、更可执行的提示词，弹出前后对比，支持一键替换回输入框。

plugins.name: songoao25/dsh-bottom-info-bar#plugin
plugins.description: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

plugins.name: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
plugins.description: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

plugins.name: springbrand-lab/dsh-skin-universe#dsh-web-ui-all
plugins.description: Web GUI bundle for DSH: a task board with cron scheduling, a Git branch graph, a file and change side panel, an SSH terminal with SFTP and port forwarding, QR-paired mobile remote control, a desktop companion, live token statistics, and five installable themes.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 全家桶：带定时调度的任务看板、Git 分支图、文件与变更��栏、支持 SFTP 与端口转发的 SSH 终端、扫码配对的手机远程控制、桌面宠物、实时 token 统计，以及五套可安装主题。

plugins.name: Stylelinzzz/dsh-chat-history
plugins.description: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
plugins.description_zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

plugins.name: suiyideali/dsh-selection-toolbar
plugins.description: Shows a floating toolbar above text selected in a conversation, with copy, quote, ask, explain, translate, summarize, and custom prompt actions.
plugins.description_zh: 在对话中选中文本时显示浮动工具栏，提供复制、引用、询问、解释、翻译、总结与自定义提问操作。

plugins.name: sunshaobei/dsh-file-mention
plugins.description: Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder picker menu, plain-text colored mention tokens via the platform lexicon scan, and a nested-git-aware file index.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 式 @文件/@文件夹提及插件：输入框弹出工作区文件与文件夹选择菜单，通过平台词法扫描插入纯文本着色提及 token，内置嵌套 git 感知的文件索引。

plugins.name: sunshaobei/dsh-input-history
plugins.description: Standalone arrow-key input history for the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recalls sent prompts from one global ring shared across all sessions and workspaces, persisted to localStorage with an overridable cap.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页版输入框独立输入历史插件：↑/↓ 上下键即时召回已发送的提示词，所有会话与工作区共享一个全局历史环，localStorage 持久化、容量可配。

plugins.name: taxueseek/dsh-files
plugins.description: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.
plugins.description_zh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容��探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。

plugins.name: TecFancy/dsh-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

plugins.name: TianYa-DAO/dsh-wallpaper-engine#plugin
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine local library, background layer, native Scene panel, and desktop-mode controls for the DSH desktop shell.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 桌面壳的 Wallpaper Engine 本地库、背景层、原生 Scene 面板与桌面模式控件。

plugins.name: tipoLi5890/dsh-file-mention
plugins.description: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。

plugins.name: tsonglew/dsh-media-preview
plugins.description: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.
plugins.description_zh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。

plugins.name: tsonglew/dsh-workspace-search
plugins.description: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.
plugins.description_zh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

plugins.name: tuogusa/dsh-word-complete
plugins.description: Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框词自动补全：按前缀匹配与接近程度排序弹出当前会话词建议，↑/↓ 选择、回车确认。

plugins.name: TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-mobile-ui
plugins.description: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.
plugins.description_zh: Web GUI 移动端适配：窄屏全宽响应式布局、会话抽屉、44px 触摸目标、安全区适配与阅读增强，桌面端零影响。

plugins.name: uigdwunm/dsh-process-fold
plugins.description: Groups each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into an expandable process box that shows the latest two items by default, while keeping user dialogue, interactive questions and final answers outside.
plugins.description_zh: 把每轮 DSH Web 会话中的思考、工具调用和上下文合并为可展开的过程框，默认显示最新两项，同时把用户对话、交互式提问和最终回答留在框外。

plugins.name: UndeadSheep/dsh-file-preview#dsh-file-preview
plugins.description: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: Web 客户端悬浮文件预览窗：懒加载文件树、CodeMirror 预览与窗内编辑保存、Markdown 与图片预览、Quick Open 搜索，以及点击会话中的路径直接打开。

plugins.name: urzeye/dsh-outline
plugins.description: Real-time outline panel for the DSH Web session page: user questions plus a Markdown heading tree (H1–H6) that updates live during streaming, with click-to-locate highlighting, expand-depth control, search, and per-session favorites.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 会话页实时大纲面板：「用户问题 + Markdown 标题（1~6 级）」大纲树，流式生成时实时更新，点击节点滚动定位并高亮，支持展开深度调节、搜索与会话级收藏。

plugins.name: vibeinging/dsh-turn-navigator
plugins.description: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 对话轮次导航。

plugins.name: vlln/dsh-navbar
plugins.description: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.
plugins.description_zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。

plugins.name: vlln/dsh-task-status
plugins.description: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
plugins.description_zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

plugins.name: vvvspec/better-reasoning-slider
plugins.description: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.
plugins.description_zh: 官方风格输入框 + 浮动推理能力滑块弹窗，节点与滑块对齐，弹窗跟随 Harness 主题自适应。

plugins.name: warmwine/dsh-ui-font
plugins.description: Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。

plugins.name: Waverly-W/dsh-scratchpad
plugins.description: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

plugins.name: wefio/dsh-cache-miss
plugins.description: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
plugins.description_zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

plugins.name: weien666/dsh-conversation-density-map
plugins.description: Adds a non-uniform conversation density map(chat history markers) to the right of the DSH chat area: one tick per turn, with tick length and spacing reflecting message size, clickable to jump to a turn and expanding on hover when crowded.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 聊天区右侧添加非等长非等距对话密度地图���历史聊天标签），一轮对话一个刻度，刻度长度与纵向距离反映消息大小，点击刻度可跳转至对应对话，标签繁杂时鼠标悬停会自动拉伸便于点击。

plugins.name: weshopai/weshop-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

plugins.name: whiteguo233/dsh-openbiliclaw
plugins.description: OpenBiliClaw consumer panel for DSH: recommendations, saved lists, Socratic dialogue, profile views, and Agent Bridge tools.
plugins.description_zh: OpenBiliClaw 的 DSH 消费侧插件：提供推荐、收藏列表、苏格拉底式对话、画像面板和 Agent Bridge 工具。

plugins.name: WhitePlusMS/dsh-input-plus
plugins.description: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.
plugins.description_zh: 在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。

plugins.name: WilliamShi666/dsh-wsl-workspace-picker
plugins.description: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

plugins.name: winditer/dsh-elf
plugins.description: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 页面悬浮的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼小精灵：点击打开可拖动、可最小化的临时聊天浮窗，支持跟随会话模型或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点实时流式输出。

plugins.name: winditer/dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

plugins.name: Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline
