plugins.description: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
plugins.description_zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

plugins.name: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-deep-verbs
plugins.description: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.
plugins.description_zh: 把内置 'Deep diving...' 思考状态行扩展为 53 条 deep 系英/中双语短语池：回合开场随机一条，随新思考段/工具调用事件轮换（最短间隔 3 秒），点击状态行切换中英文。

plugins.name: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-turn-fold
plugins.description: Automatically folds tool calls into Think-segment groups and collapses each finished turn into a single header showing duration, token, throughput, and cache-hit metrics.
plugins.description_zh: 工具调用按 Think 段自动分组折叠；回合结束后整回合收成一个大组头，显示耗时/token/tok/s/缓存命中率指标。

plugins.name: WJNCT55555/dsh-web-preview-float
plugins.description: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

plugins.name: wjy9902/dsh-web-default-session
plugins.description: The generic New Session action opens a default-directory workspace instead of requiring a folder pick, and the workspace picker lists that workspace as a no-folder choice.
plugins.description_zh: 点「新会话」默认打开绑定宿主启动目录的「默认目录」工作区（无需选文件夹），工作区选择菜单中也可选该项。

plugins.name: WJZ-P/dsh-attachments
plugins.description: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
plugins.description_zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

plugins.name: wlj521/dsh-ui-tweaks
plugins.description: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
plugins.description_zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

plugins.name: wmengxiang/dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框新增图标按钮，一键调用当前模型把提示词优化得更清晰具体。

plugins.name: wodongx123/dsh-desktop-tray
plugins.description: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。

plugins.name: wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach
plugins.description: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.
plugins.description_zh: **DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标��从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。

plugins.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-composer-tools
plugins.description: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe) and related input conveniences.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）等输入增强。

plugins.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-turn-scrubber
plugins.description: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。

plugins.name: wx-yss/dsh-message-rail
plugins.description: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：每条用户消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击跳转，全历史一次索引。

plugins.name: wydddddcool/dsh-hover-approve
plugins.description: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 侧边栏锚定气泡：会话待授权、提问、计划确认、目标阻断时在会话行旁自动弹出并一键处理，无需点进会话。

plugins.name: wzz3034026545/dsh-rule-manager
plugins.description: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

plugins.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-client-ui-writing
plugins.description: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
plugins.description_zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

plugins.name: XHR666/dsh-mpkg-wallpaper
plugins.description: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
plugins.description_zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

plugins.name: xiaheng1/dsh-turn-nav
plugins.description: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 对话轮次导航轨，支持 mixed / DeepSeek / Codex 三种视觉风格。

plugins.name: Xiaofei-fei/dsh-prompt-history
plugins.description: Bash-like prompt history and terminal-style right-click paste for the DSH web composer: Up/Down arrows recall previously submitted messages and right-click pastes the clipboard directly, sourced from the session's own message log (zero config, zero extra storage).
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供类 Linux shell 的提示词历史与右键粘贴：按 ↑/↓ 召回之前发送过的消息，右键直接粘贴剪贴板内容，历史取自会话自身的消息记录（零配置、零额外存储）。

plugins.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-tui
plugins.description: Clean and simple TUI.
plugins.description_zh: 干净简单的终端交互式界面。

plugins.name: xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager
plugins.description: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

plugins.name: xiaoyuer3921/dsh-showreel
plugins.description: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
plugins.description_zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

plugins.name: XiLuovo/dsh-session-timeline
plugins.description: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
plugins.description_zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

plugins.name: xing-shuyin/dsh-ui-tools
plugins.description: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
plugins.description_zh: dsh Web UI 开发者工具面板：文件浏览/预览/编辑与路径式文件提及、多终端（快捷命令）、Git 面板（提交/推送/拉取/分支）与后台任务管理。UI 移植自 pi-web-ui。

plugins.name: xiyuepcl/dsh-approval-translator
plugins.description: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.
plugins.description_zh: DSH审批汉化 — 审批弹窗在渲染前自动翻译成中文：DeepSeek 驱动、宿主侧完成，React 重渲染也无法还原。

plugins.name: Xliecc/dsh-session-theme
plugins.description: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
plugins.description_zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

plugins.name: Y1X1n/dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框旁加「优化」按钮：流式分析并改写提示词草稿，支持会话上下文感知（模板/润色双策略）、跨编辑记忆链与撤回，模型路由带 fallback 与连通性测试。

plugins.name: yangshen830-eng/dsh-editor
plugins.description: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
plugins.description_zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

plugins.name: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view
plugins.description: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized.
plugins.description_zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。

plugins.name: YiRan0/dsh-mobile-glass
plugins.description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 移动端适配：窄屏下聊天页在上/侧栏在下的 reveal 抽屉、拖动手势、设置面板底部卡片上滑、composer 与头部修复，桌面端零影响。

plugins.name: YooRarely/dsh-open-explorer
plugins.description: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 会话标题和工作区菜单中添加按钮，用系统文件管理器打开当前 Workspace 根目录。

plugins.name: ysyyhhh/dsh-pet
plugins.description: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 跟随 agent 状态的 DSH 原生桌宠，兼容 Codex 桌宠包，并可在插件内直接从 Petdex 导入已审核桌宠，无需 Petdex CLI。

plugins.name: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-read-image-view
plugins.description: Displays the images read in the conversation (read_image results) in the DSH Web GUI: a dedicated Read image row with a default thumbnail and an in-page full-resolution lightbox (zoom buttons, mouse wheel, 1:1 original size), plus the metadata envelope.
plugins.description_zh: 用于展示对话中读取的图片（read_image 的结果）：在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 对话流中以专用 Read image 行呈现，默认缩略图 + 页面内全精度放大层（缩放按钮/滚轮/1:1 原始尺寸）+ 元数据信封。

plugins.name: Yuer6327/NoLetMe
plugins.description: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
plugins.description_zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

plugins.name: Yujm888/dsh-turn-rail
plugins.description: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

plugins.name: YZz-S/dsh-workspace-files-explorer
plugins.description: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
plugins.description_zh: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。

plugins.name: zealot00/dsh-pet
plugins.description: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

plugins.name: yokesky/dsh-usage-lens
plugins.description: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

plugins.name: yyb16yyb-hub/dsh-deepseek-usage
plugins.description: Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.
plugins.description_zh: 实时 DeepSeek API 用量：账户余额与低余额告警（跨阈值浏览器通知）、请求/token 统计（全部/今日/近 60s，按模型与会话下钻）、估算花费——输入框下方统计条 + 设置页用量面板。

plugins.name: YZz-S/dsh-billing-balance
plugins.description: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页、输入框下方读数条与可拖动悬浮按钮三处显示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 套餐额度（5小时/周/月窗口及重置倒计时）。

plugins.name: YZz-S/dsh-token-cost-meter
plugins.description: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

plugins.name: Zenjibad/headroom-stats-plugin
plugins.description: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 Headroom 压缩代理的 token 与费用节省：设置页仪表盘 + 输入区常驻统计行。

plugins.name: zer0zio-stack/dsh-opencode-go-quota
plugins.description: Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider's OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 右下角「余额」徽标：展开时读取当前所选提供方，显示 OpenCode Go 计划限额或 DeepSeek 预充值余额，并附本机 token 用量与按定价表估算的消费金额。

plugins.name: zh667/TokenLedger
plugins.description: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

plugins.name: zhang-jiazhi/dsh-stats-panel
plugins.description: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。

plugins.name: zhouchengke2046/dsh-sidebar-balance
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。

plugins.name: zhu168/dsh-save-money#plugin
plugins.description: Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
plugins.description_zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

plugins.name: zoumutou/dsh-cost-balance
plugins.description: Collapsible iOS-style stats pill under the composer: session cost, DeepSeek account balance, cache-hit rate, and token usage in a frosted panel.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框下方的 iOS 风格统计条：一键展开查看会话花费、DeepSeek 账户余额、缓存命中率与 Token 用量。

plugins.name: 0nt-one/dsh-neo-skin
plugins.description: Neo-brutalism skin with two switchable schemes (Blue Command / Aged Newspaper), hard shadows, sharp corners, and light/dark theme support.
plugins.description_zh: 新粗野主义换肤皮肤：双方案（蓝统治 / 做旧报纸）随时切换，硬阴影 + 直角 + 2px 边框结构层，浅色/深色自适应。

plugins.name: aerince/dsh-models-dev-reasoning
plugins.description: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.
plugins.description_zh: 为未配置的第三方 DeepSeek Harness 模型添加 models.dev 推理级别支持。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-cyber-particle
plugins.description: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: AKS1st/ikun-theme-skin
plugins.description: IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.
plugins.description_zh: ikun 主题皮肤：星蓝昼/夜与背带裤黑金三套配色接入系统主题列表，全屏照片壁纸轮播、音乐盒与发送音效。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-custom-brand
plugins.description: Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 品牌区自定义：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑（双击修改，右键恢复）。

plugins.name: BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin
plugins.description: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室：5 套内置预设 + 完全可自定义的浅/深配色（强调色、背景、前景、UI 与代码字体、半透明侧栏、对比度），即时热切换并持久化到 localStorage。

plugins.name: caoyiwei850/dsh-client-ui-skins
plugins.description: Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

plugins.name: chinaRXQ/dsh-wallpaper
plugins.description: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: image background with opacity, mask and blur controls.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：图片背景，可调透明度、压暗遮罩与模糊。

plugins.name: code-newbie-1/dsh-wallpaper
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a wallpaper-design panel (opacity, scope, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
plugins.description_zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

plugins.name: codeMonkey-Pine/dsh-wallpaper
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
plugins.description_zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

plugins.name: d-dev0101/open-sea-skin
plugins.description: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.
plugins.description_zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-skins
plugins.description: Skin family aggregator: one install gives the skin center plus all skin assets (qq98, ths, xp, blue-fantasy, dragon-heir, minecraft, miku, trading).
plugins.description_zh: 皮肤全家桶聚合插件：一键安装皮肤中心 + 全部皮肤资产（qq98/ths/xp/blue-fantasy/dragon-heir/minecraft/miku/trading 等）。

plugins.name: ddbj-hub/dsh-wallpaper-skin
plugins.description: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
plugins.description_zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

plugins.name: dhicoc/dsh-theme-mineradio
plugins.description: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
plugins.description_zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

plugins.name: DocJlm/dsh-arknights#pramanix-eyjafjalla
plugins.description: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins/dsh-thought-buddy
plugins.description: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
plugins.description_zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

plugins.name: elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: plays local Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页界面壁纸：把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸提取主纹理作为静态帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

plugins.name: FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette
plugins.description: Ports all 34 opencode official themes (33 static JSON + 1 system) into DeepSeek Harness: data-driven pipeline (JSON → color resolve → DSH override), per-browser persistence, monospace/proportional choice, five code fonts, and a system fallback that keeps typography only.
plugins.description_zh: 把 opencode 官方 34 款主题（33 个静态 JSON + system）完整搬到 DeepSeek Harness：数据驱动三层管线（JSON → 颜色解析 → DSH 覆盖注入），按浏览器持久化，等宽/正体切换、五种代码字体实时预览，system 模式仅保���排印。

plugins.name: feng78-boop/dsh-thirteen-bg
plugins.description: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

plugins.name: GGBond2424648901/deep-whale-day-night-theme
plugins.description: Non-commercial day/night whale-girl skin for official Harness rc.7: current no-viewport-frame layout, paired crystal-workshop and moon-tide scenes, chibi companions, translucent ornaments, and lightweight ambience.
plugins.description_zh: 面向官方 Harness rc.7 的非商业鲸鱼娘昼夜皮肤：当前无整屏边框布局、白昼水晶工坊与夜晚月潮观测室双场景、Q 版侧栏伙伴、透明花边与轻量氛围。

plugins.name: GptsApp/dsh-stylevault
plugins.description: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 30 套经典开源主题配色（Catppuccin、Nord、Tokyo Night、Gruvbox、Solarized 等），映射官方 ThemeService token；带 Style Settings 面板，可实时调整颜色/字体/圆角，并支持 JSON 导出/导入分享配置。

plugins.name: hanyi7867069-create/dsh-moonrise
plugins.description: Moonrise dark theme for the DSH Web UI, with deep indigo surfaces and warm amber accents.
plugins.description_zh: 月升暗色主题——深蓝夜色打底、琥珀月光点缀。

plugins.name: Isilsolme/dsh-anthropic-fonts
plugins.description: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
plugins.description_zh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

plugins.name: Juryorca/dsh-custom-theme-import
plugins.description: DSH Web skin manager for mainstream DSH skin packages: import local paths or GitHub collections, scan installed skins from the web profile, preview/use/disable/refresh/delete, with host-side persistence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 皮肤管理器：支持主流 DSH 皮肤包本地/GitHub 导入、扫描已安装皮肤、预览/使用/禁用/刷新/删除，宿主持久化。

plugins.name: keke050/dsh-wallpaper
plugins.description: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: presets, image URL or upload, and an opacity slider that fades the interface to reveal the wallpaper.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：预设 / 图片 URL / 本地上传，透明度滑块让整面界面透出壁纸。

plugins.name: KinGao294/dsh-skin
plugins.description: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。

plugins.name: kingOfSoySauce/dsh-liang-skin
plugins.description: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
plugins.description_zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

plugins.name: leavestring/awesome-dsh-background-plugin
plugins.description: DSH Web background settings: upload a local image or pick a preset ambiance, with live preview and persistent settings.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 设置背景：上传本地图片或选择预设氛围，实时预览且设置持久化。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-qq2007-skin
plugins.description: QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格皮肤：72 个原生主题 token、作用域三栏窗框、原创离线素材与像素伙伴、可选合成发送提示音、响应式/无障碍回退和可恢复设置开关。

plugins.name: Lhy723/dsh-neu-theme
plugins.description: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提��浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

plugins.name: linhut/dsh-stock-terminal
plugins.description: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.
plugins.description_zh: 股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

plugins.name: Liu-ZA-81/dsh-theme-firefly
plugins.description: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
plugins.description_zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

plugins.name: lyq3/dsh-skin-nebula
plugins.description: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.
plugins.description_zh: 动漫皮肤包：忍者、樱花、竹林、落日、苍龙五套 AI 生成高清主题，各配专属点缀色，右上角衣服图标一键切换，透明度可调。

plugins.name: MangMax/dsh-themes
plugins.description: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

plugins.name: mux9056-bot/dsh-theme
plugins.description: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设��� → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

plugins.name: niiang/dsh-kimino-theme
plugins.description: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

plugins.name: NoNameLeGo/dsh-catppuccin-theme
plugins.description: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

plugins.name: ossFrankFrank/dsh-dracula-theme
plugins.description: Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

plugins.name: PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-client-ui-skin-claude
plugins.description: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
plugins.description_zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

plugins.name: RevolutionLA/dsh-dream-skin
plugins.description: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
plugins.description_zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

plugins.name: RizenHNT/dsh-skin-digital-arcade
plugins.description: Digital arcade HUD skin: neon cyan/violet/magenta palette, Fusion Pixel fonts, animated sprites (city backdrop, data core, mascot), custom crosshair cursor; light and dark themes follow the system.
plugins.description_zh: 数码电玩风 HUD 皮肤：霓虹青/紫/品红配色、Fusion Pixel 像素字体、动画精灵（背景城市/数据核心/吉祥物）、自定义十字准星光标，浅深双主题跟随系统。

plugins.name: ruijiaang-lab/dsh-wallpaper-engine
plugins.description: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 聊天背景壁纸。Windows：直接读取你的 Wallpaper Engine（Steam）库，把视频/网页壁纸渲染到聊天界面背后。macOS：自动扫描 WaifuX 下载目录和媒体文件夹——在 WaifuX 里保存的壁纸零配置即可成为 DSH 背景，支持视频与图片。带毛玻璃模糊、压暗、边框调节滑块。

plugins.name: sakuraaa667/dsh-wallpaper-engine
plugins.description: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.
plugins.description_zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

plugins.name: SamizuHM/dsh-client-ui-theme-xp
plugins.description: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
plugins.description_zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

plugins.name: SenryLee/dsh-frosted-window
plugins.description: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
plugins.description_zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，��方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

plugins.name: Sim-xia/dsh-vscode-theme
plugins.description: Imports .vsix theme files made for Visual Studio Code and applies them to the DSH Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 导入为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件并应用到 DSH Web UI。

plugins.name: Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale#maid-atelier
plugins.description: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

plugins.name: starslittle/dsh-blue-whale
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
plugins.description_zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

plugins.name: starsstreaming/beautiCode#deepseek-harness
plugins.description: Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web: a sidebar Background panel, saved themes including a built-in window-frame preset, mute toggle, last-background restore, plus /bg, /bg-theme and /bg-clear commands.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存主题（含内置「画窗」）、声音开关、恢复上次背景，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

plugins.name: TFboy1/dsh-minecraft-ui
plugins.description: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
plugins.description_zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

plugins.name: tiantyu/dsh-skin-toggle
plugins.description: Skin manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable whale button that restores the default look on left-click and switches between installed skins on right-click.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页皮肤管理器：可拖动的鲸鱼按钮，左键恢复默认界面，右键列出并切换所有已安装皮肤。

plugins.name: tianyhjg-lab/dsh-font
plugins.description: Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。

plugins.name: Tkingxiao/dsh-any-background
plugins.description: Custom theme plugin with video and image wallpapers, free positioning, and scale/fill modes. Extracts wallpaper colours and switches text to light or dark automatically. Per-area blur across 6 UI regions, per-area opacity, and one-click theme export/import.
plugins.description_zh: 自定义主题插件：支持视频与图片壁纸、自由拖动位置与拉伸填充模式；从壁纸提取主色并自动切换明暗字体；六个界面区域的模糊分别可调，分区不透明度可调；主题一键导出与导入。

plugins.name: Tommy00748/dsh-theme-cyberpunk2077
plugins.description: Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme: NC yellow and neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter and message SFX, and hidden easter eggs (relic / johnny).
plugins.description_zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题：NC 黄 × 霓虹青配色、CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 悬停锁定、战斗状态 HUD、合成打字机与消息音效，以及隐藏彩蛋（relic / johnny）。

plugins.name: tpmoonchefryan/dsh-joi-channel-theme
plugins.description: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
plugins.description_zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；��三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

plugins.name: TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance
plugins.description: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

plugins.name: tuogusa/dsh-whale-background
plugins.description: Whale-girl wallpaper background with a frosted semi-transparent app surface; customize image, opacity, and contain/cover from the Web settings, with remote image preflight and no-referrer loading.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 鲸鱼娘壁纸背景，应用表面半透明磨砂；支持在设置页自定义图片、透明度与 contain/cover 铺放方式，远程图片自动预检并 no-referrer 加载。

plugins.name: Ultronen/dsh-liquid-glass
plugins.description: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
plugins.description_zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。

plugins.name: webkubor/dsh-bloom-theme
plugins.description: Bloom Morandi theme: four variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all eight foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.
plugins.description_zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：四款变体（雾蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、花瓣 petal、涟漪 ripple）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，八组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

plugins.name: Willmylife/dsh-dynamic-wallpaper
plugins.description: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.
plugins.description_zh: 动态壁纸插件：8 种内置 Canvas 壁纸（粒子、流星雨、星际穿梭、波光、雨幕、气泡、字符雨、极光）加自定义视频背景，支持速度/密度/遮罩/模糊调节，配置持久化。

plugins.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-appearance-gallery
plugins.description: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default.
plugins.description_zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。

plugins.name: xiaozhe7772222/dsh-api-key-pool
plugins.description: API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.
plugins.description_zh: 对话模型 API Key 轮换池：自动检测 settings 中的厂商，每个厂商下多 Key 轮询，401/403/429 自动切换，冷却恢复。

plugins.name: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-liquid-glass
plugins.description: Wallpaper plus optional Liquid Glass islands for the DSH Web UI: Ice/Deepwater presets, import, wallpaper opacity, and per-island blur on official light/dark/system.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 液态玻璃皮肤：冰原/深水壁纸、可导入、壁纸透明度，以及叠在官方浅色/深色/跟随系统上的分岛模糊。

plugins.name: yunxiiQwQ/dsh-maid-whale-webUI#maid-whale-webui
plugins.description: Whale-maid paper theme for the DSH Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, decorative assets, and a persistent pet.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 鲸鱼女仆纸面主题：亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与常驻桌宠。

plugins.name: Yuuhann1999/dsh-bloub-mood
plugins.description: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
plugins.description_zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页���置。

plugins.name: yzke/dsh-icon-theme
plugins.description: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

plugins.name: ZaVang/dsh-diorama
plugins.description: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
plugins.description_zh: 角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。

plugins.name: zhijun-dai/Catppuccin-dsh-theme
plugins.description: Catppuccin theme plugin: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha skins for the DSH Web theme runtime.
plugins.description_zh: Catppuccin 主题插件：为 DSH Web 主题运行时提供 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套皮肤。

plugins.name: zhijun-dai/dsh-Fonts
plugins.description: Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
plugins.description_zh: 字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

plugins.name: zhijun-dai/Solarized-dsh-theme
plugins.description: Solarized and Selenized theme plugin: four faithful palettes registered with the DSH Web theme runtime.
plugins.description_zh: Solarized 与 Selenized 主题插件：向 DSH Web 主题运行时注册四套忠实色板。

plugins.name: zhxqc/dsh-oh-my-theme
plugins.description: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

plugins.name: ZJUZhiyuCai/dsh-ivory
plugins.description: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

plugins.name: AdonisSheldon/dsh-openai-oauth
plugins.description: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
plugins.description_zh: 通过浏览器 PKCE 或设备码 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型，并支持自动刷新令牌以及 Web 或无头登录。

plugins.name: amlyczz/dsh-agy-link
plugins.description: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
plugins.description_zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

plugins.name: BruceLanLan/dsh-tier-router
plugins.description: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
plugins.description_zh: 双档模型路由：强档负责规划/咨询/评审、弱档负责实现；含计划模式自动路由、高危操作守卫、失败自动升级与子代理分层。

plugins.name: btspoony/dsh-llm-fallbacks
plugins.description: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
plugins.description_zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

plugins.name: corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect
plugins.description: Brings the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app straight into DeepSeek Harness — zero configuration in the DSH chat.
plugins.description_zh: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH 对话窗口里零配置使用。

plugins.name: cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit
plugins.description: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
plugins.description_zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

plugins.name: CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router
plugins.description: Routes delegated subagent work to configured models: a subagent_model tool whose model enum is the configured aliases, per-route tags and routing guidance injected into the tool schema and system prompt, a wait-for-subagents join tool returning terminal results from outstanding background children, active-model chips in the subagent header and catalog rows, and a Web settings page, namespace-scoped configuration tool, and guided setup skill.
plugins.description_zh: 把委派给子代理的任务路由到配置好的模型：subagent_model 工具的 model 枚举即配置的别名，每条路由的标签与使用说明会注入工具 schema 与系统提示；wait-for-subagents 汇合工具等待未完成的可续跑后台子代理并返回其最终结果；在子代理头部与目录行显示当前模型标签；另有 Web 设置页、命名空间内的配置工具与引导设置技能用于管理路由。

plugins.name: dawnliming/dsh-chinese-mode
plugins.description: Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.
plugins.description_zh: 全局中文模式：输入框旁的紧凑胶囊开关，开启后向任意预设（完整 persona 除外）的系统提示注入语言要求；回复、思考、工具区域可分别切换中英文，并兼容锚定预设。

plugins.name: dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model#plugin
plugins.description: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略���

plugins.name: dylan121322/llm-adaptive
plugins.description: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.
plugins.description_zh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

plugins.name: Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL
plugins.description: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

plugins.name: ffyuuu/dsh-llm-longcat
plugins.description: LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
plugins.description_zh: LongCat-2.0 模型适配器：100 万上下文、二元思考模式、工具调用，基于 OpenAI 兼容接口的流式输出。

plugins.name: fieldnote-ops/keyringseam
plugins.description: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
plugins.description_zh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

plugins.name: franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect
plugins.description: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

plugins.name: GodD6366/dsh-sub2api
plugins.description: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
plugins.description_zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

plugins.name: HB00/dsh-llm-failover
plugins.description: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
plugins.description_zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模��提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

plugins.name: hytime/dsh-thinking-effort
plugins.description: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-polyglot
plugins.description: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

plugins.name: jiay98528-dev/dsh-model-sync
plugins.description: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
plugins.description_zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

plugins.name: jiay98528-dev/dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor
plugins.description: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

plugins.name: kam74515-boop/dsh-everything-oauth
plugins.description: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
plugins.description_zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

plugins.name: katsos/dsh-claude-cli
plugins.description: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
plugins.description_zh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求��已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

plugins.name: kinoward/dsh-plugin-subhub
plugins.description: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
plugins.description_zh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

plugins.name: LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity
plugins.description: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
plugins.description_zh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

plugins.name: llmpolska/oh-my-dsh
plugins.description: Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分级模型路由：think/build 模型分级、视觉委派（视觉模型只负责描述图片，工作模型负责执行操作）、图片生成，以及高影响操作守卫。

plugins.name: lninghaha/dsh-coding-subscription-oauth
plugins.description: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
plugins.description_zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

plugins.name: lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

plugins.name: Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider
plugins.description: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
plugins.description_zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-codex
plugins.description: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
plugins.description_zh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-cursor
plugins.description: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
plugins.description_zh: 非官方 Cursor 订阅聊天：Host 持有 CLI 会话登录，可编辑展示用模型目录，并显示订阅额度。Cursor 员工认定此类私有客户端用法违反 ToS。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-grok
plugins.description: xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.
plugins.description_zh: xAI Grok 订阅聊天：用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 的 OAuth 登录，选择要显示的模型子集，经 Grok CLI 代理走 Responses，并始终开启服务端 web_search 与 x_search。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama
plugins.description: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
plugins.description_zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/Qwen-MM-Plugins
plugins.description: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
plugins.description_zh: Qwen 多模态插件支持。

plugins.name: OpenTritium/dsh-codex-shim
plugins.description: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
plugins.description_zh: 为选定的模型路由模拟 Codex 环境，以提升 GPT 系列模型的工具调用成功率。

plugins.name: passingby000/dsh-nl-model-switch
plugins.description: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
plugins.description_zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

plugins.name: qjf44/dsh-plugin-thinking-api
plugins.description: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
plugins.description_zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

plugins.name: r600a-code/dsh-swarm-router
plugins.description: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.
plugins.description_zh: 子智能体矩阵蜂群：把异质任务路由到最合适的模型（OpenRouter 类网关 + cfgpu.com/llm/square），通过进程内子智能体或直接 LLM 调用下放，并按模型统计 token 消耗、用真实反馈驱动排名。

plugins.name: ringoage/dsh-subagent-model-picker
plugins.description: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
plugins.description_zh: 主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话��择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

plugins.name: SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director
plugins.description: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
plugins.description_zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

plugins.name: SnowAmberX/dsh-role-router
plugins.description: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
plugins.description_zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

plugins.name: songoao25/dsh-chatgpt-subscription
plugins.description: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
plugins.description_zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

plugins.name: stoneface10/dsh-codex-connect-plus
plugins.description: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

plugins.name: suntianc/dsh-codex-auth
plugins.description: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
plugins.description_zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

plugins.name: superboy911/dsh-model-router
plugins.description: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件：确定性关键词路由、白名单模型切换与隔离的 image_gen 生图通道。

plugins.name: superfish058/dsh-llm-proxy
plugins.description: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

plugins.name: TikaFlow/dsh-model-reasoning
plugins.description: Automatically fills in reasoning-effort levels for models from unofficial (custom) providers, with data sourced from models.dev.
plugins.description_zh: 为所有非官方（自定义）提供商的模型自动填充推理级别，数据来自 models.dev。

plugins.name: upJiang/dsh-ccswitch
plugins.description: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.
plugins.description_zh: 将 CC Switch 中的 provider 和模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 provider 筛选和模型名称搜索。

plugins.name: V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions
plugins.description: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
plugins.description_zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

plugins.name: wenheguo2/dsh-delegation-suite
plugins.description: Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.
plugins.description_zh: 智能委派套件：按角色路由最强模型、失败自动互备、每个子代理可设思考强度、名字带模型标签、支持 fork 委派与可视化路由编辑。

plugins.name: wenzetan/dsh-llm-newapi
plugins.description: NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.
plugins.description_zh: NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模���参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。

plugins.name: WJZ-P/dsh-model-capabilities
plugins.description: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

plugins.name: WNJXYK/dsh-codex-oauth
plugins.description: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

plugins.name: WSL043/dsh-codex-subscription
plugins.description: Built-in ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models, selectable subscription web search, backend quota for standard Codex and Spark, and a DSH settings UI; no API key or separate Codex installation required.
plugins.description_zh: 内置 ChatGPT OAuth 的 Codex 模型提供方：可切换订阅联网搜索，在设置页显示普通 Codex 与 Spark 独立额度；无需 API Key，也不需要另装 Codex。

plugins.name: wss534857356/dsh-plugin-codex
plugins.description: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
plugins.description_zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

plugins.name: xiaozhe7772222/dsh-opencode-zen
plugins.description: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
plugins.description_zh: 0元接入6个免费大模型，免注册免充值，内置6个免费模型，多Key轮换与限流退避。

plugins.name: zeng6125-rgb/dsh-llm-retry-settings
plugins.description: Settings card to tune the DSH LLM auto-retry policy (retry count, backoff, jitter) live from Settings → General.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 设置里调整 LLM 自动重试的次数与退避时间并实时生效的设置卡片。

plugins.name: AgentConnect/dsh-awiki
plugins.description: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于开放协议ANP的原生身份，以及基于该身份的私聊、群聊、邮件和智能体间通信能力。

plugins.name: 23swccp/dsh-undo#bundle-rollback
plugins.description: Conversation undo: roll a session back to before any sent prompt via /undo, the session-header button, or the icon under the message, restoring files from a plugin-private shadow-Git snapshot and forking the conversation so the model never sees the reverted turns; includes an Archive Tasks settings page and per-tool colored tool cards.
plugins.description_zh: 对话撤销：通过 /undo、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标把会话回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前，文件由插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复、会话 fork 成新分支，模型看不到被回滚的回合；附带归档任务设置页与工具卡片按类型着色。

plugins.name: 3403473060/dsh-inline-images
plugins.description: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
plugins.description_zh: 对话内联图片：LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径在消息正文直接渲染为图片（9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸）。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-archived-conversations
plugins.description: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.
plugins.description_zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

plugins.name: Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind
plugins.description: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
plugins.description_zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger ��滚会话与工作区状态。

plugins.name: anweat/dsh-assistant-message-forge
plugins.description: Create/modify/inject test assistant messages and import/repair session.jsonl(.zstd) session logs into new sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 消息锻造台：创建/修改/注入测试用 assistant 消息，导入识别并安全修复 session.jsonl(.zstd) 会话日志为新会话。

plugins.name: Asianfleet/dsh-message-copy-enhance
plugins.description: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
plugins.description_zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

plugins.name: azure5100/huahua-dsh-record-replay
plugins.description: Full-featured record & replay for DSH (works on Windows) from the huahua plugin series: replay every auto-recorded session as a readable timeline, export/import shareable replay packs, re-run conversations in a fresh session, and record screen operations to auto-generate installable SKILL.md skills. Includes a 4-file Windows adaptation of kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay for DSH rc.5 (see README derivative notice).
plugins.description_zh: 功能完整的 DSH 录制回放插件（huahua 出品，Windows 实测可用）：会话时间线回放、回放包导出/导入、复刻会话重新执行、录屏自动生成可安装技能。基于 kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay 做 4 处 Windows/rc.5 适配（见 README 衍生声明）。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-session-mover
plugins.description: Move a session to another workspace by dragging it onto the target workspace header in the sidebar: the session is cloned with full history into the target workspace and the original is archived.
plugins.description_zh: 在侧边栏把会话直接拖到其他工作区的标题行即可移动：目标工作区生成携带完整历史的新会话，原会话归档。

plugins.name: baixianger/dsh-chat
plugins.description: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

plugins.name: beijingwahw/dsh-companion
plugins.description: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).
plugins.description_zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

plugins.name: bill9109/dsh-conversation-share
plugins.description: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 分享任意段落的对话。

plugins.name: Boliban/dsh-enter-customizer
plugins.description: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
plugins.description_zh: 接管聊天输入框的回车等快捷键，每个快捷键的行为都能单独配置。

plugins.name: Buyi-wsgzg/dsh-sidechain
plugins.description: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
plugins.description_zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

plugins.name: bwndlct/dsh-session-export
plugins.description: Export the current session to portable, schema-versioned Markdown and JSON files via the `session_export` tool and slash commands, with cross-platform-safe filenames.
plugins.description_zh: 把当前会话导出为可移植、带 schema 版本的 Markdown 与 JSON 文件，提供 `session_export` 工具与斜杠命令两种入口，文件名跨平台安全。

plugins.name: caoqinnan-web/organize-workspace-sessions
plugins.description: Organize DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions by renaming them as 类别｜主题 and reporting archive, rename, and review suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 整理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区会话，按 类别｜主题 重命名并给出归档、改名与待判断建议。

plugins.name: CH4ACKO3/bites-the-dsh
plugins.description: Adds read-only, scriptable playback to native DSH conversations, with simulated user typing, forward and reverse playback, event stepping, speed control, idle-gap compression, and direct seeking by event, turn, or recorded time.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 原生会话加入完全只读、可脚本控制的历史回放，支持模拟用户输入、正放与倒放、逐事件移动、变速、空闲间隔压缩，以及按事件、轮次或记录时间直接跳转。

plugins.name: Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything
plugins.description: Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.
plugins.description_zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

plugins.name: chenproton/dsh-history
plugins.description: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
plugins.description_zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

plugins.name: Chinesezjc/dsh-interconnect
plugins.description: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.
plugins.description_zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-branch-review
plugins.description: Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.
plugins.description_zh: 为相关 DSH 会话分支记录人工决策：保留、淘汰或待跟进，并保存理由、标签与外部链接。

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-fork-diff
plugins.description: Read-only side-by-side comparison of related DeepSeek Harness conversation histories, including messages, tool calls, responses, timing, and usage.
plugins.description_zh: 只读并排比较相关 DeepSeek Harness 会话历史，展示消息、工具调用、回答、耗时和 usage 差异。

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-fork-graph
plugins.description: Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.
plugins.description_zh: 会话标题栏内联的 Git 风格 fork 血缘图：用彩色轨道与分叉曲线显示会话从何处分支，并可点击跳转。

plugins.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-local-share
plugins.description: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
plugins.description_zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

plugins.name: cindyguyuehu123/dsh-webchatlike
plugins.description: Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).
plugins.description_zh: 更贴近 deepseek 网页版/App 的聊天体验：原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、每条消息带 <i/N> 版本翻页器（树状版本模型，跨对话保持稳定）。

plugins.name: Coprexist/dsh-session-recovery
plugins.description: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 从原始磁盘恢复被删除或损坏的 dsh 会话（session.jsonl.zstd）与记忆库（memory.db），并通过 web 界面中的 /session-repair 命令修复重建后无法续接的会话。

plugins.name: czm15053/dsh-peer-link
plugins.description: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
plugins.description_zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-projection-guard
plugins.description: Guards the persisted session-projection cache: per-row JSON degradation so one misbehaving projection unit (e.g. a third-party plugin storing a Map) can never stall session titles or the whole cache again, plus a startup self-heal that backfills missing titles.
plugins.description_zh: 会话投影缓存守卫：逐行 JSON 降级，单个违规投影单元（如第三方插件存储 Map）不再拖垮会��标题与整个缓存；启动自愈自动补全缺失标题。

plugins.name: dongsheng123132/task-passport
plugins.description: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
plugins.description_zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

plugins.name: dream12347/dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 会话管理插件：删除（回收站可恢复或彻底清除）、恢复归档会话、活动统计、继续/暂停、打开日志目录、未读标记、新聊天中继续、工作区分组与排序、上下文压缩阈值设置。

plugins.name: dylan121322/dsh-session-unarchive
plugins.description: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

plugins.name: EvilIrving/dsh-context-proxy
plugins.description: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.
plugins.description_zh: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。

plugins.name: feiertu/dsh-input-rewriter
plugins.description: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched and keeping multi-part questions numbered.
plugins.description_zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话自动改写成更容易得到好答案的样子；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

plugins.name: flow2dream/dsh-msg-rewind
plugins.description: Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.
plugins.description_zh: 对话回退：/undo 回退一轮，/rewind 回退到历史消息，悬浮用户气泡可可视化撤回。

plugins.name: fredalxin/dsh-solo-thinking
plugins.description: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
plugins.description_zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

plugins.name: Frog755/dsh-client-auto-retry
plugins.description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning and a settings card; it never switches models or providers.
plugins.description_zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、连续次数上限、启动扫描与设置卡片；不切换模型/provider。

plugins.name: GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message
plugins.description: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

plugins.name: hajimimaodie8/DSH-Session-Sync
plugins.description: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.
plugins.description_zh: 双向同步网页版与 DSH Desktop 桌面版之间的会话、工作区、设置与插件。

plugins.name: heartmove/dsh-side-chat
plugins.description: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
plugins.description_zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

plugins.name: hellodigua/dsh-share
plugins.description: Share your conversations with one click.
plugins.description_zh: Share your conversations with one click.

plugins.name: hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Delete conversations with a confirmation dialog and manage archived sessions (archive/unarchive) in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中删除对话（二次确认），并管理归档会话（移入/移出归档）。

plugins.name: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-session-import
plugins.description: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
plugins.description_zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

plugins.name: HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-incognito
plugins.description: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
plugins.description_zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

plugins.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#search
plugins.description: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

plugins.name: i1j/context-assembler-DSH
plugins.description: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文汇编插件：话题块上下文汇编、水位压力话题切割、工具轮压缩/改写、reality 召回注入与 handoff 规划。

plugins.name: ishuowang/dsh-rolehub-bridge
plugins.description: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.
plugins.description_zh: 发现并校验可移植的 RoleHub 角色，固定其精确 bundle，再将提示词和随角色打包的 Skills 加载到独立、可续聊的 DSH Session，以 Host 批准的工具绑定限制能力，并可选接入 Agent Team Room。

plugins.name: ishuowang/dsh-sideband
plugins.description: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.
plugins.description_zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

plugins.name: jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager
plugins.description: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-crosstalk
plugins.description: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/session-titler
plugins.description: Two-phase session captioning: instant keyword titles while the conversation is busy, then cheapest-budget-model refinement plus a one-line summary once it goes idle.
plugins.description_zh: 两阶段会话题词：会话进行中即时关键词题名，空闲后再调用最经济的预算模型精修，并附带一句话摘要。

plugins.name: kaieye/dsh-AIR
plugins.description: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

plugins.name: keepermttl/dsh-archive-viewer
plugins.description: Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 归档会话管理器：支持标题/内容搜索、标签筛选、阅读日志、恢复会话与 ZIP 导出。

plugins.name: kirkchinese/claude2dsh
plugins.description: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
plugins.description_zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

plugins.name: lacemou/dsh-session-ref
plugins.description: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

plugins.name: lamost423/dsh-trace-compare
plugins.description: Trace Compare & Live Maze: draw the agent's real exploration — main path, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, and subagent branches — on one wall-clock timeline; upload 1–2 session logs for a same-axis compare, or watch it grow live in a session tab.
plugins.description_zh: 轨迹对比与实时迷宫：把智能体真实的探索过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返点与子代理支路——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；可上传 1–2 个 session log 做同轴对比，或在会话页签里实时生长。

plugins.name: Leeminjing/dsh-messages-sanitizer
plugins.description: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
plugins.description_zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-session-search-pro
plugins.description: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-task-relay
plugins.description: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

plugins.name: limbo947/dsh-recall-plugin
plugins.description: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
plugins.description_zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

plugins.name: liuyuelintop/dsh-conversation-exporter
plugins.description: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
plugins.description_zh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

plugins.name: loonai321/dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid
