plugins.description: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的女仆鲸鱼娘人格：沉浸式扮演（称呼/自称/说话方式）、防出戏规则，以及借鉴 ALTM 的轻量分层记忆与按需召回。

plugins.name: lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete
plugins.description: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache, and workspace accounting.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-chinese-thinking
plugins.description: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
plugins.description_zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

plugins.name: mayf3/dsh-session-doctor
plugins.description: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager
plugins.description: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

plugins.name: MingoZhou/dsh-replay
plugins.description: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
plugins.description_zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

plugins.name: Moeblack/dsh-message-edit
plugins.description: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
plugins.description_zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

plugins.name: Moeblack/dsh-prompt-studio
plugins.description: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
plugins.description_zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

plugins.name: mrzhangkris/dsh-session-pruner
plugins.description: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

plugins.name: MuWinds/dsh-archived-sessions
plugins.description: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
plugins.description_zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

plugins.name: Nothree-code/review-quote-sh
plugins.description: Message review and quote chips for conversations: multi-model cross review (code/reply) with severity grading and summaries, review history, and host-persisted preferences.
plugins.description_zh: 对话消息审查与引用：多模型并行互审（代码/回复审查、严重度分级、综合汇总）、引用问答胶囊、评审历史与偏好记忆。

plugins.name: Nwflower/dsh-chat-import
plugins.description: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
plugins.description_zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

plugins.name: Nwflower/dsh-file-claim
plugins.description: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
plugins.description_zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

plugins.name: p2coder/dsh-task-control
plugins.description: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.
plugins.description_zh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

plugins.name: penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks
plugins.description: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
plugins.description_zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-claude-move
plugins.description: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
plugins.description_zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-session-pin
plugins.description: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
plugins.description_zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

plugins.name: PwnKY/dsh-session-link
plugins.description: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
plugins.description_zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

plugins.name: reinocheong/dsh-session-move
plugins.description: Move a session to another folder from the Web UI via drag & drop or a menu picker, permanently delete a session with a risk-consent dialog, and AI-rename a session by summarizing the whole conversation (typo-aware). Each action also ships as an agent tool.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 侧边栏把会话移动到别的文件夹（拖拽或菜单选择），带风险确认地永久删除会话，以及 AI 重命名会话（总结整个对话并自动纠正错别字）；每个操作都提供 agent 工具。

plugins.name: Relethe/dsh-brief-session-title
plugins.description: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

plugins.name: Renzic-Stone/DSH-EasyRewrite
plugins.description: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
plugins.description_zh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

plugins.name: Ricketts-Guo/dsh-off-peak-message#dsh-offpeak-send
plugins.description: Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.
plugins.description_zh: 谷时发送调度器：开启谷时模式后输入框消息排队至 DeepSeek 谷时窗口（半价）自动注入会话并得到回复。原生外观输入条、快捷键（Enter 入队 / ⌘+Enter 立即发送 / Esc 退出）、按会话记忆的开关，重启不丢。

plugins.name: RyensX/dsh-message-fold
plugins.description: Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的会话消息折叠。

plugins.name: SaiSenBox/dsh-prompt-manager
plugins.description: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
plugins.description_zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面���收藏与 JSON 备份。

plugins.name: Semidia/dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
plugins.description_zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

plugins.name: SiriLee/dsh-rewind
plugins.description: In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.
plugins.description_zh: 同一会话窗口内的 in-place 对话回退（不 fork，Claude Code /rewind 语义）：每条消息的 ↶ 按钮把模型上下文回退到任意用户消息，可选用磁盘持久化的 before-backups 还原工作区文件。

plugins.name: sjh9714/dsh-what-changed
plugins.description: Reviews every file the agent wrote in a session from the session header, with per-file hunks and refused writes counted apart from changes.
plugins.description_zh: 在会话顶栏审阅本次会话 Agent 写过的所有文件，按文件列出逐处改动，被权限拒绝的写入单独计数不算改动。

plugins.name: SLin-code/dsh-task-notice-board
plugins.description: Task-scoped Workspace to Task to Session control center for DSH Web, with Session boards, archived conversation viewing, and bounded long-term memory shared across linked Sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH Web 的任务级 Workspace 到 Task 到 Session 协作控制台，提供 Session 看板、归档对话查看，以及在关联 Session 之间共享的有界长期记忆。

plugins.name: snow-The/dsh-session-handoff
plugins.description: Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).
plugins.description_zh: 会话交接与上下文管理：导出/恢复结构化交接文档，让新会话无缝续接；并集成了主动上下文裁剪（acp_* 工具，基于官方 compaction API 与模型自写摘要）。

plugins.name: SocFeng/dsh-query-jump
plugins.description: DSH WebUI session query navigation with a faint conversation-edge rail, a hover list of real user queries, and click-to-jump back to the matching bubble.
plugins.description_zh: DSH WebUI 会话提问导航：对话区右缘淡色短横线，悬停列出真实用户提问，点击跳回对应气泡。

plugins.name: starslittle/dsh-queue-plus
plugins.description: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

plugins.name: Sttrevens/dsh-linked-folders
plugins.description: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
plugins.description_zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

plugins.name: tmpdot/dsh-checkpoint-diff
plugins.description: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
plugins.description_zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

plugins.name: Totoro-qaq/dsh-plugin-bridge
plugins.description: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.
plugins.description_zh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。

plugins.name: tsingshitao-nuke/dsh-set-workspace
plugins.description: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
plugins.description_zh: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

plugins.name: tuogusa/dsh-session-nav
plugins.description: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.
plugins.description_zh: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转；悬浮弹出/移出平滑关闭。

plugins.name: tuogusa/dsh-session-tags
plugins.description: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

plugins.name: txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.
plugins.description_zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除」项，经二次确认后硬删除该会话。

plugins.name: Ultronen/dsh-archived-chats
plugins.description: Archived Chats settings page for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, filter, tag, annotate, measure storage, export and preview-first import of versioned JSON/Markdown ZIP backups, restore non-conflicting archives, unarchive, and delete sessions by workspace, including live sessions without a restart.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 已归档聊天设置页：按工作区浏览、搜索和筛选会话，添加标签与备注，查看存储统计，导出并预览导入带版本的 JSON/Markdown ZIP 备份，恢复无冲突归档，取消归档和删除会话，包括无需重启即可删除仍在后台运行的会话。

plugins.name: WenhongPan/dsh-projects
plugins.description: Project and session organization with multi-folder groups, attention summaries, grouped chat search, native folder picking, pinning, favorites, ordering, and an archive center.
plugins.description_zh: 项目与会话整理工具：支持多文件夹组合、待处理状态摘要、分组聊天搜索、原生目录选择、置顶、收藏、排序和归档中心。

plugins.name: whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-session-export
plugins.description: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
plugins.description_zh: 把 append-only 会话日志导出为按轨迹来源分组的可读 Markdown 或 HTML。

plugins.name: Wine-Red/dsh-prompt-stash
plugins.description: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
plugins.description_zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

plugins.name: wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-idle-archive
plugins.description: Idle session reminder: prompts to archive sessions untouched for N hours, with a snooze window after each refusal, using the official archiveSession API.
plugins.description_zh: 会话闲置提醒：超过 N 小时未对话的会话弹窗询问是否归档，拒绝后进入静默期；归档走官方 archiveSession 接口。

plugins.name: wpc0323/deepseek-web-import
plugins.description: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
plugins.description_zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

plugins.name: WSL043/dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Adds a red permanent-delete action with a confirmation dialog to the native session menu.
plugins.description_zh: 在原生会话菜单中增加红色永久删除操作，并在删除前二次确认。

plugins.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。

plugins.name: wuxiangru915/dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 会话管理插件：在设置页查���全部与已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）、二次确认删除与对话内容预览。

plugins.name: xianshu-virtuous/dsh-whale-companion
plugins.description: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.
plugins.description_zh: 接近上下文上限时自动创建新 Web 会话并只转移最后一个完整回合，同时提供可编辑的追加式鲸鱼娘人格与按需重读工具。

plugins.name: xiaoshenming/dsh-session-surgeon
plugins.description: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.
plugins.description_zh: 修好打不开的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，侧栏「会话医生」可查看对话并默认 dry-run 修复。

plugins.name: xing666173/dsh-bridge-preview
plugins.description: Inline image previews in chat for pasted images bridged by dsh-tool-vision on text-only models (click to zoom, old messages get previews too).
plugins.description_zh: 在对话气泡中内联显示 dsh-tool-vision 桥接的粘贴图片,点击可放大,旧消息也会自动补上预览。

plugins.name: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-session-actions
plugins.description: Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

plugins.name: xohmai/dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.
plugins.description_zh: 真正删除会话：回收站可还原、归档清理、设置页批量删除。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-session-export
plugins.description: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.
plugins.description_zh: 会话导出为 Markdown/JSON，便于复盘、重放与单会话成本汇总。

plugins.name: YeqingTang/dsh-session-flow
plugins.description: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + header chip (stall detection). Settings dialog section with 7 tunable behavior params.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与头部芯片（疑似卡死识别）。设置弹窗独立分节，7 项行为参数可调。

plugins.name: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-session-hotkeys
plugins.description: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename, navigation mode, search focus), all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets.
plugins.description_zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、导航模式、聚焦搜索，键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。

plugins.name: yoza10635/dsh-argp
plugins.description: Deterministic context compaction: prunes conversation atoms in reference-graph topological order with no LLM calls during compaction, and keeps pruned atoms recallable by marker.
plugins.description_zh: 确定性上下文压缩：按引用图拓扑序摘除对话原子，压缩阶段不调用 LLM；被摘除的原子保留 marker，可按需回拉。

plugins.name: yuezengwu/dsh-explain
plugins.description: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
plugins.description_zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-period-report
plugins.description: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
plugins.description_zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

plugins.name: zljr/dsh-share
plugins.description: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
plugins.description_zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-shelf
plugins.description: Session lifecycle CLI: export (md/json/jsonl), archive/restore, trash, search, and stats. Read-only by default; nothing is ever deleted by the engine.
plugins.description_zh: 会话生命周期 CLI：导出（md/json/jsonl）、归档/恢复、回收站、搜索与统计。默认只读；引擎从不删除任何东西。

plugins.name: ZRui-C/dsh-minimal-first-turn
plugins.description: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
plugins.description_zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

plugins.name: 00080000/dsh-project-memory
plugins.description: Project memory for DeepSeek Harness: project files are indexed into searchable summaries as they are read, so after context loss the agent retrieves hits on demand instead of re-reading files, with source citations and BM25 ranking.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的项目记忆插件：项目文件在读取时索引为可检索摘要，上下文失效后按需检索命中，无需重读文件，自带出处与 BM25 排序。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-memory-setup
plugins.description: Local, auditable personal memory for DeepSeek Harness: preferences, project conventions, workflows and error lessons persisted as a changelogged JSON file in the workspace, with onboarding, auto project-convention extraction and evidence-backed lessons.
plugins.description_zh: 解决 AI 金鱼���：本地可审计的个人记忆层——偏好、项目约定、工作流与纠错教训，以带变更日志与完整性校验的 JSON 持久化在工作区，支持一次性设置、项目约定自动提取、证据化教训与快照恢复。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-focus
plugins.description: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

plugins.name: aerince/dsh-active-context-pruning
plugins.description: Model-authored context pruning for DeepSeek Harness through the official compaction API.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型驱动上下文裁剪插件，通过官方 compaction API 释放上下文空间。

plugins.name: Aik358/dsh-auto-memory
plugins.description: Cache-friendly three-layer memory for DSH: lean auto injection, per-turn AI consolidation, proactive calendar reminders and warm greetings, plus memory inheritance from other AI tools.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 三层自动记忆引擎：缓存友好的精简注入与每轮 AI 自动沉淀，主动日历提醒与暖心问候，可继承其他 AI 工具的记忆。

plugins.name: akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger
plugins.description: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
plugins.description_zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

plugins.name: AndyYang12345/dsh-butler-memory
plugins.description: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
plugins.description_zh: PostgreSQL 持久���人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

plugins.name: aqsk-BLG/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

plugins.name: Asher-2000/dsh-memory-connect
plugins.description: Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.3.0): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. Zero-config.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话记忆插件 (v0.3.0)：自动提取、SQLite FTS5 索引、RRF 语义召回、定时维护、LLM 智能合并（自动接入 ctx.llm）、上下文爆炸防护、全局身份 Soul（~/.dsh/soul.md）。零配置。

plugins.name: baaai123/dsh-memory-protocol
plugins.description: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
plugins.description_zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

plugins.name: CeilCelia/dsh-eli-mode#packages/eli-mode
plugins.description: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
plugins.description_zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

plugins.name: Co-Engram/Co-Engram#dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
plugins.description_zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code��MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-memories
plugins.description: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search model tools and JSON-file storage.
plugins.description_zh: 项目作用域持久化键值记忆：set/get/list/delete/search 模型工具，JSON 文件存储。

plugins.name: detongz/dsh-client-ui-obsidian-memory
plugins.description: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
plugins.description_zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

plugins.name: diqierjia/StrataGate-AgentMemory#deepseek-harness
plugins.description: Automatic, local-first cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: remembers user preferences, project decisions, conversations, and tool results; verifies recalled information against original messages before answering.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自动本地跨会话记忆：记住用户偏好、项目决策、历史对话与工具结果；回答前检查证据，并可追溯到原始消息。

plugins.name: FleetingEcho/dsh-handoff
plugins.description: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
plugins.description_zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

plugins.name: flymysql/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

plugins.name: freehul/sgme
plugins.description: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
plugins.description_zh: 拾光记��引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

plugins.name: FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory
plugins.description: AGI long-term memory base: multi-agent spatiotemporal memory graph, self-evolving knowledge flywheel, self-cognition, and auditable trust guardrails.
plugins.description_zh: AGI长期记忆基础：多智能体时空记忆图谱、自进化知识飞轮、自我认知与可审计的信任护栏。

plugins.name: gezi-wen/sage-mem
plugins.description: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
plugins.description_zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

plugins.name: GIT121995/dsh-memory-gate
plugins.description: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
plugins.description_zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

plugins.name: giter00/dsh-headroom
plugins.description: Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自动上下文压缩插件：在工具输出进入模型前压缩，并通过 CCR 检索工具保持所有有损压缩可逆。

plugins.name: hellosky983/dsh-qrcode
plugins.description: Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 离线二维码（SVG/PNG/ASCII）��条码（Code128/EAN-13）生成器，无网络、无 shell。

plugins.name: hellosky983/dsh-skillradar
plugins.description: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 扫描当前会话可见的技能，按与最近对话的相关性排序推荐。

plugins.name: highland0971/dsh-native-memory
plugins.description: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

plugins.name: htcqp802/dsh-knowledge-base
plugins.description: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

plugins.name: Hua1Q1nG/dsh-hindsight-local-optimize
plugins.description: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 桌面端官方 Hindsight 插件补齐本地记忆生命周期：一键启停 hindsight-embed 守护进程、开机自启、退出随停、隐藏 uv.exe 黑框，并支持把档案柜与模型装到其它盘。

plugins.name: Hua1Q1nG/dsh-prompt-self
plugins.description: Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.
plugins.description_zh: 按学习到的 Prompt 画像改写每个请求，并自动更新习惯清单、防幻觉规则与学习记录。

plugins.name: ICCuse/dsh-file-memory
plugins.description: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.
plugins.description_zh: 文件型工作记忆：memorize/recall 把关键前提逐字保存在会话笔记文件，无损挺过上下文压缩。

plugins.name: ICCuse/dsh-knowledge
plugins.description: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
plugins.description_zh: 全局知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex 共享的 D:\knowledge（格式逐字节兼容）。

plugins.name: ICCuse/dsh-premise-guard
plugins.description: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
plugins.description_zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。

plugins.name: Ikalus1988/MisakaNet
plugins.description: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
plugins.description_zh: 失败恢复记忆库：从真实工程会话中搜索和记录失败恢复教训，支持 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和知识库管理。

plugins.name: isheng-eqi/dsh-hermes-memory
plugins.description: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

plugins.name: itr-del/dsh-cue-bank
plugins.description: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
plugins.description_zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（���键词或向量匹配）。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

plugins.name: jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria
plugins.description: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
plugins.description_zh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

plugins.name: jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria-extra
plugins.description: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.
plugins.description_zh: memoria 进阶工具：会话上下文注入（画像+召回）、近期决策、健康报告、命名空间白名单、记忆关系图与实体搜索；dsh-memoria 的伴生插件。

plugins.name: jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-memory
plugins.description: BM25 keyword-based memory recall.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 BM25 关键词检索的记忆召回。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/context-pruner
plugins.description: Session context triage for long DeepSeek Harness sessions: deterministic screeners trim stale, duplicate, failed, and oversized content through the official ctx.compaction seam.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 长会话的上下文分诊插件：通过官方 ctx.compaction 接缝，用确定性规则筛查并裁剪过期、重复、失败与超大的上下文内容。

plugins.name: JunNanLYS/dsh-layered-memory
plugins.description: Layered memory pipeline for DSH: auto-distills conversations into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile (L0–L3), with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, chat/work family separation, and context injection before each model step.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 分层记忆管线：自动把会话蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像（L0~L3），BM25 + 向量混合检索，chat/work 双族隔离，每步模型调用前注入相关上下文。

plugins.name: KLRSL/dsh-biomemory
plugins.description: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: plain-Markdown data layer, memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection, graded approval gating, structured audits, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall, /memory command, and cross-session retrieval.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：纯 Markdown 数据层、memory 工具、冻结快照注入、分级审批门、结构化审计、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、语义检索、/memory 命令与跨会话召回。

plugins.name: lanyun077/dsh-project
plugins.description: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.
plugins.description_zh: 把多个文件夹与会话收纳为「项目」，共享 PROJECT.md 记忆与 AGENTS.md 指令并注入每个会话，附带项目树侧边栏。

plugins.name: lemoncat7/dsh-knowledge
plugins.description: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
plugins.description_zh: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

plugins.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory
plugins.description: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, hard-injected at every session start, plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill and pack/unpack migration tooling.
plugins.description_zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动强制注入 boot 块，含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能与 pack/unpack 迁移工具。

plugins.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-compaction
plugins.description: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
plugins.description_zh: 压缩后端：用确定性语义提取器替�� LLM 摘要（保留代码/路径/命令，剔除闲聊），附带 28.4x KV 压缩记账。

plugins.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-memory-director
plugins.description: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
plugins.description_zh: LLM 驱动的记忆记/忘插件：每轮对话后由模型决定记住什么/忘记什么（MemoryDirector），请求前注入相关记忆，自动去重，跨会话持久化。

plugins.name: LoserFox/distill
plugins.description: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.
plugins.description_zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。

plugins.name: lovezi0/dsh-memory-palace
plugins.description: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
plugins.description_zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

plugins.name: madage/dsh-self-improved
plugins.description: Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆与自进化插件：L0 对话捕获 → L1 记忆提取 → L2 场景归纳 → L3 用户画像，自动召回注入 + 技能合成，纯本地（SQLite FTS5 + jieba，可选向量召回）。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会���明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

plugins.name: memorax-ai/dsh-patchouli
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

plugins.name: memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness#dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
plugins.description_zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

plugins.name: MineRPi/dsh-trilium
plugins.description: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

plugins.name: mingzeng21/dsh-obsidian
plugins.description: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
plugins.description_zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入��移动与回收笔记。

plugins.name: modusensus/dsh-mneme#dsh-mneme
plugins.description: Cross-session memory engine for DeepSeek Harness: SQLite store + human-editable Markdown mirror, autoDream consolidation, offline semantic search (local vector/rerank/clustering), entity-attribute-timeline, Sleep Mode, custom-model autoSummarize, and 7 memory tools.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆引擎：SQLite 存储 + 可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像、autoDream 自我巩固、离线语义搜索（本地向量/精排/聚类）、实体-属性-时间轴、Sleep Mode、autoSummarize 自定义模型，共 7 个记忆工具。

plugins.name: moononnn/DeepSeek-Harness-Hanako-Memory
plugins.description: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).
plugins.description_zh: Hana 式助手管理：可视化配置助手预设（卡片、四性格「元」、头像裁剪），并完整复刻 Hana 记忆系统（滚动摘要、分层编译、SQLite 事实库、深度记忆）。

plugins.name: nanpaidashi/dsh-honcho-sync
plugins.description: Honcho memory bridge: auto-syncs every conversation turn to a self-hosted Honcho service, with recall/search/remember/context/status tools, context injection on session start, and a visual settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: Honcho 记忆桥接：每轮对话自动同步到自建 Honcho 记忆服务（NAS/服务器/云），提供 recall/search/remember/context/status 工具，会话启动自动注入上下文，内置可视化设置面板。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-memory
plugins.description: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.
plugins.description_zh: 五层持久记忆系统：相关性注入、LLM 自动提取、画像轮替与六个 agent 工具。

plugins.name: Noelune/unified-agent-memory
plugins.description: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
plugins.description_zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗���）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

plugins.name: nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
plugins.description: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
plugins.description_zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-kb-sieve
plugins.description: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.
plugins.description_zh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon
plugins.description: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.
plugins.description_zh: 由 Mnemon 驱动的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）跨 Agent、本地优先的持久记忆插件。它可在支持 Mnemon 的 Agent 之间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可检索项目档案、语义召回、知识图谱和 Sidebar UI。

plugins.name: orangeshinee/dsh-mem0
plugins.description: Agent tools for a self-hosted mem0 server: add, search, get, update, delete, history, reset and status memories, with a settings-panel configuration card.
plugins.description_zh: 自托管 mem0 记忆读写插件：agent 直接读写自有 mem0 服务（增删查改、搜索、历史、重置、状态），并带设置面板配置卡片。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-library
plugins.description: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.
plugins.description_zh: 将本地 Markdown 与文本文档转为可检索的知识库，支持语义与关键词混合搜索、引用校验与来源注入。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-memento
plugins.description: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.
plugins.description_zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、��审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入，并预演 dsh-memory-protocol v1——适配器注册表与可分发的一致性套件。

plugins.name: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory
plugins.description: Project-scoped cross-session memory: six-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update tools, and per-window nightly consolidation ("dream").
plugins.description_zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 六层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic），首条用户消息缓存友好注入，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update 工具，按窗口夜间整理（dream）。

plugins.name: plur-ai/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory browser.
plugins.description_zh: PLUR 记忆在每次组装时渲染进系统提示词，而非以工具调用形式暴露，因此记忆块是被替换而不是追加，整段会话的上下文长度保持不变。全本地混合检索（BM25 + BGE，RRF 融合）、可直接编辑的纯 YAML 存储、按工作区划分 scope，并提供 /plur-memory 浏览器界面。

plugins.name: rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory
plugins.description: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
plugins.description_zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

plugins.name: Relistencode/dsh-recall
plugins.description: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
plugins.description_zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

plugins.name: reshuibuduo/TMCRA-Agent-Memory#deepseek-harness-local
plugins.description: Technical-preview local graph memory for DSH and Codex: recalls owner-global and current-project evidence before each turn, writes USER and ASSISTANT records separately, and preserves project, session, actor, and source provenance for a visual atlas and cited knowledge pages.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 与 Codex 的技术预览版本机图记忆：每轮前从用户全局与当前项目作用域召回证据，分别保存 USER 与 ASSISTANT 记录，并保留项目、会话、角色和来源信息，用于可视化图谱与带证据引用的知识页。

plugins.name: Rxiain/dsh-openviking
plugins.description: Semantic retrieval, resource management, auto-recall (user + agent dual spaces) and session memory for DeepSeek Harness: memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob over viking:// URIs, memadd/memremove resource management, memqueue observer status, memcommit session capture, and memlearn skill playbook minting.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 语义检索、资源管理、自动召回（user + agent 双空间）与会话记忆插件：基于 viking:// URI 的 memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob 检索工具、memadd/memremove 资源管理、memqueue 队列状态、memcommit 会话捕获，以及 memlearn 技能手册沉淀。

plugins.name: scd13150/dsh-cognition
plugins.description: Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).
plugins.description_zh: 给 DSH agent 的项目记忆:历史相似编辑作为先例出现、越界修改被 scope 锁拦下、认知跨会话持续积累(47 次上游验收修复、去 gold 化 20/20)。

plugins.name: Shiye-10Pages/dsh-memory-porter
plugins.description: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
plugins.description_zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

plugins.name: skepsun/dsh-engram
plugins.description: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
plugins.description_zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

plugins.name: SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem
plugins.description: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

plugins.name: songoao25/dsh-auto-compact
plugins.description: Enhanced auto-compaction defaults for DeepSeek Harness agent presets: apply tuned threshold/retention budgets and per-model policies with one command, idempotent with backups and rollback.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 智能体预设注入增强的自动压缩默认值：一键应用调优的触发阈值/保留比例与分模型策略，幂等执行、自动备份、可回滚。

plugins.name: symmetryseeker/dsh-akn-plugin
plugins.description: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 Agent 经验网络：从 trace 与实时 Manifest 蒸馏任务级经验，按 H0-H4 证据分级、按兼容性发现，经显式审阅后才晋升。

plugins.name: tancheng33/dsh-yogacara
plugins.description: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
plugins.description_zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

plugins.name: text2future/flowix#dsh-flowix-memory
plugins.description: Registers the local flowix-cli MCP server so the agent can search, read, create, and edit Flowix memos and mind-map artifacts.
plugins.description_zh: 将本地 flowix-cli 注册为 MCP 服务，让 agent 可以搜索、读取、创建和编辑 Flowix 备忘与思维导图产物。

plugins.name: tinqiao-oss/engramory#plugin
plugins.description: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file, readable in any editor. The `MEMORY.md` index has a hard 200-line / 25 KB cap enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that would grow an over-cap index is denied, while a rewrite that shrinks it always passes, so an oversized index can be compacted step by step. The plugin never writes memories on its own — what is kept is decided by you and the model. The same store is also used by Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
plugins.description_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，以纯 markdown 保存：一条事实一个文件，任何编辑器都能打开。索引 `MEMORY.md` 有 200 行 / 25KB 的硬上限，由 `ctx.tools.guard()` 强制执行——让已超限的索引继续变大的写入会被拒绝，而缩小它的重写一律放行，于是过大的索引可以一步步压缩下来。插件不会自行写入记忆，记什么由你和模型决定。同一个记忆库也被 Claude Code、Codex、Kiro、OpenClaw 使用。

plugins.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-recall
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
plugins.description_zh: 跨会���记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

plugins.name: Tyan66666/billion-context-dsh
plugins.description: Model-driven context compression (Active Context Pruning) for DeepSeek Harness: the model decides when and what to compress.
plugins.description_zh: 模型驱动的上下文压缩（Active Context Pruning）：由模型决定何时压缩、压缩什么。

plugins.name: vectorize-io/hindsight#coding-agents
plugins.description: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
plugins.description_zh: Hindsight：会学习的 Agent 长期记忆系统，自动召回/保存、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆银行。

plugins.name: volcengine/OpenViking#examples/dsh-memory-plugin
plugins.description: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

plugins.name: wly8691-jpg/knowlp-rag
plugins.description: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight feedback loop — via MCP.
plugins.description_zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环，以 MCP 接入。

plugins.name: XieZongChen/dsh-md-notes
plugins.description: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** ��� **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

plugins.name: Xplore-LAB/dsh-plugin-asmemory
plugins.description: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
plugins.description_zh: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Long-term memory injected at session start: preferences/facts/summaries/knowledge in global and per-project scopes, budgeted recall via `agent/pre-step`, durable JSON store.
plugins.description_zh: 会话开始自动注入的长期记忆：preference/fact/summary/knowledge 四类、global/project 双作用域，`agent/pre-step` 字节预算召回，JSON 原子持久化。

plugins.name: yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 持久记忆插件：记忆读写/检索工具、回合自动记录、项目作用域召回注入、管理界面，可非破坏导入 Claude Code 记忆。

plugins.name: Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory
plugins.description: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.
plugins.description_zh: DSH ↔ agentmemory 会话记忆桥：把会话生命周期镜像到本地 agentmemory 守护进程（REST），提供 memory_recall / memory_remember 工具，并通过 agent/pre-step 按会话注入记忆上下文窗口。

plugins.name: zhangzhenwen1/qmd-autosearch
plugins.description: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
plugins.description_zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注��下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-flomo
plugins.description: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
plugins.description_zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-notion-connector
plugins.description: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
plugins.description_zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

plugins.name: zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
plugins.description: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先持久记忆：在 pre-step 注入有预算上限的热记忆，使用精确匹配与中文二元 BM25 召回冷层，提供六个 Agent 工具，并以审批门禁、租约锁、恢复回执和只读治理与轨迹复盘候选保护写入。

plugins.name: ZSeven-W/dsh-noema
plugins.description: Long-term memory for DSH agents — durable, inspectable memories with recall, search, browse and knowledge-graph tools, import from ten other AI coding tools, and a settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供长期记忆——可检索、可检视的持久记忆，带回忆、搜索、浏览与知识图谱工具，支持从十个其他 AI 编码工具导入记忆，并附设置页。

plugins.name: 1na-ko/dsh-hdc-bridge
plugins.description: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
plugins.description_zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

plugins.name: 6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace
plugins.description: Add a WSL workspace from the web GUI without needing to install dsh or related tools again inside WSL. Bash commands and file read/write operations run within the local WSL distribution on the host machine, while Windows files remain accessible.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web GUI 添加 WSL 工作区，无需在 WSL 之中再次安装 dsh 以及相关工具，bash 命令与文件读写运行在本机 WSL 发行版内，Windows 文件仍可访问。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-academic-writing
plugins.description: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-education
plugins.description: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data
plugins.description: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-local-life
plugins.description: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-translation
plugins.description: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

plugins.name: 988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-computer-use
plugins.description: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
plugins.description_zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

plugins.name: AbcdefgXW/dsh-toolbox-web
plugins.description: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
plugins.description_zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

plugins.name: AbnerAI/dsh-monitor
plugins.description: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
plugins.description_zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

plugins.name: acebang0303/dsh-quick-launch
plugins.description: One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.
plugins.description_zh: 一键创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式，图标可自定义上传切换，蓝白金鲸���悬浮按钮可拖动，点击旋转 90° 弹出面板。

plugins.name: agentmail-to/dsh-agentmail
plugins.description: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
plugins.description_zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

plugins.name: alone-tree/dsh-skill-mcp-manager
plugins.description: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
plugins.description_zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

plugins.name: AngelosZou/dsh-multi-folder
plugins.description: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

plugins.name: AngLi1997/dsh-plugin-sync
plugins.description: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
plugins.description_zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

plugins.name: Anionex/dsh-computer-use
plugins.description: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
plugins.description_zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

plugins.name: annexwu/dsh-cos
plugins.description: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
plugins.description_zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工��区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: anyuer678/dsh-logtimeline
plugins.description: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.
plugins.description_zh: 用中文自然语言时间描述查询本地日志（如「昨天下午」「3小时前」）——精确时间范围、匹配行、级别统计，完全离线。

plugins.name: Asher-2000/dsh-expert-mode
plugins.description: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.6.0, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 11 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. Features: Five-Anchor constraint (review/convergence/anti-drift/collaboration-check/resource-awareness per turn), Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert), progressive disclosure (28% token savings), expert persistence, cross-expert communication protocol, cross review, experience pool, fast-track for simple tasks, fault recovery with auto-retry. Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance.
plugins.description_zh: 专家模式 agent preset（v0.6.0，双语双份）：首席协调官 + 11 位领域专家子代理，按任务特性自动委派。特性：五锚约束（每轮回顾/收敛/反跑题/协作检查/资源感知自检）+ 近距离引导（身份/任务/输出格式模板）+ 渐进式披露（token 减少 28%）+ 专家持久化 + 专家间通信协议 + 交叉评审 + 经验沉淀 + 快速通道 + 故障恢复。专家：数据分析/文案/法务/产品/前端/UI-UX/架构/社交运营/增长/量化/财务。

plugins.name: buhuikongpan/dsh-win-gitbash
plugins.description: Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

plugins.name: bwndlct/dsh-session-audit
plugins.description: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
plugins.description_zh: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

plugins.name: bx33661/dsh-omv
plugins.description: Evidence-first vulnerability research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: native audit views, 29 OMV tools, Evidence.v1 findings, reproducible runs, Campaign workflows, and isolated PoC evidence.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先漏洞研究工作台：原生审计视图、29 个 OMV 工具、Evidence.v1 Finding、可复现 Run、Campaign 工作流和隔离 PoC 证据。

plugins.name: caoyiwei850/dsh-ssh-ops
plugins.description: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
plugins.description_zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

plugins.name: cerebrixos-org/dsh-asimovbox
plugins.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 API 密钥认证的工具将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 AsimovBox，用于创建、更新、渲染和完成视频。

plugins.name: changingwang/dsh-stage-gate
plugins.description: Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.
plugins.description_zh: 阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。

plugins.name: Chaos-Hyper/dsh-econ-tools
plugins.description: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
plugins.description_zh: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、��健性检验与结果报告。

plugins.name: Cheng-cheng9669/dsh-cache-precision
plugins.description: Renders the built-in cache-hit percentage with three decimals and widens the composer stats line to prevent truncation.
plugins.description_zh: 把内置缓存命中率原位显示为 3 位小数，并加宽底部统计行避免内容被截断。

plugins.name: CheshireJCat/blender
plugins.description: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
plugins.description_zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

plugins.name: Chhlafiu4312/dsh-mcp-bridge
plugins.description: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

plugins.name: chiang21fcb/cn-linebreak
plugins.description:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.
plugins.description_zh:
中文网页文案断行静态审查与修复工具：检查显式
孤字行、keep-all 覆盖、标点禁则、保护词被拆等问题，并在自然停顿处自动插入 ；提供 cn_linebreak_audit 工具供代理调用。

plugins.name: CHplus0/dsh-learning-mode#plugin
plugins.description: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
plugins.description_zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

plugins.name: CHplus0/dsh-shell-command
plugins.description: Claude Code-style shell integration: /! for single-command analysis and /terminal for interactive PTY sessions with on-demand history reference.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格的 shell 集成：/! 单命令分析 与 /terminal 交互式终端（带按需历史引用）。

plugins.name: ClaireXi99/dsh-data-insight
plugins.description: Data analysis toolkit: CSV/TSV/JSON profiling, IQR and z-score anomaly detection, structured summarization with quality issues, and code-free filter/group/aggregate queries.
plugins.description_zh: 数据分析工具包：CSV/TSV/JSON 数据画像、IQR 与 z-score 异常检测、带质量问题提示的结构化摘要、以及无需写代码的筛选/分组/聚合查询。

plugins.name: coolbreezecoin/dsh-wechat-mp
plugins.description: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
plugins.description_zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

plugins.name: CZX2244/dsh-bilibili
plugins.description: Bilibili video analysis: metadata, transcript (ASR fallback via Bijian/sherpa-onnx/whisper.cpp), comments, danmaku, and sharp keyframes with optional local vision descriptions.
plugins.description_zh: B站视频分析工具：提取元数据、字幕文稿（必剪/本地 ASR 兜底）、评论与弹幕，抓取清晰关键帧并可选本地视觉描述。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-client-v2
plugins.description: Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 客户端增强：分页工具发现、非阻塞启动、mcp_tool_search 搜索，自研 stdio/streamable-http 传输。

plugins.name: DeepTrial/dsh-bash-rtk
plugins.description: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
plugins.description_zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

plugins.name: dfycaly98931680/dsh-trajectory-governance
plugins.description: Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 轨迹治理与异常诊断：把平铺会话日志重建为多分支轨迹树，识别循环死锁/无效重试/目标漂移，带成本归因的告警与一键中断/断点分支（官方 API），独立 GUI Tab。

plugins.name: dhicoc/dsh-codex-web-search-mcp
plugins.description: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
plugins.description_zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins/dsh-auxiliary
plugins.description: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
plugins.description_zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

plugins.name: duhu2000/qcc-mcp-legal-oauth
plugins.description: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
plugins.description_zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

plugins.name: duhu2000/qcc-mcp-oauth
plugins.description: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
plugins.description_zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入��查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

plugins.name: Edge-Echo/dsh-mcp-bridge
plugins.description: Curated MCP server bundle: one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, plus a connectivity verifier tool and CI checks.
plugins.description_zh: 精选 MCP 服务器全家桶：一键接入演示、记忆、文件系统、GitHub、Playwright、远程 HTTP 等服务器，自带连通性验证工具与 CI 检查。

plugins.name: EdgeTypE/dsh-better-deepseek
plugins.description: Bridge plugin for the [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome extension: exposes HTTP handshake and session-filtered SSE event streams over the web server, enabling browser-extension UI integrations with DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.description_zh: [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。

plugins.name: Fantasality/dsh-origin-plugin
plugins.description: Drive Origin scientific plotting from DeepSeek Harness AI chat via MCP: write data, plot line/scatter/column, export PNG/SVG.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话里驱动 Origin 科学绘图：写数据、折线/散点/柱状图，导出 PNG/SVG。

plugins.name: fire-disposal/dsh-mojibake-interceptor
plugins.description: Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

plugins.name: Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: One-click prompt enhancement: an independent LLM call rewrites your rough draft in the composer, fully undoable.
plugins.description_zh: 一键提示词增强：独立 LLM 调用把模糊草稿改写为更强的提示词，不满意可撤回。

plugins.name: flymysql/dsh-remote
plugins.description: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools. The picker is a centered modal that opens on the local tab and auto-fills `/` for remote paths, live-completing each directory level.
plugins.description_zh: 多机远程工作区：管理多台 SSH 主机，在原生「添加工作区」流程里选本机系统文件夹或远程目录，把远程工作区镜像成真实本地文件夹并用 rw_* 工具操作。选择器是居中弹窗，默认落在本机页签，远程路径自动预填 `/` 并逐级自动补全目录。

plugins.name: Fro2en12/dsh-download-progress
plugins.description: Download progress panel: URL downloader, agent shell/SSH transfer tracking and workspace black-box file-growth monitoring, shown in a draggable floating panel with live bytes, speed, percentage and ETA.
plugins.description_zh: 下载进度面板：URL 下载器、agent shell/SSH 传输追踪与工作区黑箱文件增长监控，汇聚到可拖拽浮窗实时显示字节、速度、百分比与预计剩余时间。

plugins.name: geml-spec/geml#integrations/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
plugins.description_zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

plugins.name: Github-CJX/dsh-tool-imagegen
plugins.description: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.
plugins.description_zh: 对话内联生图插件：模型在对话框直接出图，可基于参考图或上次生成结果连续图生图修改，附存储清理。

plugins.name: goecho/dsh-generation
plugins.description: Adds generation_fork and generation_run to copy an agent preset and run a task on a new session.
plugins.description_zh: 提供 generation_fork 与 generation_run，用于拷贝 Agent preset 并在新会话上跑任务。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-repo-setup
plugins.description: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
plugins.description_zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

plugins.name: hanyi7867069-create/dsh-content-lab
plugins.description: Content workshop tools for DSH — topic, title, post and content-calendar generation through the built-in LLM.
plugins.description_zh: 内容工坊——选题、标题、文案与排期生成工具，直接调用内置 LLM。

plugins.name: hccccc01333/dsh-excel-chat#bundle
plugins.description: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

plugins.name: heartleo/hn-cli#hacker-news
plugins.description: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
plugins.description_zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

plugins.name: Hefulalala/dsh-remote-workspace
plugins.description: SSH/SFTP remote sites and workspaces: manage connections and remote directories like local workspaces.
plugins.description_zh: SSH/SFTP 远程站点与远程工作区：像本地工作区一样管理远程连接与目录。

plugins.name: hezhongtang/dsh-capability-optimizer
plugins.description: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
plugins.description_zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头��用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

plugins.name: Hongcheng-LI/dsh-zotero
plugins.description: Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key): search items/collections, read metadata and abstracts, list attachments, read full text (parses PDFs on the fly when Zotero cache misses), download PDFs, and manage notes.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key）操作文献库：检索条目/分类、读元数据与摘要、列附件、读全文（缓存未命中时现场解析 PDF）、下载 PDF、管理笔记。

plugins.name: HorusJiang/dsh-map-tools
plugins.description: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
plugins.description_zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

plugins.name: Huang-zhishi/dsh-plugin-call-trace
plugins.description: Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.
plugins.description_zh: 持久化模型工具调用轨迹记录器：每次工具调用落盘为 JSONL（重启不丢），提供结构化 call_trace 查询工具与 callTraceHistory 服务，支持文件大小轮转，附可选浮层画布 UI。

plugins.name: huey1in/trio
plugins.description: Browser automation (Playwright) with a live view, an MCP server exposing DSH agents to any MCP client, and GitHub issue/PR/webhook review tools.
plugins.description_zh: 浏览器自动化（Playwright，带实时画面）+ MCP Server（把 DSH agent 暴露给任何 MCP 客户端）+ GitHub issue/PR/webhook 评审工具。

plugins.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#rss
plugins.description: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），��天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

plugins.name: ilps2/dsh-video-understand
plugins.description: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Self-contained engine, no external dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。引擎自包含，无外部依赖。

plugins.name: Isanti2016/dsh-console
plugins.description: Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.
