plugins.description: Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。

plugins.name: fakechris/dsh-track
plugins.description: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
plugins.description_zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

plugins.name: february2015/dsh-taskswarm
plugins.description: DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.
plugins.description_zh: TaskPlane 的 DSH 移植版：按依赖分波、多 lane 并行执行（git worktree 隔离），任务包 + 跨模型评审 + 崩溃可恢复。

plugins.name: fuhefei/dsh-sentinel
plugins.description: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 条���驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

plugins.name: haochi72/dsh-auto-continue-429
plugins.description: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
plugins.description_zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

plugins.name: hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm
plugins.description: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
plugins.description_zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

plugins.name: huxint/dsh-team
plugins.description: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

plugins.name: icetomoyo/dsh_workflow
plugins.description: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.
plugins.description_zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

plugins.name: ishuowang/dsh-agent-team-room
plugins.description: Coordinate independent DSH Sessions and provider-backed members without merging their histories, using persistent native Rooms with identity-bound leading `@` mentions, direct delivery, broadcasts, and leader-scoped controls.
plugins.description_zh: 在不合并对话历史的前提下，将多个独立 DSH Session 与 provider-backed 成员组成持久原生 Room，支持绑定精确成员身份的行首 `@` 提及、定向投递、广播和 Leader 权限控制。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-routines
plugins.description: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.
plugins.description_zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

plugins.name: jiezeng2004-design/dsh-requirements-alignment
plugins.description: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

plugins.name: JimchengChina/dsh-frontier-repro
plugins.description: Clusters arXiv, first-party lab, official artifact, hardware-vendor, and opt-in X signals into versioned release evidence bundles, then gates claim-level reproduction on commands, artifacts, metrics, and verifiers.
plugins.description_zh: 将 arXiv、实验室官网、官方产物、硬件厂商与可选 X 信号聚合为版本化发布证据包，再以命令、产物、指标和验证者约束 claim 级复现结论。

plugins.name: jingzhao-l/iterate-plugin
plugins.description: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
plugins.description_zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/file-planning
plugins.description: Disk-persisted execution planning for DSH: milestone/step state machines, dependency gating, an audit event stream, and a deterministic completion gate via dsh tools, CLI, or skill.
plugins.description_zh: 磁盘持久化的执行规划插件：以 .trail 目录承载里程碑/步骤状态机、依赖标注、审计事件与复盘纪要，提供 dsh 工具、CLI 与技能三种接口。

plugins.name: Jungod1121/dsh-anchored-standard
plugins.description: Two-phase agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro: the first request sees only bash+read (Minimal-aligned bootstrap), then the full Standard tool catalog after the first tool call or reply; ships as an installer bundle plus a manual preset directory.
plugins.description_zh: V4 Pro 两阶段 agent 预设：首轮仅 bash+read 完成极简开局，首个工具调用或回复后恢复 Standard 完整工具目录；以安装器 bundle 与手动预设目录双形态发布。

plugins.name: KanoNoUta/dsh-captain
plugins.description: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.
plugins.description_zh: GPT 规划依赖 DAG，DeepSeek Worker 自适应并行执行任务，可选 GPT Reviewer 审核增量 Git Diff 并驱动返工轮次。

plugins.name: Karbo123/DSH-EvoResearch#evoresearch-plugin
plugins.description: Research agent suite: long-horizon goal control with auditable evidence chains, cron scheduling, multi-agent expert teams, self-evolving research memory (FTS5 + RRF recall), project workspaces, and a custom workspace UI.
plugins.description_zh: 科研 agent 套件：长程目标控制（可审计证据链）、定时任务、多智能体专家团队、自进化科研记忆（FTS5 + RRF 召回）、科研项目工作区与自定义工作台界面。

plugins.name: kui123456789/dsh-codex-workflow
plugins.description: Coordinates Codex planning and independent review while the original DSH session implements and tests changes.
plugins.description_zh: 协调 Codex 制定计划和独立审查，由 DSH 原会话完成代码修改与测试。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-task-dag
plugins.description: Projection-driven live DAG for a Session's subagents and durable workflows: status and navigation, deterministic deep-chain layout, fit/pan canvas controls, and current-session node rearrangement.
plugins.description_zh: 由投影驱动的会话子代理与持久工作流实时 DAG：状态与节点导航、深层链路确定性布局、适应/平移画布，以及当前会话内节点拖动重排。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/agent-loop-workflow
plugins.description: A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent's instructions.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、与具体项目无关的多智能体协作协议：阻止失控循环的循环守卫、六字段交接格式、按风��分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程。用一个 skill 取代复制粘贴进每个 agent 指令里的相同规则。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-ops-kit
plugins.description: Evidence-first operating kit: six read-only tools (capability catalog, staged workflow plans, packaged skill reader, bounded local memory search, repository release audit, release checklist) and five packaged skills - plans and audits, never remote writes.
plugins.description_zh: 证据优先的操作套件：六个只读工具（能力清单、分阶段编排计划、随包技能阅读、有上限的本地记忆检索、仓库发布审计、发布清单）加五个随包技能；只规划与审计，不做远程写入。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/review-workflow
plugins.description: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化多评审人评审工作流：N 个评审人在相互隔离、彼此不可见的 subagent 中独立打分；一名 chair 先按锚点匹配、再按 Δ 级别裁决来调和分歧；一名独立的 critic 负责审计整个评审过程。适用于设计、代码、论文或项目评审。

plugins.name: Letter2025/dsh-model-failover
plugins.description: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
plugins.description_zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

plugins.name: Lhy723/dsh-agent-canvas
plugins.description: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

plugins.name: limuyang2/agent-team
plugins.description: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination, and conversation management.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。

plugins.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-heartbeat
plugins.description: Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.
plugins.description_zh: 定时心跳：用 followup 注入唤醒每个根 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点——忙碌时排队不打断、最多保留一条、连续无人回应自动暂停，用户下一条消息即恢复。

plugins.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-aura-scheduler
plugins.description: Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.
plugins.description_zh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

plugins.name: lonelymoon87/dsh-specflow
plugins.description: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
plugins.description_zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

plugins.name: lusblead/dsh-Kingdom
plugins.description: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

plugins.name: lynx-gt/dsh-subagent-cwd
plugins.description: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.
plugins.description_zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。

plugins.name: lynx-gt/dsh-subagent-tools
plugins.description: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
plugins.description_zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-automation
plugins.description: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

plugins.name: MJorgin/dsh-agent-conductor
plugins.description: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

plugins.name: MoonCoder-HAPPY/SpecWorkflow
plugins.description: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
plugins.description_zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

plugins.name: NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams
plugins.description: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
plugins.description_zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

plugins.name: Noelune/dsh-agent-relay
plugins.description: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
plugins.description_zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

plugins.name: nyantused-cpun/folio#plugins/folio-events
plugins.description: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
plugins.description_zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

plugins.name: nyantused-cpun/folio#plugins/folio-tools
plugins.description: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
plugins.description_zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-deep-research
plugins.description: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.
plugins.description_zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-inspect
plugins.description: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
plugins.description_zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

plugins.name: orziz/odai#odai-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing bundle with configurable compaction calls and scoped local semantic memory; compatible with DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.0-rc.7.
plugins.description_zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供可配置的压缩调用与本地作用域语义记忆；兼容 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 与 0.1.0-rc.7。

plugins.name: PensiveFei/deep-read-summarize
plugins.description: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 精读与摘要：书籍/论文/视频/网页经可插拔解析器转成结构化 Obsidian 笔记，MapReduce 并行精读子代理、JSON Schema 输出与幂等缓存。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-background-agents
plugins.description: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
plugins.description_zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-doublecheck
plugins.description: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
plugins.description_zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

plugins.name: PiedPiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas
plugins.description: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH — orchestrate tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches on a React Flow canvas.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 可视化工作流编排画布，基于 React Flow 拖拽编排工具调用、子智能体与条件分支。

plugins.name: Punky971210/dsh-punky-swarm#dsh-punky-swarm
plugins.description: Single-machine multi-subagent swarm governance for DeepSeek Harness: fixed-semantics wavePlan (3-layer DAG), engine-enforced Tier3 gates (Entry/L0/Exit/Complete), state machine, locks/mailbox, session isolation, plus the Punky Mode preset and jiufeng-team role guide.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理引擎：wavePlan 三层 DAG + 引擎级门禁（Entry/L0/Exit/Complete）+ 状态机 + 锁/mailbox + 会话隔离，附蟛蜞模式预设与 jiufeng-team 角色指引。

plugins.name: Q00/ouroboros#integrations/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Config-only bundle that mounts Ouroboros through the DSH MCP client, exposing 36 interview, Seed, execution, evaluation, and evolution workflow tools in DSH.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 DSH MCP 客户端挂载 Ouroboros 的纯配置包，在 DSH 中提供 36 个涵盖需求访谈、Seed、执行、评估与演化流程的工具。

plugins.name: QlzqQlzq/dsh-dual-agent-presets
plugins.description: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
plugins.description_zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

plugins.name: R-LEI2536/dsh-more-agent-presets
plugins.description: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

plugins.name: rinDBeans/dsh-apex-standard
plugins.description: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog management for long-session stability.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

plugins.name: rocker2018-droid/dsh-longtask-orchestrator
plugins.description: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
plugins.description_zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

plugins.name: sailoumili/novel-writer
plugins.description: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

plugins.name: Saktawdi/dsh-ha-orchestrator
plugins.description: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings UI.
plugins.description_zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

plugins.name: sandbaseai/sandbase-harness
plugins.description: Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 stdio MCP 将 dsh 连接到本地 SandBase Harness 运行时，用于管理代理与会话、流式执行任务、检查产物和取消工作。

plugins.name: Sev7een/dsh-plugin-automations
plugins.description: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
plugins.description_zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

plugins.name: severin-ye/uagent-sync#packages/dsh
plugins.description: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

plugins.name: shanliuling/dsh-image-gen
plugins.description: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。

plugins.name: shengsheng90/DSH-taskboard
plugins.description: Local SQLite taskboard as a native overlay page: projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments and workflow automation, with backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done statuses, `taskboard_*` Agent tools that can only submit work to in_review, a headless JSON CLI and a packaged skill.
plugins.description_zh: 本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

plugins.name: shengyvself/dsh-autoresume
plugins.description: Auto-continue an interrupted dsh session after a web restart by injecting a "continue" follow-up; one-shot per process, no duplicate-injection loops.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web 重启后自动向被打断的会话注入「继续」，让 agent 自动接续干活；每进程只注入一次，不重复触发。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-minimal-ptc
plugins.description: Minimal prompt x full PTC tools: one-line persona, Code Mode SDK, subagents, workflows, web search, and Windows Git Bash.
plugins.description_zh: 极简提示词 × PTC 全量工具：一句人格、Code Mode SDK、子代理、工作流、联网搜索与 Windows Git Bash。

plugins.name: StruggleYang/dsh-project-kanban
plugins.description: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
plugins.description_zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

plugins.name: stuarthu/dsh-crew
plugins.description: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
plugins.description_zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

plugins.name: timwhitez/dsh-self-evolving#packages/dsh-self-evolving
plugins.description: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
plugins.description_zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

plugins.name: titanwings/dsh-automation
plugins.description: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.
plugins.description_zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。

plugins.name: titanwings/dsh-plannotator
plugins.description: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

plugins.name: tong-io/tongflow#dsh-tongflow
plugins.description: TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 TongFlow 的“片场”插件，用于图片、配音、音乐与视频制作：agent 为每个资产生成 TongFlow 工作流文件（.tongflow.json）并通过 TongFlow 插件执行，内嵌工作流画布，按镜头/角色/take 组织项目，附漫剧模板；以 @tongflow 开头的会话进入 Studio 界面。

plugins.name: toolclub/dsh-agent-team-gui
plugins.description: Persistent multi-model squads configured in Settings and selected in the Composer, with per-member model/tool policies; the main Agent dynamically plans each send as a bounded DAG with bounded reviewer/repair loops, while Run Center tracks retries and per-member tokens from official Harness usage events.
plugins.description_zh: 持久化多模型小队在 Settings 中配置、从 Composer 选择，并支持逐成员模型与工具策略；主 Agent 为每次发送动态规划有界 DAG，并可执行有界的审阅/修复质量回路；Run Center 展示重试和基于 Harness 官方 usage 事件的逐成员 token 用量。

plugins.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-hooks
plugins.description: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

plugins.name: ttmouse/dsh-taskboard
plugins.description: Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard).
plugins.description_zh: 内嵌于 DSH Web GUI 的完整本地优先任务看板：看板/列表/Gantt/工作流/仪表盘视图、任务 AI 对话、附件与标签、dsh-routines 驱动的待办自动认领——数据存本地 SQLite（dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard）。

plugins.name: victorzhong0110/dsh-code-reference
plugins.description: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
plugins.description_zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

plugins.name: victorzhong0110/dsh-outcome-loop
plugins.description: Keeps a local task-outcome ledger for DSH, verifies acceptance criteria from deterministic evidence, records user disposition and token usage, and supports digest-bound export.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 保存本地任务结果账本，依据确定性证据验证验收标准，记录用户处置与 token 用量，并支持摘要绑定导出。

plugins.name: virggle/dsh-shutdown-after-task
plugins.description: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: vlln/dsh-loop
plugins.description: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
plugins.description_zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

plugins.name: whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-team-board
plugins.description: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
plugins.description_zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

plugins.name: xxiaoxiong/dsh-ci
plugins.description: Provider-neutral CI/CD capability for DeepSeek Harness with GitHub Actions support, bounded failure evidence, source-aware diagnostics, and approval-gated rerun/cancel controls.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用 CI/CD 能力，支持 GitHub Actions、有限失败证据提取、��码定位诊断，以及带审批控制的重跑与取消操作。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-article-publish
plugins.description: Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
plugins.description_zh: 会话内直接发布文章到 CSDN / 掘金 / 博客园，无外部服务。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-scheduler
plugins.description: Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
plugins.description_zh: cron / 一次性定时任务：按调度执行 shell 命令或投递 webhook，结果可推送到 ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

plugins.name: ygcdsj/dsh-home-migrate
plugins.description: Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.
plugins.description_zh: 迁移 DSH 配置：跨机器导出/导入 .dshmig 归档（同 OS、新建 profile、凭据脱敏、校验与回滚）。

plugins.name: zclDragon/dsh-tool-generate-image
plugins.description: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
plugins.description_zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

plugins.name: ZEM17/dsh-subagent-agy
plugins.description: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.
plugins.description_zh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。

plugins.name: zenghaili0901/dsh-bot-mode
plugins.description: Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Bot 模式：把子 Agent 变成一群有头像、有人格的 Bot，每个 Bot 拥有独立对话，由一个持久的 continuable 子 Agent 会话支撑，跨轮次保留记忆。

plugins.name: ZhenHuangLab/dsh-sync
plugins.description: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

plugins.name: ZSeven-W/dsh-crew
plugins.description: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Claude Code / Codex 派发任务给 DSH Agent：原生子代理进度、按能力分层预设的宿主内工作会话，以及为纯文本 Harness 提供视觉与图像生成的多模态桥。

plugins.name: ztl34245881-commits/dsh-task-planner
plugins.description: Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.
plugins.description_zh: 带经验肌肉记忆的任务规划：条件反射检索历史方案 + LLM 能力匹配 + 经验自动沉淀。

plugins.name: zzhzz/dsh-ask-peer
plugins.description: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 的点对点同事 Agent 咨询：可向单个或多个已配置 Peer 提问、异步排队问题、通过签名 Friend Card 推荐发现 Peer，并在 Web UI 审批入站请求。

plugins.name: 7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit
plugins.description: Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.
plugins.description_zh: 提交前按 7DGroup 规范校验 git commit message（中文类型标签、长度与标点规则），作��� GitLab pre-receive 钩子的客户端前置校验。

plugins.name: BrambleXu/dsh-revdiff
plugins.description: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

plugins.name: cirelir/dsh-change-review
plugins.description: Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
plugins.description_zh: 会话修改审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用并展示 diff 对比；会话隔离、子代理聚合、SSE 实时推送、角标与颜色自定义。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-git-graph
plugins.description: Git branch selector and Git graph in the conversation header of the dsh web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 会话头部栏的 Git 分支选择器与提交图。

plugins.name: dd2673/dsh-wending-git-workbench
plugins.description: Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格 Git 工作台：工作区级更改、diff、暂存、提交、受守卫的分支操作、提交图谱、fetch、pull --ff-only 与经官方插件 API 的上游推送。

plugins.name: DietCokewithSugar/dsh-user-experience
plugins.description: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

plugins.name: Fectivnfy112357/github-explore
plugins.description: GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
plugins.description_zh: 基于 gh CLI 的 GitHub 搜索/发现/审计技能包（SKILL.md 打包）：仓库搜索、多��探索、趋势、仓库概览、相似项目、代码搜索、issue/PR 搜索与组织审计；以 dsh bundle 形式安装（并已发布 npm）。

plugins.name: JFWaskin/dsh-git-nexus
plugins.description: Git and GitHub panel for the DSH web profile: stage/unstage/discard/diff, branches, commit, push/pull/sync, log, file browser, workflow board, and GitHub OAuth with PR creation.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 的 Git 与 GitHub 面板：暂存/撤销/丢弃/差异、分支、提交、推送/拉取/同步、日志、文件浏览、工作流看板，以及带 PR 创建的 GitHub OAuth。

plugins.name: jiayan-xu/dsh-ocr-review
plugins.description: Local AI code-review gate: review a workspace/branch/commit diff via the managed ocr.js, returning structured findings with token stats; gate mode fails on findings.
plugins.description_zh: 本地 AI 代码评审门禁：对工作区/分支/commit diff 跑评审（托管 ocr.js），返回结构化 findings 与 token 统计；门禁模式发现问题即失败。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.
plugins.description_zh: 对抗式多视角代码审查：正确性/安全性/可维护性透镜并行攻击 diff，确定性严重度定级、抑制规则与增量审查历史。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/github-mcp
plugins.description: GitHub workbench MCP server (dsh bundle): 23 MCP tools for repos, issues, PRs, code review, and search, with zero runtime dependencies and PAT/OAuth auth.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub 开发者工作台 MCP server（dsh bundle）：23 个 MCP 工具覆盖仓库、issue、PR、代码审查与搜索，零运行时依赖，支持 PAT 与 OAuth 双认证。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/worktree-mgr
plugins.description: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.
plugins.description_zh: 按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目��双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。

plugins.name: kaziii/dsh-github-connector#github
plugins.description: GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。

plugins.name: LaoYueHanNi/dsh-git-worktree
plugins.description: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

plugins.name: lehhair/dsh-diff-viewer
plugins.description: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.
plugins.description_zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。

plugins.name: Lenonss/DSH_VsCodeMode
plugins.description: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

plugins.name: Letter2025/dsh-task-worktree
plugins.description: Complete task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: per-repo manifest for durable state, branch-and-path names (slashes allowed, e.g. refactor/logging), bring-back to main or direct commit, optional carry-over of uncommitted main changes.
plugins.description_zh: 完整的任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 永久保存、分支名即路径（支持斜杠如 refactor/logging）、带回主目录或直接提交两种收尾、可携带主工作区未提交改动。

plugins.name: lonelymoon87/dsh-gitflow
plugins.description: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
plugins.description_zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

plugins.name: LoserFox/dsh-git-identity
plugins.description: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
plugins.description_zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

plugins.name: lucas-ward/dsh-ci-context
plugins.description: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
plugins.description_zh: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-code-smell
plugins.description: Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 代码气味雷达：静态扫描 TODO/FIXME 债务、未实现桩、超长行、大文件与重复代码块，按严重度输出修复建议，全程只读。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-git-hygiene
plugins.description: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
plugins.description_zh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

plugins.name: NEAZ71eve/dsh-tool-github
plugins.description: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
plugins.description_zh: GitHub REST API 工具 + 浏览器侧边栏面板：仓库/搜索/Issue/PR/评论、账号绑定（凭据库）与一键克隆为工作区。

plugins.name: No-PRM/dsh-explorer#dsh-explorer
plugins.description: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.
plugins.description_zh: Git 优先的文件树侧栏：VS Code 风格层级线、M/A/U/D/R git 状态装饰、HEAD 与工作区对照预览、媒体预览、拖拽引用（文件/文件夹/选中代码带行号）—— 纯插件。

plugins.name: Noob-stupid/dsh-github-login
plugins.description: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
plugins.description_zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

plugins.name: Palaiologos1453/dsh-worktree-studio
plugins.description: Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的人工 Git worktree 任务工作台，将验证结果绑定到合并交付。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-github
plugins.description: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
plugins.description_zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

plugins.name: Starfie1d1272/dsh-github-skills
plugins.description: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
plugins.description_zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

plugins.name: sunshaobei/dsh-session-review
plugins.description: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
plugins.description_zh: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮��开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

plugins.name: temotee2103/dsh-ci-co-pilot
plugins.description: GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.
plugins.description_zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness Agent 化身 GitHub 副驾：PR 审查、CI 失败修复、Issue 分类与自动发版说明。

plugins.name: Tlyer233/dsh-vscode-review#dsh-review
plugins.description: Journals every AI file write/edit into before/after snapshots for an inline VS Code review flow (accept/reject hunks, per-file undo, no git).
plugins.description_zh: 把 AI 每次文件写入/编辑记录为 before/after 快照，供 VS Code 内联 review 使用（逐块接受/撤回、单文件撤销，不依赖 git）。

plugins.name: Tlyer233/dsh-vscode-review#dsh-review-changes
plugins.description: Review Changes panel above the web composer with a VS Code sidebar bridge: send editor selections, drag files/folders as tags, and batch accept/reject every listed file.
plugins.description_zh: Web 输入框上方的 Review Changes 面板与 VS Code 侧栏桥：发送编辑器选区、把文件/文件夹拖成 tag，并批量接受/撤回列表中的全部文件。

plugins.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-git-workflow
plugins.description: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
plugins.description_zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

plugins.name: txy-ucas/dsh-workspace-snapshot
plugins.description: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
plugins.description_zh: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。

plugins.name: Viger1/dsh-review
plugins.description: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
plugins.description_zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

plugins.name: WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph
plugins.description: Dedicated read-only Git Graph view beside Chat and Trajectory: commit topology, local/remote/tag refs, HEAD and working-tree status, search, filtering, first-parent mode, refresh, and load more.
plugins.description_zh: Chat 和 Trajectory 旁的独立 Git Graph 视图：提交拓扑、本地/远程/tag 引用、HEAD 与工作区状态、搜索、筛选、首父模式、刷新和加载更多。

plugins.name: wloops/dsh-git-worktree
plugins.description: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
plugins.description_zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

plugins.name: Wongzexu/dsh-git-status
plugins.description: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
plugins.description_zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

plugins.name: wuxiangru915/dsh-review-loop
plugins.description: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
plugins.description_zh: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

plugins.name: xiongjiamu/dsh-atomgit
plugins.description: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.
plugins.description_zh: AtomGit 插件包：内置六个 AtomGit 技能（Issue 规划、Issue 实现、PR 审查、PR 合并、CLI 版本发布、GitHub 镜像），并集成 ag CLI 与平台托管的 MCP 工具（仓库/分支/Issue/PR/搜索）。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-git-workflow
plugins.description: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-github-intelligence
plugins.description: The most complete GitHub integration for dsh: repo overview, releases, issues, pull requests, contributors, search, and a deep repo report with TTL caching — no API key needed.
plugins.description_zh: 目前最完整的 dsh GitHub 整合：仓库概览、Release、Issue、PR、贡献者、搜索与一键深度报告，内置 TTL 缓存，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-github-release-radar
plugins.description: Track releases and stars of any public GitHub repository from inside dsh agents — no API key needed.
plugins.description_zh: 让 dsh agent 直接查询任意 GitHub 公开仓库的 Release 与星标变化，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: zsxh1990/pr-genius
plugins.description: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

plugins.name: 534119219/chicheng-push
plugins.description: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook ���，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。

plugins.name: 534119219/dsh-messaging#messaging-core
plugins.description: Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息网关：一个插件接入 27 个 IM 平台（Telegram、QQ、微信、Discord、WhatsApp、飞书等），支持扫码授权、每平台独立工作区、斜杠命令与 Web 配置弹窗。

plugins.name: AbcdefgXW/dsh-msg-hub
plugins.description: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
plugins.description_zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

plugins.name: alvinunreal/openpets#dsh
plugins.description: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
plugins.description_zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

plugins.name: amlyczz/dsh-lark-link
plugins.description: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

plugins.name: aokamoaki/dsh-notify
plugins.description: Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conversation header.
plugins.description_zh: 对话完成通知：回合完成/出错/目标完成/提问/审批时弹出 Windows toast 与提示音，仅后台提醒，会话头部铃铛即控制中心。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-omni-bridge
plugins.description: Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: route WeChat (ClawBot/iLink), QQ, and Feishu (Lark) chat messages to a DSH agent and relay its replies back, with per-channel sessions and reply dedup.
plugins.description_zh: 多通道消息桥接插件：将微信 ClawBot / QQ / 飞书的消息接入 DSH agent，并把回复回传给发送者，按通道独立会话、回复去重。

plugins.name: BiBoyang/dsh-im-bridge
plugins.description: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
plugins.description_zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

plugins.name: bill9109/dsh-web-ui-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notification reminders.
plugins.description_zh: 桌面通知提醒。

plugins.name: bill9109/dsh-webbridge
plugins.description: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

plugins.name: Bing-Bryan/dsh-unread-dot
plugins.description: macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.
plugins.description_zh: macOS Dock 角标与提示音：最小化/切走时 Dock 显示未读角标（运行中=红点、跑完=数字）并播放水泡提示音，回到应用自动清除，基于 Badging API。

plugins.name: bobleer/dsh-acp-for-bitfun
plugins.description: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
plugins.description_zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

plugins.name: br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin
plugins.description: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。

plugins.name: caoxiaohu7745-bot/kongmu-im-bridge
plugins.description: Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 飞书桥（衍生自 dsh-im-bridge）：长连接免公网、审批卡片、群聊仅 @ 回复、流式卡片打字机回显、/stop 中断任务。

plugins.name: cdxiaodong/dsh-island
plugins.description: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Unix socket 把 DSH agent 的会话、工具调用与审批实时桥接到 CodeIsland macOS 刘海面板，可直接在面板上批准/拒绝。

plugins.name: cerebrixos-org/tuning-engines-cli#tuningengines-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Exports metadata-only DSH turn, model, tool, approval, retry, and error events to Tuning Engines for governed traces, policy evaluation, cost analysis, and Work Session review, with a disk-backed retry queue.
plugins.description_zh: 将不含原始内容的 DSH 回合、模型、工具、审批、重试和错误事件导出到 Tuning Engines，用于受治理的追踪、策略评估、成本分析和 Work Session 审阅，并提供磁盘持久化重试队列。

plugins.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-open-with
plugins.description: Open registered workspaces from the Web UI in a detected or configured local editor, terminal, or file manager, with a remembered per-browser preference.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web UI 使用检测到或配置的本机编辑器、终端或文件管理器打开已登记 Workspace，并在浏览器中记住首选项。

plugins.name: dingyi222666/dsh-session-notification
plugins.description: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
plugins.description_zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

plugins.name: doncelee229-cmyk/dsh-plugin-approval-alert
plugins.description: Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.
plugins.description_zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

plugins.name: dsh-niao/dsh-niao-message
plugins.description: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

plugins.name: faukwaa/dsh-gap-feed
plugins.description: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
plugins.description_zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

plugins.name: good-boy4069/dsh-mobile-remote
plugins.description: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
plugins.description_zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

plugins.name: grunmin/dsh-acp-enhanced
plugins.description: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
plugins.description_zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

plugins.name: hanwuji1/dsh-web-launcher
plugins.description: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
plugins.description_zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

plugins.name: hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel
plugins.description: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.
plugins.description_zh: Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

plugins.name: imetn/dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.description: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

plugins.name: ingleav626-art/dsh-native-launcher
plugins.description: Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 桌面化启动器：桌面快捷方式、静默启动、系统托盘（打开 / 彻底退出＝停服务＋关应用窗口＋退托盘）、PWA 应用窗口（已运行则聚焦不重复弹窗）、安装引导、任务完成通知。

plugins.name: isheng-eqi/dsh-niulai-sound
plugins.description: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

plugins.name: itr-del/dsh-feishu
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

plugins.name: JamesYasR/dsh-email-push-master
plugins.description: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.
plugins.description_zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：稳定 SMTP（不重试 535）、连接与空闲超时，并带 --check 自检。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-chatnode-wechat
plugins.description: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

plugins.name: jiezeng2004-design/dsh-chatgpt-bridge
plugins.description: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

plugins.name: JMOKSZ/dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
plugins.description_zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

plugins.name: kaixinbaba/dsh-complete-notify
plugins.description: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

plugins.name: lanbaolu/dsh-wechat-bridge
plugins.description: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

plugins.name: LoserFox/telegram
plugins.description: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.
plugins.description_zh: Telegram Bot API 桥接：长轮询、per-chat 会话、HTML 格式化。

plugins.name: luzhengyangtx/dsh-telegram-duty
plugins.description: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
plugins.description_zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

plugins.name: ly6170/dsh-messager
plugins.description: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

plugins.name: michaelcode-wang/dsh-wecom
plugins.description: WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Smart Robot bridge: two-way chat over the aibot WebSocket gateway, no public endpoint needed.
plugins.description_zh: 企业微信智能机器人桥接：aibot WebSocket 双向对话（bot_id + secret），无需公网回调。

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-im-connect
plugins.description: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
plugins.description_zh: 把微信、企业微��、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

plugins.name: miiaowuwu/dsh-sound-lab
plugins.description: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

plugins.name: mingzeng21/dsh-notion
plugins.description: Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.
plugins.description_zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

plugins.name: moon09300731/dsh-peak-cost-mode
plugins.description: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

plugins.name: muretai/muretai-dsh-skill
plugins.description: Puts the agent on the Muretai network: its own identity, invite-based introductions, signed end-to-end encrypted messaging with agents owned by other people, and an inbound-mail wake that lets it reply on its own.
plugins.description_zh: 让智能体加入 Muretai 网络：拥有自己的身份，通过邀请相识，与属于其他人的智能体进行签名、端到端加密的通信；来信唤醒后可自行回复。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-notifications
plugins.description: Adds a Settings card that pops a system notification and optional chime when a conversation turn completes.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置中新增卡片，对话轮次完成时弹出系统通知与可选提示音。

plugins.name: nickhelion/dsh-serverchan-notify
plugins.description: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
plugins.description_zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

plugins.name: Nixz0824/dsh-sound-cue
plugins.description: Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes. No popups or OS notifications.
plugins.description_zh: 会话需要你操作（审批、提问或计划确认）以及任务完成时播放不同的短提示音。Web Audio 现场合成，无弹窗、无系统通知。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-lark
plugins.description: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-notification
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.
plugins.description_zh: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-open-in-vscode
plugins.description: Open DSH workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 从 Web GUI 一键在 VS Code 中打开工作区目录。

plugins.name: openma-ai/deepseek-harness-acp
plugins.description: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
plugins.description_zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

plugins.name: PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-notify-skill
plugins.description: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
plugins.description_zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

plugins.name: pany0593/dsh-ui-notifications
plugins.description: OS-level system notifications for the dsh web GUI: popups when a turn finishes or the agent needs your approval, answer, or plan review while the page is in the background.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面系统通知：回合结束或 agent 等待授权/回答/计划审核时，页面在后台也弹出系统级提醒。

plugins.name: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify
plugins.description: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

plugins.name: pc439527/dsh-notify-bark
plugins.description: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
plugins.description_zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

plugins.name: PeterBon/dsh-hooks
plugins.description: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
plugins.description_zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

plugins.name: PGZXB/dsh-feishu
plugins.description: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台——每个斜杠命令都是 ⚙️ 控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。

plugins.name: photon-hq/dsh-imessage
plugins.description: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

plugins.name: pitetow/dsh-notify-on-complete
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for run completion, model questions, and approval requests with per-platform system sounds, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 系统桌面通知：运行结束、模型提问与审批请求即时提醒，三平台提示音，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: PlutoKeating/dsh-lark-bot
plugins.description: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书的桥接插件：扫码绑定 PersonalAgent、流式卡片、git worktree 项目工作区、scope 并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理，以及 dsh 崩溃后仍在飞书应答的安全网守护。

plugins.name: Qing45/dsh-feishu-chat
plugins.description: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

plugins.name: ray062/dsh-obvious-grid
plugins.description: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

plugins.name: shaobeichen/dsh-pocket
plugins.description: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.
plugins.description_zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。

plugins.name: shrekcg/dsh-im-channel
plugins.description: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

plugins.name: SingleOne/dsh-notify-center
plugins.description: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
plugins.description_zh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

plugins.name: SkyloveQiu/dsh-finreport
plugins.description: Scheduled bilingual financial reports for DSH: market quotes, news and macro calendar, with per-target timezones and delivery through eight dsh-im channels.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 定时双语财经日报：包含行情、新闻与宏观日历，支持每个目标独立配置时区，并通过 dsh-im 的八种通道投递。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-dingtalk
plugins.description: DingTalk group-robot notifications (webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
plugins.description_zh: 钉钉群机器人通知（webhook + 加签，零运行时依赖）。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-email
plugins.description: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment) with QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support and a send-approval gate.
plugins.description_zh: 邮件工具插件：IMAP/SMTP 收/发/搜/列文件夹/附件下载，内置 QQ/163/126/新浪/阿里/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud 预设，多账号、连接复用与发信审批门。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-slack
plugins.description: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
plugins.description_zh: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply，Socket Mode 免公网回调）。

plugins.name: stuarthu/dsh-update-notifier
plugins.description: Checks npm hourly for newer versions of the installed plugins and asks which ones to upgrade.
plugins.description_zh: 每小时检查 npm 上已安装插件的新版本，并询问升级其中哪些。

plugins.name: suuuuuu-1/dsh-discord
plugins.description: Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

plugins.name: temotee2103/dsh-overdrive#gateway-core
plugins.description: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.
plugins.description_zh: dsh-overdrive 聊天网关的 DSH 侧远程会话驱动：把 Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信 的会话、轨迹回放与一键审批接入 Harness。需配套运行 @dsh-overdrive/gateway。

plugins.name: THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-notifier
plugins.description: Unified notification & remote control for DSH: one `notify()` API, 25+ channels (Telegram / DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom / QQ bot / WxPusher / PushPlus / ServerChan / Bark / Discord / Slack / ntfy / webhook...), level routing (timeSensitive / active / passive) with tiered retry, multi-channel inbound approval (Telegram buttons, Feishu cards, QQ, WxPusher, WeChat iLink), official QR login for QQ/DingTalk/Feishu, a local web admin console, multi-agent routing, desktop notifications — and a mobile command center: `!status` / `!stop` / `!retry` agent control from your phone plus actionable notifications (view result / retry / logs buttons that call back into the agent). Secrets redacted, tool rate-limited, zero runtime deps — plus an open event source: other plugins can inject the notifier service (ctx.notifier) and subscribe to dsh-notifier/sent events, reusing notification without coupling — and an identity system (v0.7): pairing codes (/pair in any DM, first redeemer becomes owner), composite-key bindings, member roles, and a guided bootstrap state when the whitelist is empty.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 统一通知推送与远程控制：一个 `notify()` API 打通 25+ 渠道（Telegram / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 企业微信 / QQ 机器人 / WxPusher / PushPlus / Server 酱 / Bark / Discord / Slack / ntfy / webhook 等），timeSensitive / active / passive 分级路由并重试；五通道反向审批（Telegram 按钮 / 飞书卡片 / QQ / WxPusher / 微信 iLink）；QQ/钉钉/飞书官方扫码登录；本地 Web 管理台；多 agent 路由；系统桌面通知——以及**手机指挥中心**：在手机上发 `!status` / `!stop` / `!retry` 遥控 agent，通知带可操作按钮（查看结果 / 重试 / 日志，点击回调 agent）。密钥脱敏、工具限流、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: ThreeBody6666/dsh-im-hub
plugins.description: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

plugins.name: ttmouse/dsh-dingtalk-channel
plugins.description: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
plugins.description_zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

plugins.name: wendayuan/dsh-weixin
plugins.description: WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.
plugins.description_zh: 微信（iLink）通道：用手机微信直接对话 DSH agent，每个对话一个持久会话，复用 DSH 凭据。

plugins.name: whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-notify
plugins.description: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
plugins.description_zh: 回合完成、错误或待审批时推送 IM webhook（飞书/企微/钉钉/Slack/Discord/自定义）与本地通��。

plugins.name: wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-notifier
plugins.description: Approval/completion/error event notifications: browser Notification plus native toasts (PowerShell WinRT on Windows, notify-send on Linux/macOS), quiet hours, same-kind error merging, and an independent switch for subagent completion.
plugins.description_zh: 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT、Linux/macOS notify-send），支持免打扰时段、同类错误合并、子代理完成独立开关。

plugins.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-pet-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time.
plugins.description_zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。

plugins.name: wsz987/dsh-channels#channels
plugins.description: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.
plugins.description_zh: 将微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供统一配置、私聊与群聊访问范围管理，以及渠道内 Agent 对话和会话指令。

plugins.name: wz-heng/dsh-feishu-bridge
plugins.description: Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back — with opt-in human-in-the-loop tool approval (Allow/Deny cards before every bash call, fail-closed timeout). Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; daily latest-SDK compatibility canary; bilingual docs.
plugins.description_zh: Fail-closed 的飞书（Lark）channel 桥：和机器人聊天即驱动 dsh agent turn，可选人在环工具审批（每次 bash 调用前飞书弹 Allow/Deny 卡，超时默认拒绝）。仅经官方 Python SDK 集成（精确锁版）；白名单默认全拒、webhook 验签/时间窗/防重放、按 chat 粘性会话；每日最新 SDK 兼容金丝雀；中英双语文档。

plugins.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-weixin
plugins.description: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
plugins.description_zh: 通过微信远程控制 DeepSeek Harness，支持任意文件传输。

plugins.name: xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-chime
plugins.description: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

plugins.name: xmanrui/dsh-feishu
plugins.description: Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
plugins.description_zh: 通过扫码把飞书机器人接入DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: xmanrui/dsh-im
plugins.description: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).
plugins.description_zh: 通过二维码或机器人凭据将 IM 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 WhatsApp 共 9 种渠道）。

plugins.name: xmanrui/dsh-weixin
plugins.description: Connect a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
plugins.description_zh: 通过微信扫码把微信机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-notify
plugins.description: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

plugins.name: yeruizhi/dsh-lark-meeting-notifier
plugins.description: Feishu meeting reminder: a dsh-plugin which has only side effect: reminding you, mid-flow with AI, that you "have to go meet carbon-based lifeforms".
plugins.description_zh: 飞书会议提醒：一个只有副作用的 dsh-plugin，在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时提醒你「不得不去跟碳基生命开会了」。

plugins.name: YuMo226/dsh-task-notify
plugins.description: Native Windows system notification (Notification Center toast) when a task completes: goal completion or agent turn end.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成时弹出 Windows 原生系统通知（通知中心横幅）：目标完成或 Agent 结束一轮。

plugins.name: YZz-S/dsh-notifier
plugins.description: System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.
plugins.description_zh: 任务完成或需要确认/输入时发送操作系统原生通知：Windows toast、macOS osascript、Linux notify-send。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-notify
plugins.description: System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).
plugins.description_zh: 系统级桌面通知：回合完成 / 工作流完成横幅，需要审批时弹出模态提醒（macOS osascript / Linux notify-send）。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-ticktick
plugins.description: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

plugins.name: zzx-dear/dsh-capybara-notify
plugins.description: Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.
plugins.description_zh: 水豚秘书：桌面宠物气泡+叮咚通知、告警收件箱 API、会话智能提醒（任务完成/需要确认/阻塞）、磁盘/HTTP/进程巡检脚本，以及每日高口碑插件推荐，另附 API 冒烟测试。

plugins.name: 1123762794/dsh-web-restart
plugins.description: One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面一键重启按钮：侧边栏底部按钮，单击即重启 dsh web 进程，且重启后按钮常驻。

plugins.name: 2008924/dsh-progress-viz#plugin
plugins.description: Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).
plugins.description_zh: headless dsh 任务的实时阶段、ETA 与成本看板：把黑盒会话事件流变成实时多任务网格（cordis 插件 + 本地独立看板，零 API 调用）。

plugins.name: 777-Zen/dsh-capability-index
plugins.description: Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
plugins.description_zh: DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-verify
plugins.description: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-trend-radar
plugins.description: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
plugins.description_zh: 生态行情面板：把 dsh-plugin topic 与 awesome 收录列表快照成本地历史，产出周报（新增插件、star 增速、类别热度、收录覆盖率），并支持关键词雷达监控新品与 star 突增。

plugins.name: a179-sanae/dsh-code-check
plugins.description: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
plugins.description_zh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

plugins.name: Airmetro/dsh-update-checker
plugins.description: Update management for the whole stack: compares DeepSeek Harness and every installed third-party plugin against npm and GitHub releases (semver-aware), shows a locale-aware banner (zh/en) with per-plugin update status, and provides one-click updates with automatic backup/rollback, temp-dir installs that never touch other packages, and a watchdog-guarded restart. A settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles. Zero-config on any machine.
plugins.description_zh: 全栈更新管理：对 DeepSeek Harness 主程序与每个已装第三方插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅随系统语言（中/英）逐项提示可更新插件；一键更新主程序或任意插件，自动备份可回滚、插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包、更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。跨机器零配置。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 设置面板内的「技能管理」页面：按系统 / 用户 / 工作区 / 预设浏览技能，展开技能查看文件树、查看和编辑文件，支持从 zip 导入技能，以及导出、删除（系统技能只读）。

plugins.name: AngelosZou/dsh-python-env
plugins.description: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
plugins.description_zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

plugins.name: AngelosZou/graphlint#integrations/dsh
plugins.description: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
