plugins.description_zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

plugins.name: anweat/dsh-restart
plugins.description: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

plugins.name: aokamoaki/dsh-startup-guard
plugins.description: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
plugins.description_zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

plugins.name: Areium/dsh-fail-logger
plugins.description: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
plugins.description_zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

plugins.name: asdf17128/dsh-doctor
plugins.description: Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness's own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 注册 `config_doctor` 工具，检查 harness 自身配置里那些会静默通过启动的问题：patch 整体替换 config 而丢失的字段、指向不存在 entry id 的 patch、工具重名冲突。只读。

plugins.name: asdf17128/dshp
plugins.description: Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 注册 `list_profiles` 与 `export_profile`：让 agent 列出本机有哪些配置，并把整套 profile（bundle 顺序��插件版本、patch）导出成一个可直接分享的文件。只读。

plugins.name: ayahunter/dsh-plugin-clinic
plugins.description: Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.
plugins.description_zh: 已安装 DSH 插件集合的只读体检诊所：加载健康、依赖完整、版本兼容、安装脚本风险、重复与 patch 引用，交付模型工具、设置面板与 JSON 报告。

plugins.name: badai147/dsh-global-rules
plugins.description: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

plugins.name: bainianlaoyao/bash-on-windows
plugins.description: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
plugins.description_zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-conflict-guardian
plugins.description: Scans the DSH loader tree at startup for plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed or pending plugins, duplicate config row ids), auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 启动时扫描加载器中的插件冲突（重复挂载、启动失败、依赖缺失、配置行 id 重复），自动停用或恢复冲突插件，并在 Web 界面弹出冲突报告。

plugins.name: Bcy2020/dsh-cc-ecosystem
plugins.description: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/ plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via a memory-IR parse layer that keeps .claude as the source of truth with no writes back. Six installable packages: loader, skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，零回写。六个���安装包：loader、skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp。

plugins.name: BiBoyang/dsh-eval-harness
plugins.description: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

plugins.name: BotonJ/dsh-windtunnel
plugins.description: Contract regression harness for plugin authors: a scripted LLM adapter drives the real pipeline in isolated child processes with session-event assertions (load/contract/behavior/fault layers); zero API key, CI-ready.
plugins.description_zh: 插件作者的契约回归风洞：剧本适配器在隔离子进程中驱动真实管线，会话事件断言覆盖加载/契约/行为/故障四层；零 API key，可进 CI。

plugins.name: br1nosense/dsh-project-manager
plugins.description: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DSH Web 界面以悬浮窗口管理开发项目：添加/删除、一键启动/停止/重启、文件变更热重载自动重启、实时日志查看与持久化。

plugins.name: BrambleXu/dsh-prompt-profile
plugins.description: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

plugins.name: bujue600-arch/dsh-testgen
plugins.description: Automated unit-test generation: a /testgen command and generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix tests until they pass (LLM + offline template generators; vitest/jest/mocha/node:test).
plugins.description_zh: 自动化单元测试生成：/testgen 命令与 generate_tests 工具，生成、运行并修复测试直至通过（LLM 与离线模板双生成器；支持 vitest/jest/mocha/node:test）。

plugins.name: caizhihaoczh/dsh-profile-multica
plugins.description: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
plugins.description_zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: Cavan-Ou/dsh-observation-journal
plugins.description: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 零侵入运行事实遥测：每个会话自动把任务/模型档位/工具/失败/时长/状态写入人机共读观测卡并附统计区（纯观察者——零工具、零 LLM、零注入）。

plugins.name: cdxiaodong/dsh-llm-inspector
plugins.description: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
plugins.description_zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。

plugins.name: CH4ACKO3/dsh-harmony
plugins.description: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
plugins.description_zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

plugins.name: chenkai2/dsh-daemon
plugins.description: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
plugins.description_zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

plugins.name: chouyong/dsh-effect-doctor
plugins.description: Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.
plugins.description_zh: 隔离插件卸载后验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源是否回到基线，并生成确定性清理回执。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugin-toggle
plugins.description: Settings -> Plugins switchboard: every loaded plugin card shows its package description and runtime phase, with fuzzy search and start/stop toggles that never rewrite config files.
plugins.description_zh: 设置→插件开关面板：每个��加载插件的卡片显示简述与运行阶段，支持模糊搜索与运行时启动/关闭（不改写配置文件）。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-system-proxy
plugins.description: System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.
plugins.description_zh: 系统代理检测（scutil/env/PAC）：状态工具 + proxy_export 导出 bash 代理片段。

plugins.name: DeLightor/dsh-depguard
plugins.description: Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
plugins.description_zh: 依赖拓扑安全：装前预测 + 装后检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 多副本、版本漂移与插件私包，防 Symbol 键冲突崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')）。

plugins.name: disyli/dsh-tool-call-stats
plugins.description: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
plugins.description_zh: 进程内工具调用统计：提供 `tool_stats` 工具，按工具汇报调用次数、失败次数与平均耗时。

plugins.name: Elohia/dsh-genome
plugins.description: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
plugins.description_zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

plugins.name: EvilIrving/dsh-repro
plugins.description: /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
plugins.description_zh: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

plugins.name: fakechris/dsh-harness-ops#dsh-restart-recover
plugins.description: Restart recovery for DeepSeek Harness web: after a crash or restart, an interrupted agent turn continues automatically (host-side agent/created listener, no browser timing races).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness web 重启恢复：崩溃或重启后，被打断的 agent 回合自动继续（host 侧 agent/created 监听，无浏览器时序竞态）。

plugins.name: FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck#package
plugins.description: Right-side details panel that turns the Matt Pocock skills collection into a DSH quest board: wayfinder decision maps, per-issue triage / fix / discuss / execute actions, 9-item core-skill probe plus 20-skill radar, environment checks, and one-click handoff across sessions.
plugins.description_zh: Matt Pocock 技能套件的 DSH 控制面板：右侧 details 列打开；含 wayfinder 决策地图、issue 行级 triage / 修复 / 讨论 / 执行按钮、9 项核心套件探测 + 20 个技能雷达、环境检查、跨会话 handoff 交接。

plugins.name: fgm-builds/dashr#dashr
plugins.description: RLM mode for dsh: recursive sub-agents via a unified rlm() function — spawn, await, and chain child agents as first-class Python calls. Adds a persistent IPython kernel with tools.* bindings and context-as-variable.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 的 RLM 模式：通过统一的 rlm() 函数实现递归子代理——以一等 Python 函数调用生成、等待、链式传递子代理。附带常驻 IPython 内核、tools.* 绑定与上下文即变量。

plugins.name: FleetingEcho/dsh-powerdesk
plugins.description: A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。

plugins.name: FlySnailY/dsh-langfuse-plus
plugins.description: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
plugins.description_zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness���的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

plugins.name: forrestchang/dsh-multica-runtime
plugins.description: Run the dsh runtime on Multica.
plugins.description_zh: 让 dsh 运行时跑在 Multica 上。

plugins.name: frozo-ai/dsh-worlds
plugins.description: Runs the agent's filesystem, bash and PTY terminals inside a Docker container by providing the `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` seams, so cwd, environment and background processes survive a harness restart.
plugins.description_zh: 通过提供 `ctx.fs` 与 `ctx.subprocess` 接缝，把 agent 的文件系统、bash 与 PTY 终端跑在 Docker 容器里；工作目录、环境变量与后台进程可在 harness 重启后存活。

plugins.name: fuyue521/dsh-desktop-shortcut
plugins.description: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

plugins.name: guo6x/dsh-housekeeper
plugins.description: Environment housekeeper for the agent: toolchain inventory (node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/browsers), scratch/cache scan with whitelist-guarded one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) editor - all in the Web GUI settings.
plugins.description_zh: agent 的环境管家：工具链台账（node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/浏览器）、缓存与临时目录扫描 + 白名单安全一键清理、机器规则（AGENTS.md）编辑，全在 Web GUI 设置面板。

plugins.name: hackerFish/dsh-lab
plugins.description: Tested-curation lab for DSH plugins: every entry passes real install/static-scan gates in an isolated environment, with full logs and reproduction commands (Chinese-first).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件实测实验室：每个条目都在隔离环境真机过四关（安装/冒烟/快检/钉版），公开完整日志与复现命令，只发测过的结论。

plugins.name: hellosky983/dsh-fabric
plugins.description: Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 用一��声明式 DSL 统一 DSH 的所有可扩展接缝：提供 `fabric` 运行时服务、`fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` 工具，以及能力图谱设置页。

plugins.name: hellosky983/dsh-foundry
plugins.description: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

plugins.name: hezhongtang/dsh-update-copilot
plugins.description: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the dsh core, official bundles, and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 dsh 本体、官方 bundle 和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

plugins.name: huasheng33991/dsh-power-button
plugins.description: One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action.
plugins.description_zh: 固定在窗口右下角的一键启停按钮：通过脱离终端的辅助进程按原始启动命令重启 DeepSeek Harness（仅本机同源可调），附「仅停止」小按钮。

plugins.name: HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-check-update
plugins.description: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
plugins.description_zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

plugins.name: hust-open-atom-club/oh-dsh
plugins.description: Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.
plugins.description_zh: 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。

plugins.name: ICCuse/dsh-pain-point-check
plugins.description: Enforced pain-point gate: after two non-converged experiments it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until answered, and blocks same-direction retries.
plugins.description_zh: 强制痛点检查：同一问题连续 2 个实验未收敛后注入三问、拦截非调查类工具调用直到答出、阻止同方向重试。

plugins.name: iiwish/dsh-testkit
plugins.description: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

plugins.name: izz-BLUE/dsh-devtools
plugins.description: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

plugins.name: jasen215/dsh-continual-harness
plugins.description: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
plugins.description_zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

plugins.name: Jayden-X-L/forkprobe
plugins.description: Compare multiple skills on the same task and pick the winner.
plugins.description_zh: 同一任务并行试跑多个技能，对比结果选出最优。

plugins.name: JayDong9130/dsh-evolution-lab
plugins.description: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
plugins.description_zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

plugins.name: JesmonX/dsh-web-shell
plugins.description: Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.
plugins.description_zh: 右���停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-tmuxctl
plugins.description: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.
plugins.description_zh: 掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

plugins.name: jilian-dsh/dsh-rules-manager#dsh-rules-manager
plugins.description: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

plugins.name: jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#evidence-first
plugins.description: Evidence-first guard: warns the agent when it claims success without a matching tool-execution record in recent context.
plugins.description_zh: 证据铁律守卫：模型声称成功但上下文中没有对应工具执行记录时，自动注入警告。

plugins.name: jinhongxun/dsh-mcphub
plugins.description: MCP management panel for DeepSeek Harness — live connection status per server (green dot), one-click pip/npx upgrades for local stdio servers with Windows file-lock handling, pause/resume/delete, an add-server form writing cordis.patch.yml, real initialize-handshake probes, and beginner-friendly usage help.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 MCP 管理面板：每个服务器实时连接状态（绿点）、本地 stdio 服务器一键升级（pip/npx，自动处理 Windows 文件锁）、暂停/恢复/删除、添加表单直写 cordis.patch.yml、真实 initialize 握手探测与小白友好的使用说明。

plugins.name: Jiyr0119/dsh-service-console
plugins.description: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/hooks-adapter
plugins.description: Reuses hooks declared in Claude Code, Codex and opencode configs on dsh, executing shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers with zero runtime dependencies.

plugins.name: jorinyang/dsh-clawshell
plugins.description: Self-healing runtime layer: a resource control loop with strategy switching and repair escalation, error-storm and fiber-failure insight, cross-session knowledge carry-over, a self-healing dashboard and 7 tools.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时自愈层：资源控制闭环（策略切换 + 修复升级链）、错误风暴与 fiber 失败洞察、跨会话知识传承，附自愈可视化面板与 7 个工具。

plugins.name: jorinyang/dsh-doctor
plugins.description: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

plugins.name: kanneiren/dsh-network-settings
plugins.description: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
plugins.description_zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

plugins.name: keyiadiannao/dsh-restart-button
plugins.description: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
plugins.description_zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖���它插件），动态端口适配。

plugins.name: kriskite/dsh-network-proxy
plugins.description: Network proxy manager for DeepSeek Harness: switch between system, manual, and direct modes from a live settings UI, applied instantly.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理管理器：在设置界面即时切换跟随系统 / 手动 / 直连三种模式，立即生效。

plugins.name: kun2-5code/dsh-plugin-template
plugins.description: A starter template for dsh plugins covering config, tools, events, services, hooks, browser UI slots, and slash commands.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件开发模板，覆盖配置、工具、事件、服务、钩子、浏览器 UI 插槽与斜杠命令。

plugins.name: labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens
plugins.description: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.
plugins.description_zh: 渐进披露 MCP 网关：用 `mcp_search` 检索大型远程工具目录，再由 `mcp_call` 按精确 schema 调用，并采用惰性连接与有界缓存。

plugins.name: leechen298/Code2Skill
plugins.description: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
plugins.description_zh: 从用户授权的源码生成 Function、MCP 工具、工作流 Skill 与离线测试包。

plugins.name: Leo-Ayh-Oday/dsh-orcana#dsh-bundle

plugins.name: lilming123/dsh-api

plugins.name: lilyblessing/dsh-mcp-skill-panel
plugins.description: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
plugins.description_zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

plugins.name: lire1131/dsh-undo-savepoint

plugins.name: LIU20030725/dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Manage and organize your agent skills by category, tags and collections in DeepSeek Harness, with a settings panel and a slash-command folder picker.
plugins.description_zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按分类、标签和集合文件夹管理你的 agent 技能，自带设置面板与输入框文件夹技能挑选器。

plugins.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-agentframe-suite
plugins.description: One-command bundle of the three AgentFrame plugins: memory-director, compaction, and aura-scheduler together.
plugins.description_zh: AgentFrame 三件套整合包：一条命令装齐记忆、压缩与主动调度。

plugins.name: loeanxi/dsh-cursor-acp
plugins.description: Hands standalone jobs to the Cursor CLI signed in on the same machine, with child-model settings and a read-only connectivity test.
plugins.description_zh: 将独立任务交给同机已登录的 Cursor 命令行，并提供子模型设置和只读连通性测试。

plugins.name: loongsuite/dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.

plugins.name: lsz-asd/dsh-chameleon#bundle

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-doc-guard
plugins.description: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-weekly-digest
plugins.description: Weekly digest generator: aggregates git commits, DSH session activity and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report, read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 周报生成器：聚合最近 N 天的 git 提交、会话活动与每日记忆，自动生成 Markdown 周报，全程只读。

plugins.name: luumod/dsh-desktop-lifecycle

plugins.name: lxp731/agents-plugins#dsh-service-control

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-skill-mcp-center

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager
plugins.description: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.

plugins.name: minivv/dsh-agent-skills

plugins.name: mkiea/dsh-forge
plugins.description: Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.
