plugins.description: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
plugins.description_zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

plugins.name: MutaLucem/dsh-plugin-integration
plugins.description: Discovers installed DSH plugins with tags, overlap and compatibility detection, one-click enable/disable, failure diagnosis, and update checking.
plugins.description_zh: 动态发现已装插件并打标分类，检测功能重叠与兼容冲突，一键启停切换、失效诊断与更新检测。

plugins.name: NormanFxxkingRockwell/harmonyos-dev-mcp-for-dsh
plugins.description: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
plugins.description_zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-plugin-check
plugins.description: Plugin health checks: manifest protocol / patch format / build traps, zero-dependency and read-only.
plugins.description_zh: 插件健康检查：扫描清单协议/patch 格式/构建陷阱，零依赖只读。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-session-health
plugins.description: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
plugins.description_zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/fabric
plugins.description: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
plugins.description_zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/plugin-template
plugins.description: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
plugins.description_zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.description: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
plugins.description_zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-observe
plugins.description: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
plugins.description_zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-output-styles
plugins.description: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
plugins.description_zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-test-drive
plugins.description: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
plugins.description_zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

plugins.name: pzc2004/dsh-frostfin
plugins.description: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
plugins.description_zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code��ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

plugins.name: rand0wn/dsh-minimal-anchor
plugins.description: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.
plugins.description_zh: 只在会话首轮把工具清单裁剪到白名单并注入一段结构化前言，之后每一轮原样放行。

plugins.name: Raphaelutumn/dsh-change-budget
plugins.description: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
plugins.description_zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

plugins.name: dsh-myrules
plugins.description: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

plugins.name: rj-jiangyichen/dsh-rules
plugins.description: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
plugins.description_zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

plugins.name: ruby1304/dsh-preset-anchored-standard
plugins.description: Minimal-anchored agent preset: request #1 keeps the real bash + str_replace_editor pair with auto-injected context stripped, then promotion unlocks the full Standard catalog and posts a one-shot background-jobs notice against sleep-polling habits.
plugins.description_zh: Minimal 锚定的 agent preset：request #1 仅保留真实 bash + str_replace_editor 工具对并剥离自动注入上下文，晋升后开放完整 Standard 工具目录，并注入一次性后台 job 提示纠正 sleep 前台轮询惯性。

plugins.name: ryubyte/dsh-a2a
plugins.description: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

plugins.name: SaiSenBox/dsh-boot-guard
plugins.description: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
plugins.description_zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

plugins.name: shinjiyu/deepseek-harness-evolver
plugins.description: Complement to official Creator mode: stage, validate, live-mount via ctx.plugin, score, and solidify or roll back in-memory tool-plugin trials.
plugins.description_zh: 补充官方创造模式：把内存里试过的小工具插件校验、经 ctx.plugin 热挂、打分后固化到盘上或回滚。

plugins.name: sjh9714/dsh-movein
plugins.description: Migrate and import a whole Claude Code or Codex setup into DSH. Skills, slash commands, MCP servers, hooks, subagents and permission rules, with a dry-run moving estimate, a migration diff report and a post-move doctor; installs as a plugin exposing a movein_from_claude_code tool so the agent can do the move for you.
plugins.description_zh: 一键迁移导入整套 Claude Code 或 Codex 配置到 DSH：技能、斜杠命令、MCP、hooks、子代理、权限规则，默认先出搬家清单预演，输出迁移差异报告，搬完可用 doctor 体检；作为插件提供 movein_from_claude_code 工具，直接让 agent 帮你搬。

plugins.name: sjh9714/dsh-win32
plugins.description: Makes Minimal mode work on Windows by supplying the missing win32 process inspector, so the persistent shell actually starts. Adds a busybox-based preset whose persistent shell survives the workspace-write restricted token (MSYS shells die there), ConPTY console-list foreground resolution, GBK/UTF-16 file reads, and an install-trap doctor.
plugins.description_zh: 补上官方缺失的 win32 进程探测，让 Minimal 模式在 Windows 上真正可用，持久 shell 才能起来。附 busybox 变体预设，其持久 shell 能在 workspace-write 受限令牌下存活（MSYS 系 shell 在那里会崩），另有基于 ConPTY 控制台进程列表的前台命令解析、GBK/UTF-16 文件读取，以及安装排障工具。

plugins.name: Small-tailqwq/dsh-tps
plugins.description: A TPS metrics plugin.
plugins.description_zh: TPS 指标插件。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-flakefinder
plugins.description: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history and maintain a quarantine manifest.
plugins.description_zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档与隔离清单。

plugins.name: Starfie1d1272/dsh-builtin-toggles
plugins.description: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

plugins.name: strukto-ai/mirage#dsh
plugins.description: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
plugins.description_zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

plugins.name: stuarthu/dsh-hot-reload
plugins.description: Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
plugins.description_zh: 插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，��需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

plugins.name: swaylq/dsh-genie
plugins.description: Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
plugins.description_zh: 把 agent 现场造出来的插件留下来：将 `cordis_define` 的动态包固化成能跨重启存活的正式插件，写包并注册 profile 层的全过程不用 pnpm、不联网、不需要构建授权。

plugins.name: tancheng33/dsh-spill-s3
plugins.description: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
plugins.description_zh: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

plugins.name: Tang-mm95/dsh-single-instance-guard
plugins.description: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.
plugins.description_zh: 检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

plugins.name: tianyaZTY/dsh-hot-plugin-host
plugins.description: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。

plugins.name: tuogusa/dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Web 设置面板中浏览、搜索、删除/撤回并更新用户技能，支持从 GitHub/Gitee Release 检查技能更新。

plugins.name: vibeinging/dsh-trace
plugins.description: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
plugins.description_zh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

plugins.name: william-jin-cmu/dsh-evolve
plugins.description: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
plugins.description_zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

plugins.name: wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-gzip
plugins.description: Gzip compression for /api responses, fixing history-load timeouts over remote/low-bandwidth connections; skips SSE and already-encoded responses.
plugins.description_zh: /api 响应 gzip 压缩，解决远程/低带宽访问时历史加载超时；SSE 与已编码响应自动豁免。

plugins.name: wiyi/dsh-web-service-manager
plugins.description: Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务:状态、版本、重启、停止与一键更新。

plugins.name: WM-CODER/custom-first-control-prompt
plugins.description: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。

plugins.name: WODE25500/dsh-az
plugins.description: Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.
plugins.description_zh: Azure 资源管理：查询/展示资源、部署 Bicep/ARM 模板、查看活动日志。

plugins.name: WODE25500/dsh-codex
plugins.description: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.
plugins.description_zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 封装：一次性任务、仓库审查与会话续接，默认只读沙箱。

plugins.name: WODE25500/dsh-k6
plugins.description: Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.
plugins.description_zh: Grafana k6 压测：先冒烟再跑脚本，从 JSON 汇总读百分位数。

plugins.name: WODE25500/dsh-kubectl
plugins.description: Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
plugins.description_zh: Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。

plugins.name: WODE25500/dsh-terraform
plugins.description: Infrastructure as code: gated plan/apply, state and output inspection, and configuration validation via the terraform CLI.
plugins.description_zh: 基础设施即代码：plan/apply 门控、state/output 检查与配置校验。

plugins.name: WODE25500/dsh-winget
plugins.description: Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.
plugins.description_zh: Windows 包管理器：搜索、安装、升级、卸载、导入导出与版本固定。

plugins.name: worksAssistant/dsh-quickref
plugins.description: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.
plugins.description_zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

plugins.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-guard
plugins.description: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.
plugins.description_zh: 开发配套守护：滚动快照、插件失败自动回退、启动失败救援、设置页管理面板。

plugins.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-shield
plugins.description: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
plugins.description_zh: 脱手模式安全网：agent 删除的目录先进回收站、链接绝不跟随，零审批。

plugins.name: xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup
plugins.description: One-command backup & restore of DSH user data: /backup commands, a backup_dsh tool and a Settings panel, sha256 verification with hardened restore (path-traversal and symlink rejection), scheduled auto-backup that survives restarts, rotation, an archive download route and GitHub sync to a private repo. Credentials are redacted by default — .credentials.yaml and .env stay in a local vault rather than the archive, and a cross-machine restore lists what to re-enter. macOS/Linux/Windows.
plugins.description_zh: 一键备份与恢复 DSH 用户数据：/backup 命令族、backup_dsh 工具与可视化设置面板，sha256 校验与加固恢复（拒绝路径穿越/��链），定时自动备份（重启续跑）、轮换、归档下载路由、GitHub 私有仓库同步。默认对凭据脱敏——.credentials.yaml 与 .env 留在本地保险库而不进归档，跨机恢复时会列出需要重新填写的项。macOS/Linux/Windows。

plugins.name: xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-auto-exit
plugins.description: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
plugins.description_zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

plugins.name: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-updater-ui
plugins.description: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
plugins.description_zh: 设置页中的 DSH 自助更新器：一键检查/拉取（git pull --ff-only）、自动后台检查、版本对比与更新说明预览，带红点提醒。

plugins.name: xxiaoxiong/dsh-prometheus
plugins.description: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
plugins.description_zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

plugins.name: young-tim/dsh-profile-lab
plugins.description: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
plugins.description_zh: 运行可复现的 DSH Profile 与 Patch 实验，并提供引导式用例构建、断言、Web 对比报告、恢复和策略门禁。

plugins.name: YTxue/dsh-skill-manager-ytxue
plugins.description: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
plugins.description_zh: 设置侧边栏的 Skill 管理器：池与启用目录启停、文件夹批量导��（重名询问）、状态驱动一键规范检查与自动修复、系统级/项目级来源标识。

plugins.name: YZz-S/dsh-update-checker
plugins.description: Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.
plugins.description_zh: 会话顶栏徽章：显示 DeepSeek Harness 当前版本，自动检查 npm 最新版本，有新版时提示升级。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-start
plugins.description: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
plugins.description_zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

plugins.name: Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor
plugins.description: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.
plugins.description_zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

plugins.name: ZK-Andy/dsh-continual-evolve
plugins.description: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
plugins.description_zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-cn-boot
plugins.description: China-network bootstrap for dsh: probes npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee and local proxies, reads registry config, recommends mirrors/proxy, and generates a PowerShell + bash bootstrap script. Read-only by default; apply is explicit. CLI plus an agent-callable cn_boot tool.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 国内网络引导：探测 npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee 与本地代理，读取注册表配置，推荐镜像/代理并生成 PowerShell + bash 引导脚本。默认只读，apply 显式。含 CLI 与 agent 可调用 cn_boot 工具。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-dep-audit
plugins.description: Dependency supply-chain hygiene audit for dsh projects and profiles: peer-range resolvability, broken dist-tag detection (#2763 class), stale / missing-license / non-registry dependencies, and installed-vs-declared drift — CLI plus an agent-callable dep_audit tool.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 项目与 profile 的依赖供应链卫生审计：peer 范围可解析性、坏 dist-tag 检测（#2763 类）、过期/缺许可证/非注册表来源依赖与安装版本漂移——CLI + agent 可调用 dep_audit 工具。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-discussions-radar
plugins.description: Official GitHub Discussions radar for DeepSeek Harness: list, filter and search the official boards (Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls) — CLI plus an agent-callable discussions_radar tool, dsh-discussions-radar/v1 reports, zero runtime deps, read-only public API.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions 雷达：列出、筛选、搜索官方讨论区（Ideas / Q&A / Show Your Plugins! / General / Announcements / Polls）——CLI + agent 可调用 discussions_radar 工具，dsh-discussions-radar/v1 报告，零运行时依赖、只读公开 API。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-disk-audit
plugins.description: Disk-usage audit for dsh data directories: total size, per-directory breakdown, largest files, oversized-file warnings (session logs can hit hundreds of MB) and cleanup suggestions — CLI plus an agent-callable disk_audit tool, dsh-disk-audit/v1 reports, zero runtime deps, read-only.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 数据目录磁盘占用审计：总大小、按目录拆分、最大文件、超大文件告警（会话日志可达数百 MB）与清理建议——CLI + agent 可调用 disk_audit 工具，dsh-disk-audit/v1 报告，零运行时依赖、只读。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-firstrun
plugins.description: First-run health check for DeepSeek Harness: verifies Node/pnpm/dsh toolchain, home, profile, API key (names only, never values), workspace writability and npm registry, then prints actionable next steps — CLI plus an agent-callable quickstart tool, dsh-firstrun/v1 reports, zero runtime deps.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 首次运行体检：检查 Node/pnpm/dsh 工具链、home、profile、API Key（只显示名称、绝不显示值）、工作区可写性与 npm 注册表，并给出可执行下一步——CLI + agent 可调用 quickstart 工具，dsh-firstrun/v1 报告，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-llms-forge
plugins.description: Generate llms.txt for dsh plugin repositories from package.json + README — AI-readable discovery files, zero runtime deps, read-only by default. CLI plus an agent-callable llms_forge tool.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh 插件仓库从 package.json + README 生成 llms.txt（AI 可读发现文件），零运行时依赖、默认只读，含 CLI 与 agent 可调用 llms_forge 工具。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Health checks for DSH plugins: manifest/patch/entry/build/pack/install verification, model-callable plugin_check, profile host-shadowing + BOM detection, environment diagnostics, and poison preflight.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件体检：manifest/patch/entry/build/pack/install 校验、可被模型调用的 plugin_check、profile 宿主遮蔽与 BOM 检测、环境诊断、投毒预检。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-quality-score
plugins.description: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-readme-forge
plugins.description: Generate README.md for dsh plugin repositories from package.json + cordis.patch.yml + source layout — install/CLI/tools/dev/license sections, deterministic, zero runtime deps, read-only by default. CLI plus an agent-callable readme_forge tool.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh 插件仓库从 package.json + cordis.patch.yml + 源码布局生成 README.md——安装/CLI/工具/开发/许可证章节，确定性输出、零运行时依赖、默认只读。CLI + agent 可调用 readme_forge 工具。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-rule-evolve
plugins.description: Verification-driven self-evolution loop: failure logs become verified AGENTS.md rules; in-session plugin (evolve_learn / evolve_apply / evolve_touch / evolve_recall), tool-verify gate, rule lifecycle, local recall.
plugins.description_zh: 验证驱动的自我进化循环：失败日志自动变成经过验证的 AGENTS.md 规则；会话内插件（evolve_learn/evolve_apply/evolve_touch/evolve_recall）、工具体检、规则生命周期、本地召回。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-timesheet
plugins.description: Turn-based time tracking from dsh session logs: totals, per-day/project/provider/source rollups, tool-call counts, failure rates, and time-to-first-token — CLI plus an agent-callable timesheet tool, dsh-timesheet/v1 reports, zero runtime deps.
plugins.description_zh: 从 dsh 会话日志做基于 turn 的时间跟踪：总计、按天/项目/供应商/来源汇总、工具调用数、失败率与首 token 延迟——CLI + agent 可调用 timesheet 工具，dsh-timesheet/v1 报告，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: 030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor
plugins.description: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
plugins.description_zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

plugins.name: 030611/dsh-verification-receipt
plugins.description: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
plugins.description_zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

plugins.name: 030611/qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit
plugins.description: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
plugins.description_zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-gov
plugins.description: Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 治理套件：基于策略的工具门禁（allow/deny/ask，支持通配符与优先级）、结构化 JSONL 审计日志、基于宿主 token 计量的按 agent 配额，状态存于 $DSH_HOME/gov。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-gate
plugins.description: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

plugins.name: 940842546/dsh-permissions
plugins.description: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-perm-guard
plugins.description: Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.
plugins.description_zh: 自动审批权限守卫：介于 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间的中间档——信任目录内安全操作自动放行，危险操作一律人工确认；11 个分类开关可调，自带审计记录。

plugins.name: Alnita-M/dsh-Almost_Full_Access
plugins.description: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
plugins.description_zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

plugins.name: AntaresCorn/dsh-auto-reviewer
plugins.description: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格自动审查权限模式：新增 auto-review 权限档，自动放行安全沙箱提权，危险或模糊操作转人工确认，未确认的致命操作直接拒绝。

plugins.name: arrow949/dsh-turn-approval
plugins.description: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
plugins.description_zh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

plugins.name: bigclawd/dsh-security-guard
plugins.description: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

plugins.name: BotonJ/dsh-plugin-sentinel
plugins.description: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
plugins.description_zh: 插件安装前静态安全审计：生命周期脚本、动态执行、凭据外传组合特征与 patch 层风险；零依赖，tar 包全程内存解析不落盘。

plugins.name: cdxiaodong/dsh-guardian
plugins.description: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

plugins.name: ChenLaoshiYF/dsh-mcpguard
plugins.description: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
plugins.description_zh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

plugins.name: couldbeme/dsh-write-gate
plugins.description: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
plugins.description_zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-approve-for-me
plugins.description: Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.
plugins.description_zh: 自动化审批审核：只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，策略引擎 fail-closed。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-secret-redactor
plugins.description: Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.
plugins.description_zh: 工具结果敏感信息自动脱敏：模型看到前掩码 API key / token / JWT / 私钥与配置密钥。

plugins.name: Darren-Tang/dsh-provenance
plugins.description: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

plugins.name: Eligahyu/dsh-sentinel-scanner
plugins.description: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

plugins.name: GDWhisper/dsh-web-startup-auth
plugins.description: Replaces the dsh web startup to allow binding 0.0.0.0, gated by username/password login: signed session cookies, /api route protection, an auth tab in the settings panel, and a reset CLI that rotates the signing key to invalidate all sessions.
plugins.description_zh: 替换 dsh web 启动器以允许绑定 0.0.0.0，并以账号密码登录为门槛：签名会话 cookie、/api 路由保护、设置面板认证标签页，以及轮换签名密钥使全部会话失效的重置 CLI。

plugins.name: howmp/dsh-pentest
plugins.description: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

plugins.name: hxy91819/dsh-auth
plugins.description: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
plugins.description_zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

plugins.name: ilharp/dsh-tool-approval
plugins.description: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
plugins.description_zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

plugins.name: Jiao-XXX/dsh-auto-approve
plugins.description: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
plugins.description_zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

plugins.name: jilian-dsh/dsh-rule-engine
plugins.description: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
plugins.description_zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/safety-net
plugins.description: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.
plugins.description_zh: dsh 破坏性命令拦截闸门：解析 shell 语义、依据 41 条内置规则判定风险，将 rm -rf、git reset --hard、git push --force 等不可逆命令挡在确认关卡之前。

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
plugins.description_zh: 拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不��出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

plugins.name: JW53222/faultseed#dsh
plugins.description: Honesty guardrails on the tool pipeline: blocks a coding agent from weakening tests, swallowing errors, stubbing type checks, or deleting tests through the shell — nine deterministic hooks, each backed by a planted-failure test proving the guard can fail.
plugins.description_zh: 工具流水线上的诚实性护栏：阻止编码 agent 弱化测试、吞掉错误、用桩替换类型检查或通过 shell 删除测试——九个确定性 hook，每个都配有植入失败的测试，证明该护栏确实会触发。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-fleet-audit
plugins.description: Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.
plugins.description_zh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

plugins.name: Letter2025/dsh-approval-llm
plugins.description: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
plugins.description_zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

plugins.name: lonelymoon87/dsh-guardian
plugins.description: Adds dangerous-operation policy checks, output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
plugins.description_zh: 增加危险操作策略检查、输出脱敏和安全审查工作流。

plugins.name: MicroMilo/upstream-radar
plugins.description: Always-on dependency security for DSH plugins: tracks exact installed paths, OSV vulnerabilities, npm releases, and breaking-change signals, then routes project evidence to a DSH Agent.
plugins.description_zh: 面向 DSH 插件的常驻依赖安全监控：追踪实际安装路径、OSV 漏洞、npm 发布和破坏性更新信号，再把项目证据交给 DSH Agent。

plugins.name: moon09300731/dsh-approval-gate
plugins.description: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回��，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

plugins.name: MrWeiCodes/dsh-permgate
plugins.description: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
plugins.description_zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-security-audit
plugins.description: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
plugins.description_zh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/sandbox-micro
plugins.description: Support for the microsandbox backend.
plugins.description_zh: microsandbox 沙箱支持。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/sandbox-mxc
plugins.description: Microsoft cross-platform sandbox support.
plugins.description_zh: 微软跨平台沙盒支持。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/sandbox-nono
plugins.description: Support for the nono sandbox backend.
plugins.description_zh: nono 沙盒支持。

plugins.name: onlyqzq/dsh-riskproof
plugins.description: Provenance-aware execution security that tracks sensitive data across DSH tool calls and blocks risky exfiltration before execution.
plugins.description_zh: 具备来源追踪能力的执行安全机制，可跨 DSH 工具调用持续追踪敏感数据，并在执行前阻断高风险的数据外泄行为。

plugins.name: PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-auto-classifier
plugins.description: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
plugins.description_zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

plugins.name: pengxuding/dsh-plugin-judge
plugins.description: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
plugins.description_zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

plugins.name: PensiveFei/dsh-secure-audit
plugins.description: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-auto-review
plugins.description: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
plugins.description_zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules
plugins.description: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
plugins.description_zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-skill-pack-security
plugins.description: Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
plugins.description_zh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

plugins.name: SARTHAK2511/dsh-cve-audit
plugins.description: Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.
plugins.description_zh: 面向你自己项目依赖（npm/pip/go）的实时 CVE/供应链审计，基于 OSV.dev，提供 `cve_audit` 工具，并支持在 lockfile 变化时自动重新扫描。

plugins.name: sashankh/dsh-taintguard
plugins.description: Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.
plugins.description_zh: 当工具结果包含不可信内容时将代理标记为已污染，对随后的高权限调用进行拦截，并在所有模式下拒绝将凭据传递给可联网的工具。

plugins.name: SeverusZh/dsh-yolo-mode
plugins.description: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
plugins.description_zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

plugins.name: shaoshi20/dshscan
plugins.description: Security scanner for DSH plugins: static and semantic passes over plugin source, DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, batch scanning, and an HTML report with per-finding severity and evidence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：对插件源码做静态与语义双通道检查，内置 DSH 特有攻击面规则，集成 npm audit，支持批量扫描，输出带严重等级与证据的 HTML 报告。

plugins.name: shuxue6662-a11y/dsh-risk-guard
plugins.description: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
plugins.description_zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并���纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

plugins.name: simon300000/dsh-auto
plugins.description: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
plugins.description_zh: 为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

plugins.name: sjh9714/dsh-movein-permissions
plugins.description: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool), works standalone without migrating.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

plugins.name: slywalker2006/dsh-passwords
plugins.description: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
plugins.description_zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-code-security
plugins.description: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance and SBOM-lite dependency inventory.
plugins.description_zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受与 SBOM-lite 依赖清单。

plugins.name: SummerSec/dsh-web-auth
plugins.description: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie��基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

plugins.name: tancheng33/dsh-code-runtime-container
plugins.description: Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.
plugins.description_zh: `ctx.codeRuntime` seam 的容器隔离后端：每个 Code Mode 程序跑在全新容器里，无网络、根文件系统只读、丢弃全部 capability，内存/CPU/进程数上限由内核强制。

plugins.name: tancheng33/dsh-credentials-vault
plugins.description: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.
plugins.description_zh: 凭证 seam 的 HashiCorp Vault 后端：支持 KV v2/v1、AppRole 机器认证、逐次操作读取（轮换无需重启）与 compare-and-swap 写入。

plugins.name: tancheng33/dsh-egress-guard
plugins.description: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
plugins.description_zh: 工具管线上的运行时安全网关：拦截出站白名单之外的主机调用，在 canonical value（而非仅渲染内容）层面脱敏结果中的凭据，每个决策写入 JSONL 审计日志；默认仅监控不拦截。

plugins.name: TecFancy/dsh-auth-gate
plugins.description: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

plugins.name: toby-bridges/api-relay-audit
plugins.description: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.
plugins.description_zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对 AI API 中转站和 LLM 代理运行本地安全审计，生成 Markdown 报告，覆盖提示词注入、模型替换信号、工具调用改写、错误泄漏、流完整性和按 profile 启用的 Web3 风险。

plugins.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting
plugins.description: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
plugins.description_zh: 为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。

plugins.name: wulun811/dsh-plugin-vet
plugins.description: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

plugins.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-lan-pass
plugins.description: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

plugins.name: xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway
plugins.description: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
plugins.description_zh: 为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

plugins.name: xgone/dsh-remote
plugins.description: Remote access & authentication for DeepSeek Harness web UI: account/password login gate, MFA (TOTP), signed session cookies, role-based access, in-browser directory picker, account management settings, fully localized in English and Chinese.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端远程访问与认证：账号/密码登录门、MFA（TOTP 两步验证）、签名会话 Cookie、基于角色的访问控制、浏览器内目录选择器、账号管理设置页，界面支持中英双语。

plugins.name: ylwl1997/noatmark-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
plugins.description_zh: 文本卫生 dsh 插件：净化不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清洗 LLM 格式、转义 CSV 公式注入。

plugins.name: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth
plugins.description: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
plugins.description_zh: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard
plugins.description: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

plugins.name: 534119219/chicheng-gate
plugins.description: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。

plugins.name: AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access
plugins.description: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.
plugins.description_zh: Web UI 局域网/远程访问：为纯 HTTP 非安全上下文注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，局域网/Tailscale IP 直连时前端不再崩溃。

plugins.name: ai-eks/dsh-auth-tunnel
plugins.description: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
plugins.description_zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问���并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

plugins.name: baixianger/dsh-weave
plugins.description: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
plugins.description_zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

plugins.name: Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate
plugins.description: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
plugins.description_zh: 局域网手机访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问审批 + 设备令牌绑定 + 限流 + 手机端紧凑排版注入（输入区权限/模型小胶囊、randomUUID polyfill）。

plugins.name: Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote#plugin
plugins.description: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
plugins.description_zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

plugins.name: BotonJ/dsh-remote-link
plugins.description: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
plugins.description_zh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

plugins.name: cindyguyuehu123/dsh-mobile
plugins.description: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).
plugins.description_zh: 让 DSH 在 iPhone/iPad 上可用：显式开启的局域网反向代理（���写 Host/Origin 通过回环信任栅栏，含 WebSocket 升级）、iOS PWA 外壳（主屏幕图标、standalone meta、viewport-fit）、触屏/移动端 CSS（安全区、键盘避让、输入框按钮行适配）。

plugins.name: clarknu/dsh-gateway
plugins.description: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
plugins.description_zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-remote-web-ui
plugins.description: Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry with one-time pairing tokens.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 移动端远程控制：扫码配对 QR 入口、一次性配对 token。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-ssh
plugins.description: Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store and persisted sessions.
plugins.description_zh: dsh web GUI 远程 SSH 操作：主机配置存储、持久化会话。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh/dsh-ssh#dsh-ssh
plugins.description: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.
plugins.description_zh: SSH 远端工作区——在远端机器上执行 bash、文件读写、glob 与 grep（基于 sshd 的 exec + SFTP），远端零安装，纯附加。

plugins.name: godchen520/dsh-web-remote
plugins.description: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link + LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access (auto self-signed cert), token auth, gzip compression, floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, and a NapCat QQ bot channel to fetch the link.
plugins.description_zh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接 + 局域网 HTTP/HTTPS ���连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码），并内置 NapCat QQ 机器人取链接通道。

plugins.name: jack-ranbo/dsh-wsl-expose
plugins.description: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
plugins.description_zh: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

plugins.name: jsdvjx/dshn#agent
plugins.description: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).
plugins.description_zh: 把本地 dsh 网页通过带登录门禁的中继转发到公网 *.ds.hn 子域名(也可自托管到自己的域名),支持可选的端到端加密(PBKDF2 到 AES-256-GCM)。

plugins.name: JUANWANG-BUAA/dsh-full-remote
plugins.description: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
plugins.description_zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

plugins.name: JUNQINGV587/dsh-ssh-hub
plugins.description: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web GUI 多服务器 SSH 终端面板：浮动终端窗口支持标签页、并排组合、广播、宿主侧持久会话，以及密码/私钥/SSH Agent 认证。

plugins.name: KyoMio/dsh-zen-remote
plugins.description: Phone-first mobile UI rework plus a pairing-code gateway: use DSH from anywhere as an installable PWA with Web Push, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
plugins.description_zh: 手机优先的移动端界面重排 + 配对码网关：经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 把 DSH 变成可安装、带推送的 PWA。

plugins.name: Leon0555/dsh-lan-access
plugins.description: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
plugins.description_zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

plugins.name: liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote
plugins.description: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness: continue an active session from your phone, tablet, browser, or another computer over an end-to-end encrypted channel (Noise IK + adaptive relay/WebRTC transport), with device authorization, ApiProxy-only remote capabilities, and read-only file preview via dsh-file-viewer — no shell, remote desktop, or write access.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 多端远程访问：从手机、平板、浏览器或另一台电脑继续进行中的会话，端到端加密通道（Noise IK + 自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输），设备授权管理；远程端仅开放 ApiProxy 能力，支持 dsh-file-viewer 只读文件预览，不提供 Shell、远程桌面或写入权限。

plugins.name: Linjiangxian0203/dsh-remote-tunnel
plugins.description: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
plugins.description_zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

plugins.name: litestartup-com/dsh-api-gateway
plugins.description: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.
plugins.description_zh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

plugins.name: MDR-EX1000/dsh-rw
plugins.description: Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.
plugins.description_zh: Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。

plugins.name: mervyn-teo/dsh-plugin-qr-connect
plugins.description: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
plugins.description_zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

plugins.name: mexiaosqwq/dsh-web-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile-adaptive layout for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes a content-hugging overlay drawer, the conversation gets the full width, and the settings panel becomes a near-full-width sheet.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏下侧边栏变为贴合内容的 overlay 抽屉、会话独占全宽，设置面板改为近全宽 sheet。

plugins.name: moyu-good/dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.description: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge

plugins.description_zh: 把微信私聊桥接进 DSH agent 会话并流式回传回复，支持热插拔与设置页签。

plugins.name: ook826092-cloud/dsh-mobile-css
plugins.description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.

plugins.name: polaris-smart/dph-fleet

plugins.name: pppolf/dsh-webgate

plugins.name: saya-ch/dsh-mobile

plugins.name: TongaiLinC/dsh-mobile-access

plugins.name: wangzhishou/onebox-dsh-bridge

plugins.name: zylzyqzz/dsh-mobile-pwa

plugins.name: marvin9551/dynamic-schulte-dsh
plugins.description: Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.
plugins.description_zh: 动态舒尔特方格等待小游戏：模型思考时，在静态网格或旋转轮盘上按顺序点击 1..N，边玩边等。

plugins.name: miku00039-01/dsh-whale-pet
plugins.description: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
plugins.description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

plugins.name: minybear/DeepSeek-Harness-Pet
plugins.description: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
plugins.description_zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

plugins.name: Moeblack/deepseek-manners
plugins.description: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.
plugins.description_zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

plugins.name: Nagi-ovo/dsh-ads
plugins.description: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
plugins.description_zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

plugins.name: Nanki-nn/dsh-answer-pet
plugins.description: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
plugins.description_zh: 可扩展回答状态宠物，内置蓝鲸、橘猫和银渐层猫主题；按会话实时展示回答进度、模型动作与工具调用轨迹、token、输出速率与耗时，并支持多会话状态卡片展开和收起。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-petdex-market
plugins.description: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.
plugins.description_zh: 在设置中浏览 petdex.dev 宠物市集，并运行一只响应 agent 活动的 macOS 悬浮桌面宠物��

plugins.name: nzl153/dsh-pet-whale
plugins.description: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline: pure-SVG animation follows agent state (thinking, working, celebrating, error), with poke and double-click flip interactions, cursor avoidance, 7 palettes, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
plugins.description_zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠：纯 SVG 动画随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错），可戳可拖、双击翻滚，光标停留在身侧会自己避让，7 套色板并跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-auto-chess
plugins.description: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.
plugins.description_zh: 自走棋：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-gomoku
plugins.description: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
plugins.description_zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

plugins.name: ovdoesw/dsh-xiangqi
plugins.description: A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.
plugins.description_zh: 卡通小宠物邀请你在 AI 思考间隙下中国象棋：内置引擎、走子记谱导出、可选多模型局势点评。

plugins.name: PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet#dsh-pet
plugins.description: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：25 个透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击反应与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成链。

plugins.name: PM25000/dsh-ths-holdings
plugins.description: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
plugins.description_zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

plugins.name: PocketSWPU/dsh-serendipity
plugins.description: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.
plugins.description_zh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

plugins.name: potoior/dsh-bull-bear
plugins.description: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

plugins.name: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」
plugins.description: XiaoTangYuan, an in-game AI companion for single-player games: understands the game screen, chats by text or push-to-talk, and speaks replies aloud; Stardew Valley is supported, with Don't Starve Together and Oxygen Not Included integrations in progress.
plugins.description_zh: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」：理解游戏画面，支持文字或按住说话交流并语音回复；现已支持《星露谷物语》，《饥荒联机版》和《缺氧》正在迁移接入。

plugins.name: Rain-Shuoyu/dsh-client-deep-sneak
plugins.description: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
plugins.description_zh: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

plugins.name: says693/dsh-log-memory
plugins.description: Popup guardian for session logs: opens with the Web UI on a configurable reminder interval (10 min-3 h), with one-click incremental backup of every session.jsonl(.zstd) under ~/.dsh/sessions in raw or readable chat-log format.
plugins.description_zh: 会话日志守护弹窗：打开 Web 即提醒（间隔 10 分钟至 3 小时可调），一键增量备份 ~/.dsh/sessions 全部 session.jsonl(.zstd)��可选原始压缩或可读聊天记录两种格式，弹窗内可选备份文件夹。

plugins.name: shinjiyu/holdem#dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Host tools for Texas Hold'em on kuroneko.chat — seat token, hosted/manual control, legal actions, and act loop for one GitHub identity.
plugins.description_zh: 连接 kuroneko.chat 德州扑克桌的 Host 工具：座位令牌、人控/托管切换、合法动作查询与行动循环（同一 GitHub 帐号一席）。

plugins.name: Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet#dsh-codex-pet
plugins.description: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

plugins.name: sjh9714/clippy-harness#plugin
plugins.description: Clippy is back and this time he can actually help. An office assistant pet that reacts to real agent state, jumps when the turn completes, and opens a classic "illegal operation" dialog when a turn fails.
plugins.description_zh: 回形针助手回来了，这次它真的会干活：会对真实 agent 状态做出反应的办公助手宠物，任务完成时跳起来庆祝，回合失败时弹出经典的 "illegal operation" 对话框。

plugins.name: skiuniverse/dsh-running-liang
plugins.description: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
plugins.description_zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进��条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

plugins.name: skr311/dsh-codex-pet#dsh-codex-pet
plugins.description: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
plugins.description_zh: 导入/上传 Codex 风格精灵图序列帧宠物，在 DSH Web GUI 以悬浮浮层渲染，含图库管理、交互与 Agent 状态联动。

plugins.name: Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-whale-musume
plugins.description: A cute whale-girl desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: pat-to-raise growth, live work-state poses, 494 dialogue lines, 30 achievements and a built-in settings panel — all local, zero telemetry.
plugins.description_zh: 元气鲸鱼娘桌宠：摸头养成、工作状态联动、494 条台词与 30 项成就，自带设置面板，全本地零遥测。

plugins.name: swaylq/dsh-digipet
plugins.description: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.
plugins.description_zh: 数码宝贝式养成：孵一颗吃真实工作长大的蛋（回合、工具调用、报错都是营养），按你的工作方式走四条进化分支；零 token，模型完全看不见。

plugins.name: swaylq/dsh-wildmon
plugins.description: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.
plugins.description_zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

plugins.name: THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-coyote
plugins.description: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
plugins.description_zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话���却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

plugins.name: Tisitan/dsh-live2d-companion
plugins.description: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.
plugins.description_zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：8 态 AI 状态灯 + 网页挂件 + 置顶透明 Electron 桌宠窗，表情/动作/气泡齐全，换模型自动适配。

plugins.name: TongY1n/ui-muyu
plugins.description: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.
plugins.description_zh: 一个赛博木鱼：可拖拽、点击敲击、累积功德的 Web 悬浮小摆件。

plugins.name: txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet
plugins.description: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.
plugins.description_zh: 浮动在 DSH Web 页面上的 DeepSeek 蓝色小鲸鱼桌宠：可拖拽，说话气泡与心情姿势随互动切换，模型可调用 pet_say 工具让它开口，对话开始/结束时自动进入思考与庆祝状态。

plugins.name: vlln/whale-girl
plugins.description: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
plugins.description_zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

plugins.name: whitefirer/dsh-niulai-pet
plugins.description: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.
plugins.description_zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

plugins.name: william-jin-cmu/dsh-stickers
plugins.description: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.
plugins.description_zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。

plugins.name: WJNCT55555/dsh-achievements
plugins.description: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.
plugins.description_zh: DSH Web 成就系统：画廊支持按分类/难度双排序、解锁 toast、侧栏奖杯、输入坞进度读条、联动成就，并本地持久化进度。

plugins.name: xczhanjun/lazeword
plugins.description: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
plugins.description_zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

plugins.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-desktop-pet
plugins.description: DSH pet, on the desktop!
plugins.description_zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠，桌面端！

plugins.name: xiekai886/dsh-MusicPlayer
plugins.description: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.
plugins.description_zh: 可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

plugins.name: Yang-wudi/dsh-kun-like-pet#kunpet-dsh
plugins.description: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
plugins.description_zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

plugins.name: yushi-xxh/dsh-homepage-skin
plugins.description: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
plugins.description_zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款��景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

plugins.name: yyh-001/dsh-meme
plugins.description: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.
plugins.description_zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

plugins.name: ZelinW1/dsh-cosplay
plugins.description: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
plugins.description_zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-pet-evolve
plugins.description: The pet that grows with your agent: 5 evolution stages earned from real signals (verified rules, completed sessions, tool calls, compactions), agent-state mirroring, and one-click growth share cards. Zero dependencies, 100% local.
plugins.description_zh: 会随 agent 成长的宠物：真实信号（已验证规则/会话/工具调用/压缩）驱动 5 阶段进化、镜像 agent 状态、一键导出成长分享卡。零依赖、全本地。
